I guessed that the lower water temperature caused under-extraction, so I decided to raise the water temperature a bit tomorrow and adjust the pour rhythm.

That night he recorded his inspirations in a memo, and an urge to write a novel began to sprout. Since he already had plans for the next day, he moved the rowing machine workout to earlier that evening.

events.name: Father took the initiative to learn more about the store’s operations.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Jianguo asked Lei Mingxuan in detail about the recent customer traffic at his clothing store, the positioning of the new techwear-style apparel, and the online and offline plans. Lei Mingxuan was surprised but pleased, answered patiently, and even took out his phone to show pictures of several new products.

events.name: Reflect on the family's entrepreneurial history and feel a sudden impulse to write a novel
events.description: While talking about his own entrepreneurial journey, Lei Mingxuan suddenly recalled the story his mother had told during the Qingming tomb-sweeping: three generations of the Lei family had made their way from Shanghai's longtang alleys into the business world. He felt a strong resonance between his forebears' struggles and his own entrepreneurship. A surge of impulse rose in him to record the family's changes.

events.name: Rowing machine training.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan went to the community gym for a 30-minute rowing machine workout, with an average heart rate of 150. He completed one of this week’s specialized training sessions (done early because there is roller skating tomorrow evening).

events.name: Use the memo app to record initial novel ideas
events.description: After training, Lei Mingxuan returned home, opened the memo app on his phone, and wrote down character settings and story background: starting from an old longtang in Pudong, depicting the fates of three generations and the transformation of Shanghai, working title 'Afternoon at Xiafei Lane'. He decided to slowly organize the material in his spare time.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Daily routine, starting the day as usual.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Wednesday morning, Lei Mingxuan went for a morning run and methodically brewed coffee; in the morning he organized a spring clothing clearance event at the store; in the afternoon he met with financial advisor Xu Feng as scheduled and adjusted the fund strategy; in the evening he went night skating along the Pudong Riverside with roller-skating partner Song Jia, relaxing his mind and body through exercise and sharing camping plans.

events.name: Morning run 6 kilometers.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, I ran 6 kilometers around the neighborhood at a pace of 6 minutes per kilometer and felt at ease. After the run, I took a shower and made a pour-over cup of fruity, acidic coffee—the flavor was just as good as ever.

events.name: Preparations for the store's end-of-season spring clothing clearance event.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan had the staff gather the remaining spring clothing in the promotion area, launched a 30% off clearance sale, and posted a preview in WeChat community. He personally adjusted the lighting and display signs to attract passing customers.

events.name: Meeting with financial advisor Xu Feng to adjust the fund portfolio.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived on time at the Starbucks near Jing'an Temple. Xu Feng analyzed the current market fluctuations and suggested converting some actively managed funds into regular fixed investments in index funds, and also recommended a conservative bond fund. Lei Mingxuan accepted the suggestion and immediately used the fund app to set up a monthly automatic investment of 3,000 yuan in an index and bond portfolio starting next month, to accumulate funds for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan and for starting a business.

events.name: Contact Song Jia to confirm the night roller skating plan
events.description: After the financial planning meeting, Lei Mingxuan contacted his roller-skating partner Song Jia via WeChat to confirm meeting at 7 p.m. that evening on Binjiang Avenue for a night skate along the Pudong riverside roller-skating trail. Song Jia replied to confirm and reminded him to bring protective gear.

events.name: Organized his roller skating gear and set off.
events.description: In the evening, he went home to organize his roller skates, protective gear, and headlamp, changed into quick-dry sportswear, and then walked to the meeting point on the Pudong riverside roller-skating trail.

events.name: Night skating with Song Jia on the Pudong riverside skating path
events.description: Met up with Song Jia at 7 PM, and the two put on protective gear and skated along the riverfront road toward Nanpu Bridge. With the river breeze blowing in the night, they chatted while skating, taking turns sharing recent camping stories and roller-skating tips.

events.name: Exchange outdoor experiences and rework the camping plan
events.description: During a short rest at the riverside viewing platform, Lei Mingxuan shared his experience of the last camping trip at Bay Forest Park and the recent family conflict. Song Jia then recommended several routes suitable for long-distance roller skating, such as the Chongming Island ring road and the Dianshan Lake lakeside road. When talking about next week's camping trip to Mogan Mountain, Song Jia encouraged him to make sure to go, and the two agreed to team up for outdoor activities later.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Looking forward to the double sense of fulfillment from exercise and financial adjustments

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Relaxed and at ease, clear financial decisions, refreshed after exercise, and the camping plan reignited

2025-05.daily_overview: On Thursday, Lei Mingxuan organized a seasonal warehouse cleanup at the store to make room for the new techwear-style clothing. In the evening, his father Lei Jianguo offered to help at the store on the weekend, which made him feel warm. After returning home, he spent a relaxing evening with his parents, sharing weekend plans and making final preparations for the Moganshan camping trip.

events.name: Organizing the Store's Stockroom and Preparing for the Season Change
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan led store clerk Xiao Lin and a part-time college student to sort and pack the out-of-season clothing in the warehouse, some prepared for donation and some returned to the manufacturer. They cleared two rows of shelves specifically for the techwear new arrivals due at the end of the month, and reorganized the warehouse layout.

events.name: Father offered to come help at the store on the weekend
events.description: During dinner, Lei Jianguo said to Lei Mingxuan that since he was so busy with work every week and he himself had nothing to do on weekends, he could go to the store to help with stocking and organizing the clothing racks. Lei Mingxuan readily agreed and thanked his father for his support.

events.name: Family evening leisure and discussion of camping plans.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan watched two episodes of the TV drama Like a Flowing River in the living room with his parents, chatting about the specific arrangements for his father to go to the store on the weekend. Lei Mingxuan told his parents that the next Saturday and Sunday had been replanned for a camping trip to Moganshan as physical training, and his parents expressed support.

events.name: Bedtime preparation and health record
events.description: Before bed I weighed myself at 77.8 kg, recorded it in the Boohee Health app, and reviewed the day's diet and exercise. I soaked my feet for 20 minutes, skimmed a few Xiaohongshu operation tips, and turned off the lights at 23:00.

start_state.mood: Stable, and I already have a plan for today's warehouse organizing work

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.

2025-05.daily_overview: Lei Mingxuan made final preparations for his solo hiking and camping trip to Moganshan, set off alone by car in the afternoon, arrived at the campsite in the evening, and finished pitching the tent, starting his weekend mountain getaway.

events.name: Organizing camping gear
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan systematically organized his hiking and camping gear at his home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong: checked the condition of the tent, sleeping bag, and moisture-proof pad, adjusted the load of the trekking backpack to 15 kg (including water bladder, dry food, and first aid kit), specially brought hand-drip coffee equipment and an action camera, and tested the headlamp and backup power. Before departure, he checked the vehicle's fuel level and tire pressure and loaded all the gear into the trunk of his family car.

events.name: Drove alone to Mogan Mountain
events.description: Around 17:30 in the evening, Lei Mingxuan set off from his home in Pudong, took the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and then the Changchun-Shenzhen Expressway to the Mogan Mountain Scenic Area in Huzhou, Zhejiang. Along the way, he took a short break at a service area and used his phone to reconfirm the campsite reservation and the next day's hiking route. After about 3.5 hours of driving, he arrived at the foot of Mogan Mountain around 21:00.

events.name: Set up camp and plan the next day's route.
events.description: After arriving at the designated campsite, Lei Mingxuan used the car headlights for illumination, leveled the ground on the flat lawn, set up a double-layer tent, laid out sleeping bags and a moisture-proof mat, taking about 40 minutes. He then checked the safety around the campsite, read a paper hiking map inside the tent with a flashlight, marked key intersections and rest stops, and set an alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Excited and full of anticipation, making final preparations in an orderly manner.

end_state.location: Inside a tent at the Mogan Mountain Scenic Area campsite in Zhejiang
end_state.mood: Satisfied and a little tired, full of anticipation for tomorrow's hike.

state.daily_exercise: Long-distance driving, organizing gear, no extra exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Early morning mist turned to clear skies; mountain temperatures were 15-22°C, with brief gusts in the afternoon.

2025-05.daily_overview: Lei Mingxuan experienced hand-brewed coffee at the camp in the early morning and shared it on his Moments. In the morning, he started a weighted hike but hit a physical bottleneck and withdrew early. In the evening, he learned that a store clerk had independently and properly handled a customer complaint. At night, he reflected deeply and decided to start systematic physical training.

events.name: Campground Pour-Over Coffee and Social Sharing
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan set up a portable stove outside the tent, slowly poured 85°C hot water over hand-drip coffee grounds, and extracted a cup with a rich aroma. Using the mountain morning mist and the rising sun as background, he composed a layered photo with the coffee cup, tent, and hiking backpack, posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption The first sip of clarity in the mountains, and soon received likes and comments from friends such as Zhang Wei, Li Na, Zhao Min, and Shen Jie.

events.name: Weighted Hiking and Physical Exhaustion
events.description: At 8:00 a.m., Lei Mingxuan set out from camp carrying a backpack weighing about 15 kg (including 4 liters of water and dry food for lunch) and followed the mountain loop trail in the scenic area. On the first 5 km of gentle slopes, he maintained a fairly fast pace; from the 6th kilometer, the route turned into continuous steep climbs, and the soreness in his thigh muscles intensified. Along the way, he used a sports camera to record at a viewpoint and a stream. At noon, he had a simple lunch at an altitude of about 800 meters. At 2 p.m., he encountered a continuous climbing section; his quadriceps and calves were in severe pain, and he had to stop and stretch every 200 meters. He assessed that he was close to his physical limits.

events.name: Decisive descent and camp recovery.
events.description: Considering safety, Lei Mingxuan decisively abandoned the final 2 km out-and-back route. After resting in place for 20 minutes, he slowly descended along the original path. Exhausted, he returned to camp at 17:30, immediately took off his hiking boots, applied an ice pack to his calves, consumed an energy gel and electrolyte drinks, and lay down in the tent to recover.

events.name: Shop assistant Xiao Lin handled the customer complaint independently.
events.description: The same afternoon, a customer came to the store upset to complain because a T-shirt purchased earlier at Lei Mingxuan's store had fading and dye transfer issues. The owner was not in, and staff member Xiao Lin received her calmly. She first soothed the customer, carefully inspected the dyeing condition, and quickly proposed a solution of return and refund plus a coupon. After about an hour of communication, the customer left satisfied. Xiao Lin handled the whole matter properly, demonstrating independent customer complaint handling ability.

events.name: Triggered the resolve to exercise systematically
events.description: In the tent in the evening, Lei Mingxuan recalled the leg pain during the hike and realized strongly that his current physical fitness could not support planned outdoor activities such as the self-driving trip in western Sichuan, creating a sense of crisis. He immediately opened the memo on his phone and wrote down the goal: 'Must do aerobic + strength training at least three times a week, and reduce BMI to below 24 within three months,' and decided to start implementing it next Monday. At the same time, he sent a message to store clerk Xiao Lin to confirm store matters.

start_state.location: Inside the tent at the Mogan Mountain campsite
start_state.mood: Energetic, excited from the morning coffee.

end_state.location: Inside the tent at the Mogan Mountain campsite
end_state.mood: Body is extremely tired but willpower is strong, with an intense sense of urgency about fitness

state.daily_exercise: Weighted hiking about 8 kilometers, with a total elevation gain of 600 meters

2025-05.daily_overview: Lei Mingxuan broke camp and returned to Shanghai. In the afternoon, while organizing his gear, he was inspired to write family stories. After listening to his staff's report, he delegated more authority. In the evening, he had dinner with his family to recover his strength.

events.name: Break camp and head back
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., after a simple breakfast at the campsite (oatmeal and coffee), Lei Mingxuan took down the tent, packed up all the trash, and drove away from Mogan Mountain at 10:30. The return trip was smooth, and he arrived at his home in Pudong, Shanghai at 12:30 p.m.

events.name: Organizing equipment triggered writing inspiration.
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan hung the wet clothes and tent on the balcony to dry and washed his hiking shoes. While organizing his backpack, the scene stirred his emotions, connecting to his plan for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan and his parents' generation's early struggles to make their way from a Pudong longtang. Inspiration struck. He immediately created a new folder, "Century of the Longtang," in his Notes app, initially listing a chapter outline centered on the changes of three generations, and flagged historical details that needed to be verified with his mother, deciding to make it a long-term writing project.

events.name: Listened to the staff report and gave authorization.
events.description: In the evening, after Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store, Xiao Lin proactively reported the entire process and outcome of handling a customer complaint. Lei Mingxuan was very satisfied with Xiao Lin's adaptability and communication skills, and felt that Xiao Lin was now capable of handling things independently. On the spot, he decided to further delegate authority for return approval and small-amount compensation, and they agreed to hold a weekly communication meeting to improve Xiao Lin's management capabilities.

events.name: Family dinner and recovery
events.description: In the evening, his mother Wang Xiuying specially made Shanghai-style braised pork belly and yanduxian (preserved pork and bamboo shoot soup) to help her son regain his strength. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan briefly shared his camping experience at Mogan Mountain with his parents. His father Lei Jianguo reminded him to pay attention to safety, while his mother worried about his leg pain. Lei Mingxuan felt the warmth of family and went to bed early that night to recover his strength.

start_state.location: Inside the tent at the Mogan Mountain campsite
start_state.mood: Sore muscles but a cheerful mood

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Physically tired but full of inspiration, with a clear plan for the future.

In the evening, he unexpectedly won a hidden-edition blind box and shared the surprise to his Moments, while also starting strict food diary logging — his life entered a healthy transformation.

events.name: Create a physical fitness enhancement plan
events.description: In the morning, based on the physical shortcomings exposed by the Moganshan trip, Lei Mingxuan refined his weekly fitness plan at home: three morning runs of 5 km each per week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) and two core strength training sessions (Tuesday, Thursday). He checked the wear on his old running shoes and decided to buy new gear.

events.name: Purchased sports gear.
events.description: During his lunch break, Lei Mingxuan went to Decathlon (Pudong flagship store) and selected a pair of cushioned running shoes, a quick-dry sports T-shirt, and shorts. After trying them on, he was satisfied and bought them, preparing himself for morning runs.

events.name: Got the hidden Pop Mart figurine.
events.description: After closing the store in the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan stopped by the Pop Mart store in the Century Avenue commercial area and bought two blind boxes from a new series. While unboxing them in the store's rest area, he unexpectedly got the hidden figure 'Mountain Stream Hermit.' After checking repeatedly, he was delighted.

events.name: Share the joy and display the collection.
events.description: Lei Mingxuan immediately used his phone to take close-up shots of the hidden figurine from multiple angles and uploaded them to the "Trendy Toy Collectors Circle" WeChat group, sharing the joy of getting the hidden item. In the group, collectors such as Lin Jing and Gao Yuan liked and congratulated him, creating a lively atmosphere. After returning home, he specially adjusted the lighting in the display cabinet and placed the hidden figurine in the most conspicuous spot.

events.name: Start meal logging.
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan recorded his three meals in detail on the Mint Health app and planned a light diet going forward: reduce red meat, oil, and salt, and add more vegetables and chicken breast. He discussed this week's menu adjustments with his mother, who supported it and agreed to cooperate.

His healthy eating plan also continued to progress.

events.name: Organizing the store's monthly data
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan organized the May sales report, inventory list, and employee attendance at Store A-208, preparing for the monthly meeting with Xiao Lin in the afternoon. He also noticed that today was the store's fifth anniversary, and felt quite emotional.

events.name: Delegate authority to store staff and establish a weekly meeting system.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan held the monthly summary meeting with Lin Xiao (Xiao Lin). He first affirmed Lin Xiao's excellent handling of customer complaints, then formally delegated to him the authority for daily scheduling, customer complaint handling, and part of the stock receiving and inspection. They also agreed to hold a 15-minute communication meeting every Tuesday afternoon. The two also reviewed photos from the store's opening together; the atmosphere was harmonious.

events.name: Created a budget for the Western Sichuan road trip
events.description: Back home in the evening, Lei Mingxuan opened Excel in his study and created a new workbook, listing item by item the estimated expenses for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan: car rental 8,000 yuan, fuel 3,000 yuan, accommodation 6,000 yuan, meals 4,000 yuan, tickets 2,000 yuan, plus an emergency reserve of 2,000 yuan, totaling about 25,000 yuan. He attached the basis for estimating each expense.

events.name: Discussing the trip with my father and politely declining his financial support
events.description: Lei Mingxuan took the budget sheet to the living room and explained his western Sichuan self-driving trip plan to his father. After reading it, his father offered to sponsor 5,000 yuan. Lei Mingxuan thanked his father for his kindness but said he could cover it himself and would consider accepting it if he went over budget. The two also discussed travel safety and equipment.

events.name: Set up a dedicated travel savings fund.
events.description: After talking with his father, Lei Mingxuan returned to the study, took a rarely used bank card out of the drawer, and added a “Western Sichuan Special Savings Tracker” in Excel, deciding to withdraw 3,000 yuan from the store's profits on the 5th of each month and deposit it into that card as a 12-month forced savings plan. He also recorded this expense in the expense-tracking app.

events.name: Showed his father the techwear results and received his support.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took out his phone to show outdoor techwear styling cases and the store's recent sales data, explaining the market for this style among young people. Although his father did not completely understand fashion, seeing his son's planning and execution, he said, 'As long as you have a plan, I won't hold you back.' The father-son relationship became more harmonious.

events.name: Healthy diet execution
events.description: Stuck to a light diet all day: boiled eggs and whole wheat bread for breakfast, homemade chicken breast salad for lunch, and steamed pumpkin and mushroom soup made by his mother for dinner. Lei Mingxuan logged and drank 2 liters of water in the app and felt his body gradually adapting.

After the match, Qin Lang's e-commerce advice triggered his determination to open an online branch. In the afternoon he practiced climbing with Zhao Min, and in the evening he had a family dinner and further thought about store upgrades. Life was fulfilling and full of turning points.

events.name: Shanghai-Hangzhou Billiards Friendly Match and Coffee Sharing

His father was cautious but supported exploring it, and his mother reminded him not to wear himself out. Lei Mingxuan felt that his family was his solid backing.

2025-12.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, Lei Mingxuan kept up his Japanese study during his commute. In the morning, he handled a negative-review crisis at the shop; in the afternoon, he activated his annual gym membership, completed a fitness assessment, and drew up a systematic workout plan. In the evening, he sorted out a camping music equipment list and discussed ukulele options with his cousin Shen Jie. Late at night, he also set Japanese learning goals for December. The day was packed and action-oriented, kicking off multiple goals for the whole month of December.

events.name: Evidence collection and appeal for malicious negative reviews.
events.description: On the afternoon of December 1, Lei Mingxuan was browsing Xiaohongshu in his own clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, when he noticed a malicious negative review suspected to be from a competitor, falsely accusing his products of poor quality and inflated prices. He suppressed his anger and immediately took screenshots of the review, the user's profile page, and the posting time, saving them as evidence for a later appeal. That evening, after completing the screenshot evidence collection in the store, he submitted an appeal through Xiaohongshu's official platform channel, asking the platform to verify and remove the false review. Afterwards, he published a sincere, positive response on his personal WeChat Moments and in the store's customer group, explaining the facts in detail and thanking loyal customers for their trust. Regular customers Qian Duoduo, Feng Xiaoyu, and Shen Jie saw it and proactively reposted it in support, helping to clarify the situation within their own social circles.

events.name: Gym annual pass activation and fitness assessment
events.description: On the morning of December 1, Lei Mingxuan went to his usual fitness center in Pudong New Area, activated his annual membership that had been temporarily suspended, and used professional equipment to measure body data such as body fat percentage, obtaining specific values including weight 80.5kg, body fat percentage 27.0%, and muscle mass as the baseline for the new training cycle. He then completed his first adaptive training session under the coach's guidance, including 15 minutes of brisk walking on the treadmill and familiarizing himself with light weights, marking the official start of his December fitness plan.

events.name: Making a December Japanese study plan
events.description: During his lunch break, Lei Mingxuan formulated a systematic Japanese study plan for December based on the app's learning progress and his own schedule, including the number of study days per week, content modules (the gojuon chart, shopping phrases, numbers, etc.), and expected goals, preparing for next year's purchasing trip to Japan. The plan emphasizes using commute time and fragmented time to study 20–30 minutes every day.

events.name: Organizing the camping and music equipment checklist and discussing it with my cousin
events.description: On the evening of December 1, based on recommendations from group friends and Taobao search results, Lei Mingxuan compiled a 'Camping Music Gear Wishlist' in his phone's memo app, including a KAKA ukulele (model MAD-106), a JBL Flip6 speaker, a set of outdoor folding chairs, and a storage bag. He sent a screenshot of the list to his cousin Shen Jie and asked her for suggestions on ukulele styles. Shen Jie replied, recommending another cost-effective brand, Tom. The two discussed it on WeChat until late at night, and finally decided to buy a basic ukulele first and start practicing.

events.description: Because his lower right wisdom tooth had been repeatedly inflamed and painful for a week, Lei Mingxuan made an appointment by phone for tooth extraction at a dental clinic in Pudong New Area. The surgery was scheduled for the afternoon of December 5, 2025, and the pre-operative precautions (such as fasting requirements and stopping certain medications) were confirmed. In the evening, when he mentioned the extraction to his mother, she comforted him and told him not to be nervous.

During the afternoon lunch break, he used paper teaching materials in the store's rest area to practice price-question sentence patterns from basic shopping phrases, completing his daily study check-in of about 20 minutes. 2025-12.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lei Mingxuan and three others headed to the countryside, where they set up camp in nature, had a barbecue, chatted, and tested new gear, with their friendship warming by the campfire. Lei Mingxuan even remembered to keep up his fitness routine with bodyweight exercises.

events.name: Morning meditation at the campsite
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning before departing, Lei Mingxuan did a 16-minute meditation at home. Although the year-end inventory pressure had reached a new peak, he especially used 5 minutes for a body scan, relaxing tense muscles one by one from head to toe. When it was over, he clearly felt his shoulders and neck relaxed, and his mindset was more composed.

events.name: Drive to the campsite and set up camp
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan drove his own car carrying Zhang Wei, Shen Jie, and Li Na, setting off from Zhangyang Road toward the campsite at Pudong New Area Country Park. Along the way, upbeat music played and the four chatted in anticipation. After arriving at 10:30, they divided the work: Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei set up two tents and a canopy, while Shen Jie and Li Na laid out ground mats, arranged folding tables and chairs, and sorted the food. By noon, the campsite was ready, and the four ate the sandwiches and fruit they had brought for lunch.

events.name: Alternative training at the campsite
events.description: During afternoon free time, Lei Mingxuan changed into sportswear and trained at the campsite using natural conditions: 3 sets of bodyweight squats (20 reps each), 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps each), then a 3-km off-road trail run along the forest path (about 20 minutes) as a substitute for gym equipment. Zhang Wei joked that he was pushing himself too hard, and Lei Mingxuan laughed and said he couldn't let his fitness plan be interrupted. After training, he took a quick rinse at the camp and felt refreshed.

events.name: Camp barbecue dinner and coffee experience.
events.description: In the evening, the four of them started a barbecue dinner. Lei Mingxuan was in charge of lighting the fire and grilling the meat, Zhang Wei helped with seasonings, and Shen Jie and Li Na made a vegetable salad and a fruit platter. The dinner was hearty and everyone enjoyed it. During the meal, Shen Jie took out her newly purchased pour-over coffee kettle to show everyone. Li Na was very interested, and they agreed to try brewing coffee early the next morning. After dinner, the four sat around the campfire chatting, recalling childhood stories and sharing recent life and work updates. Zhang Wei mentioned that he had developed an initial interest in camping, and Li Na remarked how wonderful it was to be so close to nature again after so many years. After 10 p.m., they each returned to their tents to rest.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lei Mingxuan returned from camping. While tidying up at home, he unexpectedly found his mother's diary, which triggered a profound conversation and brought family affection and understanding to a new level. At the same time, he reviewed the year's rock climbing and health progress and gained many insights.

events.name: Morning pour-over coffee and farewell to the campsite
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the four of them got up at the campsite. Shen Jie brought out the coffee pot and freshly ground coffee, and Li Na, under guidance, completed the first pour-over coffee of her life, successfully making coffee for four. Everyone sat together in the morning light with hot coffee, chatting and enjoying the scenery around the campsite. Lei Mingxuan captured the warm moment with his phone and posted the photo with the caption "The outdoors tastes better with a group" to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group and to Moments. At 9 a.m., the four took down the tent, cleaned up the trash, and sorted and packed the remaining food. At 10, Lei Mingxuan drove back to the city, arriving at Zhangyang Road at 12:30.

events.name: Home tidying and discovering mother's diary
events.description: In the afternoon, while organizing his camping gear and bedroom at home, Lei Mingxuan found an old camphor wood chest that had not been carefully examined during the previous big cleaning. After opening it, he found an old diary with his mother Wang Xiuying's name on the cover. Realizing this was his mother's personal item from her younger days, he read it with respect and curiosity. The diary recorded her inner struggles and efforts as she left Nantong, Jiangsu, to marry into Shanghai, facing an unfamiliar environment, family responsibilities, and the process of adapting to a new life. Between the lines were loneliness, hard work, and devotion to the family, which deeply moved him.

events.name: A deep heartfelt talk with my mother
events.description: Lei Mingxuan walked into the living room with his diary in hand, stood before his mother, and sincerely expressed his understanding and deep gratitude to her. His mother was a little surprised at first, then sat down and recounted her experiences from back then in detail, telling how she blended his father's rigor with her own patience into the family, and how proud she was of her son's growth. Lei Mingxuan shared his feelings from reading and his respect, and promised to incorporate these precious memories into his new novel. The mother-son relationship became even closer, and tears welled up in his mother's eyes.

events.name: Recording inspiration and planning a new chapter of the novel.
events.description: After the conversation, Lei Mingxuan sat down at the computer, wrote down this experience and reflections, and decided to adapt his mother's true story into the new novel he was drafting on the theme of family affection, in order to commemorate and pass on family memories. He wrote an outline of the first draft, tentatively titled The Nantong Bride.

events.name: Annual rock climbing data review and goals
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan opened the rock climbing logging app to review his yearly data: 23 total sessions, highest difficulty V3, and a monthly distribution chart. As he scrolled through the data, he reflected: in spring he had kept up a weekly session; in summer it decreased because of the store's peak season; in autumn he resumed but didn't break through the V3 bottleneck. Although he felt he had neglected it a bit, he had stuck with it overall. He was satisfied with the foundation but noticed that his core strength needed improvement. Based on the review, he decided to focus on training after returning from the western Sichuan road trip, aiming for V4. He then wrote in his memo: “After I return from western Sichuan next year, I'll focus on strength training and aim to conquer V4!” He also took a screenshot of his annual summary and shared it in the rock climbing enthusiasts' WeChat group.

events.name: Cat companionship and reflections
events.description: In the evening, as Lei Mingxuan sat on the edge of the bed flipping through his diary, his cat Afu quietly jumped onto his lap and curled up. He gently stroked Afu's back, thinking about its silent companionship over the past year—from greeting him when he came home after closing the store, to snuggling with him during late-night solitude. He realized that his daily life with Afu had taught him patience and responsibility, and made him cherish the warmth brought by this family member.

events.name: Meditation and health reflection log
events.description: He continued meditating before leaving in the morning and again in the evening, with a 20-minute loving-kindness meditation in the morning to send blessings to his family and himself. He noticed that recently the number of nighttime awakenings had decreased significantly and sleep was deeper, making him even more convinced of the benefits of meditation. In the afternoon, he recorded how he felt about his health: after following the healthy meal plan for 8 consecutive days, he was full of energy, no longer needed coffee to stay alert in the afternoon, and his mother also said he looked better.

events.name: Watching an immersive theater performance.

events.name: Post-performance exchange

events.name: Going home to record inspiration
events.description: After 22:30, he said goodbye to Shen Jie at the theater entrance (Shen Jie took a taxi back to Jing'an District), and Lei Mingxuan took the last metro home; he arrived home at around 23:30, exchanged photos with Shen Jie on WeChat, and recorded inspiration from the event in his diary, accumulating material for the historical novel he was conceiving.

events.name: Contact illustrator resources.
events.description: During a break at the shop in the morning, Lei Mingxuan contacted Liu Yang, a high school classmate now living in Shenzhen, via WeChat, and asked whether he could recommend a freelance illustrator suitable for historical novel illustrations. Liu Yang immediately thought of Chen Yu, whose style matched, sent Chen Yu's WeChat contact to Lei Mingxuan, and briefly introduced the features of Chen Yu's work. The two agreed to directly coordinate the details later.

events.name: In-depth exchange in the novel group

He shared his reading notes from The Costumes of the Great Ming and his portrayal techniques for the clothing of ordinary alley residents in his novel writing, gaining recognition from group members and further strengthening his active image in the group.

events.name: Daily store operations and display adjustments.
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan and store clerk Xiao Lin rearranged the display in the ground-floor mountain-style techwear area, combining the newly arrived outdoor vests with designer toy blind boxes, and checked the cleanliness of the equipment in the coffee experience area. During that time, they also received several customers who came to buy autumn coats.

events.name: Midday run training and knee recovery
events.description: At 2 p.m., taking advantage of the slow business period in the store, Lei Mingxuan changed into sportswear and headed to the Pudong Riverside Promenade for a 5 km run. Because his right knee still had slight discomfort, he deliberately slowed down, with a pace of about 6:10 per kilometer, and finished in nearly 31 minutes. After the run, he carefully applied ice to his knee by the trail and stretched thoroughly on a bench, feeling that his recovery was going well. He took a screenshot of the running route and posted it to his WeChat Moments with the caption, "Autumn riverside, never stop moving."

events.name: Packing for the Moganshan retreat
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Lei Mingxuan, according to the list sent by his cousin Shen Jie, took out yoga clothes, quick-dry clothing, hiking shoes and other gear from the wardrobe, and packed toiletries and common medications. His mother Wang Xiuying reminded him to pay attention to safety, while his father briefly asked about the itinerary. After finishing packing, he put the backpack at the entrance, ready for departure the next day.

events.name: Reading before bed and recording inspiration
events.description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, read the chapter on scene design from Robert McKee's Story, and jotted down a few alley scene details in his phone memo that could be used in his novel. Because he was both curious and a little excited about the meditation retreat, he didn't turn off the light and fall asleep until 12:15 a.m.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Friday, Lei Mingxuan and his younger cousin Shen Jie went to the Moganshan retreat. From being somewhat resistant at first, he gradually came around. During a silent walking meditation, he unexpectedly met Chen Xiao, a botanical dye designer, which brought new inspiration to his clothing design. Going to bed early in the mountains gave him a taste of the regular routine he had long missed.

events.name: Set off for Mogan Mountain
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan got up, washed up, ate a simple breakfast prepared by his mother, then drove his own car to Shen Jie's place to pick her up. The two set off from Puxi at 8:00 sharp, drove for about 2.5 hours via the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, made a brief stop at Fengjing Service Area along the way, and arrived smoothly at the Moganshan Retreat Center parking lot at 10:30 a.m.

events.name: Check-in and camp opening ceremony
events.description: After arriving, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie checked in at the front desk and received their room cards and activity handbook. After a brief rest, the two attended the opening ceremony of the retreat camp. The instructor gently introduced the two-day schedule: morning meditation, yin yoga, vegetarian meals, and silent walking. At first Lei Mingxuan felt these activities did not match his extroverted personality and felt somewhat resistant inside.

events.name: First yin yoga class
events.description: At 2 p.m., encouraged by Shen Jie, Lei Mingxuan changed into yoga clothes and entered the yoga studio beside the bamboo grove for his first yin yoga class. Guided by the instructor, he tried to relax his body through slow stretching and deep breathing. Although his movements were still stiff, the feeling of release afterward changed his opinion of the class somewhat, and also made him realize that he had been lacking stretching after his usual workouts.

events.name: Enjoy a vegetarian dinner.
events.description: After class, Lei Mingxuan went to the dining hall with Shen Jie and the other students in the group. The retreat center had prepared a colorful vegetarian buffet, with roasted pumpkin, quinoa salad, mushroom soup, and more. Lei Mingxuan discovered for the first time that vegetarian food could be so delicious and ate a full plate.

events.name: Silent walking and an unexpected acquaintance
events.description: At 7 p.m., the retreat organized all participants to do a 30-minute silent walk along the mountain path in the dusk. After the walk, during free exchange in the rest area, Lei Mingxuan noticed a participant wearing a unique indigo-dyed cotton-linen shirt and took the initiative to strike up a conversation. The other person was a designer named Chen Xiao who worked with plant dyeing techniques. The two had an in-depth discussion on the combination of traditional plant dyeing methods and modern fashion design, and exchanged WeChat contacts.

events.name: Recording inspiration and going to bed early
events.description: After returning to his room, Lei Mingxuan used his phone's memo app to record the key information from his conversation with Chen Xiao and wrote down the initial idea of 'plant dyeing + mountain-style techwear.' With the quiet mountain surroundings and a full day of activity, he quickly felt sleepy. After a quick wash, he was sound asleep by 10 p.m.

start_state.mood: Excited before departure, with some doubts about the meditation retreat.

end_state.location: Room at Mogan Mountain Retreat Center
end_state.mood: Unexpectedly felt calm and felt anticipation for tomorrow's event

2025-10.daily_overview: Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan experienced morning meditation and walking meditation at Mogan Mountain, unexpectedly gaining a sense of calm. He used the time before breakfast to complete the first coordination with illustrator Chen Yu. In the afternoon, after checking out and returning to Shanghai, he quickly returned to his role and carefully prepared the gifts and vehicle for the next day's wedding.

events.name: Morning meditation and walking meditation.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lei Mingxuan sat on the misty lawn with his instructor and the participants, meditating for 20 minutes. Then, led by the instructor, they practiced walking meditation, slowly walking along the dew-covered flagstone path. In that profound stillness, he unexpectedly felt a long-lost inner peace and gained a whole new understanding of the experience.

events.name: Coordinate online with the illustrator
events.description: Using the gap between meditation and breakfast, Lei Mingxuan had his first meeting with illustrator Chen Yu via WeChat video in a quiet corner of the retreat center's tearoom. He showed her an excerpt describing the alleyway scene in the novel. Chen Yu quickly understood that nostalgic Shanghai-style aesthetic and promised to first try sketching a concept drawing. Lei Mingxuan approved the initial direction.

events.name: Second yin yoga class.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan stepped into the yoga studio again. Compared with yesterday, he was more accustomed to the slow pace. With the instructor's assistance, he completed several sets of spinal twists and hip-opening movements. His body felt as if it had been opened up again, and the slight discomfort in his knees was further improved by the gentle stretching.

events.name: Three people talk about cooperation at a tea house
events.description: After the yoga class, while Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie were resting in the tea room of the meditation center, they met plant-dye designer Chen Xiao again. The three sat together for tea and further discussed the possibility of applying plant-dye craftsmanship to ready-to-wear clothing. Chen Xiao showed a few photos of her works, and Lei Mingxuan shared his experience of running a store. The atmosphere was harmonious.

events.name: Checkout and return trip.
events.description: After enjoying their last vegetarian lunch at the restaurant, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie packed up and checked out. At 1 p.m., they drove back to Shanghai, stopping at the Jiaxing Service Area to refuel and buy coffee. On the way, they shared their thoughts on the retreat. Lei Mingxuan admitted it had been a special experience and that he might try it again. They arrived in Shanghai around 4 p.m. After dropping Shen Jie off at her home, he returned to his home in Pudong.

events.name: Preparing the wedding gift and checking the vehicle
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan wrapped the limited-edition trendy toy blind box he had carefully chosen for his college friend Wang Lei and included a handwritten card. He then went downstairs to check the tire pressure, engine oil, and windshield washer fluid of his car, and finally set the navigation to ensure a smooth and worry-free self-drive to Hangzhou the next day. Lying in his own bed, he felt a little nostalgic for the quiet of the mountains, but soon fell asleep.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lei Mingxuan drove to Hangzhou to attend the wedding of his college friend Wang Lei and reunited with old classmates. During the banquet, an exchange with Zhao Min gave birth to the idea for a pop-up exhibition. After returning to Shanghai late at night, he was still in high spirits and contacted the plant-dye designer Chen Xiao, but the joy and exhaustion of the wedding made him fall asleep almost as soon as his head hit the pillow.

events.name: Set out alone in the early morning
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan was woken up by his alarm clock. After a quick wash, he put on the casually tailored suit he had ironed in advance, picked up the gift for Wang Lei, and, amid his parents' 'be careful on the road' reminders, drove his private car alone along the Shanghai-Hangzhou Expressway to Hangzhou.

events.name: Arrived at the wedding hotel
events.description: At about 10 a.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived at the wedding hotel by West Lake. At the sign-in table, he met the groom Wang Lei and several early-arriving college classmates, including Zhao Min. Everyone greeted each other warmly and took photos. Lei Mingxuan gave Wang Lei the designer toy gift, and the groom was overjoyed, exclaiming, 'You really understand me!'

events.name: Attend the wedding ceremony and banquet.
events.description: At noon, the wedding ceremony was held on the lawn, and Lei Mingxuan and his former classmates witnessed the couple exchange vows. Later, in the banquet hall, everyone sat around a table, talked over drinks, and recalled funny memories from college—playing basketball together and pulling all-nighters on marketing plans. The wedding banquet had a rich spread, and although Lei Mingxuan reminded himself to be careful, he still ate a bit too much braised pork belly and dessert.

events.name: New project ideas sparked during the meal.
events.description: In the latter part of the wedding banquet, Zhao Min mentioned that her exhibition company was recently planning a series of mall pop-up events and was looking for local streetwear brands to cooperate with. Lei Mingxuan immediately thought of his store's "urban techwear" style, and the two hit it off immediately. They chatted enthusiastically about the possibility of a joint pop-up and agreed to discuss the specific plan in detail after returning to Shanghai.

events.name: Returning to Shanghai late at night and contacting the designer
events.description: At a little past 10 p.m., Lei Mingxuan said goodbye to his classmates and drove back to Shanghai alone. On the late-night Shanghai-Hangzhou Expressway, there were few cars; he turned on some soft jazz and drove steadily, arriving safely at his home in Pudong around 12:30 a.m. Lying in bed, he tossed and turned, unable to sleep, his mind still lingering on the topics from the wedding and the chance encounter at Mogan Mountain. He just picked up his phone and sent a WeChat message to Chen Xiao, expressing his interest in introducing Chen Xiao's plant-dyeing craft into his own clothing products and asking whether there were any samples he could look at. Chen Xiao replied quickly, and the two agreed to find time next week to talk in detail. Only then did he put down his phone and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Refreshed, looking forward to seeing old friends

2025-10.daily_overview: On Monday, Lei Mingxuan celebrated his 31st birthday. During the day he received blessings on Moments, and in the evening he had a warm dinner with his parents. The first draft sent by illustrator Chen Yu became the best birthday gift, and the lively wedding memories also made him briefly think about relationships, but he quickly decided to focus on his career first. Before bed, he was excited about his birthday and had some trouble falling asleep.

events.name: Sharing wedding photos on Moments
events.description: After arriving at the shop in the morning, Lei Mingxuan used a lull at the cash register to pick a few wedding-site photos from his phone—group photos with Wang Lei, Zhao Min, and others—wrote a sincere blessing, and posted it to his WeChat Moments. He soon received dozens of likes and comments.

events.name: Replying to greetings and comments
events.description: Throughout the day, Lei Mingxuan opened WeChat many times and replied to friends' comments one by one. His college classmate Zhao Min commented under a photo, 'I'll drop by your shop for coffee one of these days.' He immediately replied, 'Always welcome; come have a chat about the pop-up.' He mentally noted the appointment. His billiards buddies Han Dong and Xie Fei also sent birthday wishes.

events.name: Warm family birthday celebration
events.description: After closing the store in the evening, Lei Mingxuan rushed home. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared a table full of good dishes, specially making his favorite Shanghai-style braised pork and a bowl of longevity noodles. His father, Lei Jianguo, gave him a set of professional outdoor knee pads and ankle guards, saying, 'I've been getting these ready for your Western Sichuan road trip.' Lei Mingxuan felt a warmth in his heart, and the whole family raised their glasses together in a warm atmosphere.

events.name: Received the initial illustration draft.
events.description: After dinner, back in his room, Lei Mingxuan saw the illustration draft Chen Yu had sent via WeChat. The details of the alleyway and the characters' clothing in the picture precisely captured the atmosphere he had wanted. His face showed unmistakable surprise and delight. He immediately replied to Chen Yu to express his appreciation and joked that this was the best birthday gift this year. He then began to think about whether he could create co-branded merchandise between the novel's characters and the clothing store in the future.

events.name: Late-night thoughts and staying up late
events.description: Lying in bed, with the liveliness of Moments and the joyful atmosphere of the wedding intertwined, Lei Mingxuan briefly imagined his own relationship status. But soon, thinking that the clothing store upgrade plan and the Western Sichuan self-driving trip goal were still ahead, he firmly held on to the idea of building a career before starting a family, and set aside thoughts of romance. His mind churned until he finally dozed off at nearly 1 a.m.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lei Mingxuan refocused on his store and his novel. He completed his strength training on time in the early morning, adding energy to a busy day. He dealt with backlogged orders, personally shot promotional photos for new products, and in the evening calmly continued writing his novel and finalized revision details with the illustrator. The whole day was busy and fulfilling.

events.name: Morning strength training
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was woken by the alarm, did a brief warm-up, then laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom at home and followed the fitness app's guidance for a 30-minute systematic strength training session, including bodyweight squats, dumbbell presses, curls, and core exercises. When finished, he was lightly sweating and felt refreshed, setting a positive tone for Tuesday.

events.name: Handling Backlogged Store Matters
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan's first task was checking the inventory system. He found that several trendy toy blind boxes were low in stock and immediately placed a restocking order in the system. Then he called fabric supplier Zhou Tao to confirm that the second batch of autumn techwear fabric would arrive next Wednesday.

events.name: Lunch chat about business
events.description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan and store clerk Xiao Lin ate malatang at the food court on the basement level of the mall. While eating, they discussed the decline in customer traffic after the National Day holiday. Xiao Lin suggested holding a points redemption event for members. Lei Mingxuan thought it was feasible and asked her to draft a plan.

events.name: Photographing new products in person
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan had a sudden idea and decided to shoot a set of promotional photos for the store's mountain-style techwear clothing. He changed into new multi-pocket cargo pants and a quick-dry shirt, set up a backdrop cloth in a corner of the store, and took dozens of photos at different angles with his new phone. After selecting a few satisfactory ones, he did simple retouching and prepared to send them to Qian Duoduo for Xiaohongshu promotion.

events.name: Completed the first draft of the novel's second chapter.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in the study and continued writing the second chapter of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane. Combining his experiences at Moganshan a few days earlier, he added an inner monologue for the protagonist, writing nearly three thousand characters. When he finished, he felt a sense of relief throughout his body. He then took out his voice recorder, played back the fragment of his chat with Aunt Zhu from a few days ago, and marked several usable details.

events.name: Finalized the revision direction with the illustrator
events.description: Before going to bed, Lei Mingxuan opened the draft Chen Yu had sent on his tablet, circled two places he wanted to fine-tune (the character's expression and the background tone), and explained them via a WeChat voice message. Chen Yu quickly replied that the revised draft would be ready tomorrow. Lei Mingxuan turned off the light at 11:30 and rested, saving his energy for the next day.

2025-10.daily_overview: Wednesday was extremely crucial for Lei Mingxuan. In the afternoon, he finalized the cooperation for the December pop-up exhibition with Zhao Min. In the evening, he persisted with high-intensity interval training. At night, he also asked for hardcore knowledge about self-driving in western Sichuan. Inspired by Lao Zhou, he formulated a physical training plan that night and made up his mind to adjust his diet, starting a new chapter of healthy living.

events.name: Organize monthly sales data
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan opened his computer in the office area behind the store, pulled up the sales reports for September and early October, and checked the sales amount, inventory turnover days, and cash flow details by category one by one. He also calculated the rent due in the fourth quarter and the estimated amount for winter stocking, preparing the data materials for the afternoon business analysis meeting.

events.name: Met with Zhao Min to finalize the pop-up exhibition
events.description: At 2 p.m., Zhao Min arrived at the store as agreed. The two sat in the coffee area, and Zhao Min showed several past cases from the exhibition company, including pop-up stores in the mall atrium and themed markets. Combining this with Lei Mingxuan's store's “urban techwear” style, the two reached an agreement after more than an hour of discussion: they planned to team up with a trendy illustrator in December to hold an “Urban Techwear · Lane Memory” pop-up exhibition in the mall atrium. Zhao Min would be responsible for planning resources, and Lei Mingxuan would handle the samples and liaison with the illustrator. After the discussion, Zhao Min tried on clothes in the store and readily bought a new techwear vest, supporting her old classmate with action. The two agreed to meet next Wednesday (October 29) afternoon at Zhao Min's company to look at past cases on site.

events.name: Evening high-intensity interval training at home.
events.description: After seeing off Zhao Min, Lei Mingxuan closed the store early at 5:30 p.m. and went home. He changed into a sports tank top and shorts, opened the fitness app in the living room, and did a HIIT workout: jumping jacks, high knees, burpees, and more, followed by full-body stretching. The whole routine took about an hour; he was drenched in sweat, and even the slight discomfort in his right knee had almost disappeared thanks to the thorough stretching.

events.name: Treated Lao Zhou to dinner to get advice on a self-drive trip in western Sichuan.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan went to an authentic Benbang cuisine restaurant in Pudong and treated Lao Zhou, a seasoned outdoor enthusiast, to dinner. During the meal, he asked in detail about route planning for a self-driving trip in western Sichuan, how to handle altitude sickness, and the list of essential supplies. Lao Zhou was experienced and repeatedly stressed that physical stamina is the foundation, suggesting that he start running 5 kilometers at least three times a week from now on. Lei Mingxuan carefully noted the key points in his phone's memo app and was deeply inspired.

events.name: Create a running plan and adjust diet.
events.description: After dinner, it was almost 9:30 when he got home. Still feeling motivated, Lei Mingxuan wrote the plan 'Run 5 km every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday morning' on the whiteboard in his study and set a phone alarm as a reminder. Then he found his mother, Wang Xiuying, and seriously explained his determination to take a self-driving trip to western Sichuan and his health goals, asking her to help adjust the family diet. His mother agreed at once, saying she would start cooking low-salt, low-oil dishes right away. Lei Mingxuan then went downstairs, bought a large bag of healthy ingredients at FamilyMart—chicken breast, broccoli, blueberries, whole wheat bread, and more—and cleaned up the snacks on the living room coffee table. He went to bed with the new plan.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Thursday, Lei Mingxuan officially started his healthy eating routine. In the early morning he completed his regular strength training, and during the day he set up a health corner in the store to motivate himself. With his mother's support, his three meals became low-salt and low-oil. By the end of the day, although he had resisted the temptation of takeout, the sense of accomplishment from self-discipline left him especially pleased.

events.name: Morning strength training
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan followed his Tuesday/Thursday training routine and did 30 minutes of strength training at home. Riding on the momentum of yesterday's change, he deliberately increased the dumbbell weight today, did several sets of weighted squats and shoulder presses, and sweat dripped onto the yoga mat. He felt great.

events.name: Daily store operations and the establishment of the "Health Corner"
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan's first task was to paste a handwritten '15-Day Healthy Eating Challenge' chart on the wall of the small rest area in the back warehouse, and he said to store clerk Xiao Lin with a smile, 'You should join in too.' Then he processed several online orders and personally put price tags on the newly arrived designer toy blind boxes.

events.name: Sticking strictly to a healthy breakfast
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Lei Mingxuan followed the previous night's plan and had unsweetened yogurt mixed with oats and blueberries for breakfast, along with a boiled egg. His mother watched him eat it all and nodded with satisfaction.

events.name: Healthy lunch and the temptation of takeout
events.description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan opened the lunchbox his mother had prepared for him: mixed grain rice, blanched shrimp, and stir-fried broccoli. He heated it up in the mall rest area and ate it. Meanwhile, his phone popped up a fried chicken delivery promotion. He glanced at it, turned off the screen, and quietly drank some water. He made sure to drink 2 liters of water throughout the day.

events.name: Encounter with regular customer Feng Xiaoyu
events.description: In the afternoon, Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer, came by the shop while on a business trip to Shanghai. Lei Mingxuan chatted about recent news while helping her choose a trench coat suitable for autumn. Feng Xiaoyu said he looked better, and Lei Mingxuan smiled and said, 'I've just started adjusting my diet.'

events.name: Evening family healthy meal and early bedtime
events.description: When he got home in the evening, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and a bowl of mushroom tofu soup. It was low in oil and salt, yet exceptionally fresh and delicious. Lei Mingxuan ate to his heart's content and kept praising his mother's cooking. His father Lei Jianguo also praised it, saying he supported his son's health plan. After dinner, instead of looking at his phone as usual, Lei Mingxuan washed up early and went to bed at 11 p.m.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Friday, Lei Mingxuan started his energetic day with a 5-kilometer morning run. He recorded a pour-over coffee tutorial video, adding to his Xiaohongshu content. In the evening, he watched a documentary to build up knowledge for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan, and he continued following a healthy diet. After his night run, he stretched thoroughly, and his knee showed no discomfort at all.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, as soon as the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes and jogged to Century Park, 2 kilometers from home. Along the outer running track, he completed a 5-kilometer run at a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. The morning breeze was cool and he felt in great shape. After the run, he did 10 minutes of full-body stretching on a bench, paying special attention to his thighs and iliotibial band. His right knee felt completely normal. After returning home, he took a hot shower and found that his weight had dropped to 80.9 kilograms.

events.name: Healthy breakfast and packed lunch.
events.description: After returning home, his mother had already prepared breakfast: a whole-wheat sandwich with scrambled egg and avocado, and a cup of freshly ground unsweetened soy milk. Lei Mingxuan put the lunch box his mother had also prepared (chicken breast salad with vinaigrette) into his backpack and left with it to go to the shop.

events.name: Discussed promotion data with Qian Duoduo.
events.description: During a slow moment at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan proactively sent a WeChat message to Qian Duoduo, asking about the exposure data of her latest outfit post on Xiaohongshu. The two chatted by voice for more than ten minutes. Qian Duoduo suggested tapping into the trending topic 'autumn camping' for exposure. Lei Mingxuan said he would consider shooting content in connection with the November camping festival.

events.name: Practice pour-over coffee and record a video.
events.description: In the afternoon, when there were not many customers, Lei Mingxuan practiced pour-over coffee in the store's coffee area. He used newly purchased single-origin beans, carefully controlled water temperature and flow, and brewed a pot of Yirgacheffe with bright fruit notes. Feeling the result was good, he set up a phone stand and recorded a 10-minute teaching short video, planning to edit and post it on Xiaohongshu.

events.name: Watching a documentary about the Sichuan-Tibet Highway in the evening
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan searched on the living room TV for a documentary about self-driving along the G318 Sichuan-Tibet Highway. Watching the magnificent snowy mountains and winding mountain roads, he was deeply stirred. While watching, he updated his equipment list on his phone's memo, adding snow chains and a portable oxygen cylinder. His father was also absorbed in watching, occasionally interjecting to ask about the route.

events.name: Sticking to healthy eating and stretching after evening runs.
events.description: For lunch he ate the chicken breast salad he had brought to the store, and for dinner his mother made steamed tofu and blanched choy sum. He drank more than 2 liters of water throughout the day. Before bed, Lei Mingxuan used a foam roller to relax all his muscles and did 5 minutes of yoga stretches. He felt his body getting lighter, and turned off the lights before 11 p.m.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lei Mingxuan and his younger cousin Shen Jie held an all-day business meeting and, under real-world pressure, made the important decision to postpone the upgrade of the brand collection store. In the evening, he joined the debate in the novel discussion group and planned the warm-up for the pop-up exhibition. Late at night after the busy day, he had some trouble sleeping because of excitement and a full schedule, but he replaced dessert with fruit salad and found new comfort in self-discipline.

events.name: Business analysis meeting with Shen Jie
events.description: At 9 a.m., Shen Jie came to the office area behind the store, and the two began the monthly business analysis. They went through the sales reports, cost structure, and cash flow statement one by one and found that although sales in the mountain-style techwear category were rising, winter stocking required a large amount of upfront cash, and together with the fourth-quarter mall rent increase, this created significant cash flow pressure.

events.name: Decision to postpone the brand upgrade
events.description: In the afternoon, based on the morning's analysis, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie specifically evaluated the originally planned multi-brand store upgrade scheduled for the end of 2025. The two carefully calculated the initial investments such as renovation, design, and first stocking, and agreed that if they forced the launch, it would likely cause stockouts and cash flow difficulties. Lei Mingxuan decisively made the call to postpone the upgrade target to the first quarter of 2026, and Shen Jie agreed.

events.name: Light-hearted conversation during the lunch break.
events.description: During a break in the analysis meeting, the two had a simple lunch at a newly opened Japanese ramen shop in the mall. Lei Mingxuan ordered a low-oil soy sauce ramen, while Shen Jie talked about a buyer project she had recently handled. The atmosphere was unusually relaxed.

events.name: Debate over plot conflicts in the novel group.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lei Mingxuan joined the third thematic discussion in the novel lovers' group on time. This session centered on "the choices historical figures face when confronted with moral dilemmas." He cited the example from *1587, A Year of No Significance*, and shared the psychological description method he was conceiving for the protagonist caught in a dilemma, which sparked heated discussion. He quickly jotted down a few quotable lines in his phone memo.

events.name: Deep dive into narrative theory
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan spent two hours rereading Story: Substance, Structure, Style, and the Principles of Screenwriting, focusing on plot structure design, and wrote nearly five pages of study notes in a notebook in neat handwriting.

events.name: Video conference to finalize the warm-up plan
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan, Qian Duoduo, and Shen Jie opened a WeChat video call to discuss the online warm-up plan for the pop-up exhibition. Qian Duoduo suggested posting outfit guides on Xiaohongshu, and Shen Jie recommended using industry WeChat groups to spread the electronic invitation. The three quickly settled on the content theme, posting schedule, and division of labor. After the call, Lei Mingxuan organized the meeting notes and sent them to the small group.

events.name: Making a healthy fruit salad and having a sleepless late night
events.description: After the video conference ended, Lei Mingxuan felt a little hungry, but instead of grabbing a snack, he went into the kitchen and made a fruit salad with blueberries, strawberries, yogurt, and a little honey. He brought it to his parents, who were watching TV in the living room, and they all praised it. He also enjoyed it himself. After lying down, his mind was still occupied with business decisions and details of the pop-up exhibition, and he didn't gradually calm down and fall asleep until 12:30 AM.

start_state.mood: Woke up feeling a little stressed, but ready to face it directly.

2025-10.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lei Mingxuan was busy with the weekend promotion at the store, but in the gaps he handled important financial and planning matters. The rent share arrived and was transferred into the Western Sichuan special fund; he officially updated the brand upgrade proposal to next February and had a preliminary discussion with the property management. After the afternoon promotion ended, he insisted on going home to complete strength training, and he stayed disciplined with healthy eating all day.

events.name: Weekend store promotion and teaser posts.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the store opened. Lei Mingxuan and Xiaolin put up the poster they had stayed up late to print—'Pop-up Exhibition Warm-up: 10% Off Autumn/Winter New Arrivals'—on the window. At the same time, Qian Duoduo published the first warm-up note on Xiaohongshu: 'A Shanghai clothing store owner's private outdoor styling guide,' which received quite a few likes. Lei Mingxuan replied to comments interactively and sent private messages to thank several friends who had reposted.

events.name: Rent share credited and asset consolidation
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan's mobile banking notified him that his father had transferred his share of this month's rent from two rental properties, 11,000 yuan, into his account. He then transferred the entire amount into a savings sub-account called the Greater Hengduan Plan as a dedicated fund for the Western Sichuan road trip.

events.name: Update the brand upgrade plan and contact the mall property management
events.description: During a break in the afternoon promotion, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and changed the start time in the “Brand Collection Store Upgrade Project Plan” from the end of 2025 to February 2026, and lowered the initial budget. Afterwards, he contacted Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, via WeChat, to say that the renovation filing application originally scheduled for the end of the year would be postponed, hoping to keep the existing storefront conditions until the first quarter of next year. Zheng Kai said he understood and would keep a record.

events.name: Finalize the campsite booking
events.description: After finishing the proposal, Lei Mingxuan struck while the iron was hot. He opened several campsite websites he had bookmarked, compared them, and finally chose an eco-camp near Dongtan on Chongming Island. He called the administrator, booked one campsite and a public activity area for November 22 to 23, and paid a 200 yuan deposit. Afterward, he sent a message in the family group: 'November camping festival, Chongming Island, let's go!' which drew likes from his parents.

events.name: Strength training after the promotion
events.description: At 5 p.m., the promotional event came to an end. Lei Mingxuan tidied up the store and went straight home. After a short rest, he unrolled a yoga mat and did a systematic strength training session: dumbbell squat presses, alternating curls, and farmer's walks, 3 sets each, plus core training—crunches, Russian twists, and plank variations. The whole session lasted about 50 minutes. After training, he stretched carefully and, while relaxing to music, used the memo on his phone to plan next week's workout frequency.

events.name: Maintained a healthy diet all day
events.description: For breakfast, worked with mother to make olive-oil fried eggs, steamed sweet potatoes, and cold dressed spinach. For lunch, heated up a homemade chicken breast and broccoli bento in the store microwave. For dinner, went home and enjoyed mother's steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and brown rice. Drank 2.2 liters of water throughout the day and refused junk food.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready for the busy Sunday

2025-10.daily_overview: On Monday, Lei Mingxuan began handling the knock-on effects of the delayed brand upgrade, coordinating order adjustments with suppliers, and in the evening frankly explained the reasons to his parents. Shen Jie also launched the online promotion. Healthy eating continued, and the afternoon roller-skating date with Song Jia brought back the long-missed joy of the outdoors.

events.name: Adjusting orders with the supplier
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan called Zhou Tao, a fabric supplier in Hangzhou, and told him that due to adjustments in store plans, a large order originally scheduled for the end of the year would need to be cut in half and postponed to the first quarter of next year. After negotiation, Zhou Tao agreed that the deposit already paid could be carried over to next year. Then Lei Mingxuan contacted Wu Fang, an accessory supplier in Guangzhou, via WeChat to postpone the accessory order to February next year, and Wu Fang readily agreed.

events.name: Daily store operations and online maintenance.
events.description: After dealing with the supplier, Lei Mingxuan checked the Xiaohongshu account backend and saw that Qian Duoduo's post was performing well, gaining a good number of new favorites. He struck while the iron was hot and updated the WeChat community's Moments, posting a nine-grid set of techwear outfit looks.

events.name: Roller skating and talking with Song Jia
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan suddenly received a WeChat message from Song Jia, who said the weather was nice and wanted to meet up in the evening to go roller skating along the riverside. Lei Mingxuan, realizing he hadn't skated in a long time, readily agreed. In the evening, he closed the store an hour early, went home to change into his roller skates, and met up with Song Jia on Pudong Riverside Avenue. The two skated along the river for over an hour, catching up while skating. Song Jia shared about a roller skating competition she had recently participated in, and Lei Mingxuan talked about his plan to visit western Sichuan. The evening breeze was gentle, and it was very pleasant.

events.name: Telling my parents honestly about the postponement decision
events.description: After returning home from rollerblading, Lei Mingxuan seriously explained the whole story behind the postponement of the multi-brand store upgrade plan to his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying at the dinner table, emphasizing that it was for steady operations and to avoid putting too much strain on the cash flow at the end of the year. His father nodded in agreement and said, 'Where there's life, there's hope'; his mother told him not to overwork himself. The whole family atmosphere was supportive.

events.name: Shen Jie launched online promotion and healthy eating
events.description: In the evening, Shen Jie used her contacts to send the electronic invitation for Lei Mingxuan's store to five fashion buyer WeChat groups, along with a recommendation. At the same time, she posted a photo-text post on her Moments introducing the highlights of the pop-up exhibition and the techwear features of 'Xiafei Ji'. Lei Mingxuan thanked her in the comments and invited friends to share. His meals for the day remained consistent: breakfast was quinoa porridge and boiled eggs; lunch was multigrain rice and stir-fried shrimp with zucchini; dinner was tomato-braised beef brisket (oil removed, low salt), sautéed asparagus, and purple sweet potato. He drank enough water. Before bed, he used a foam roller to relax his legs.
