2025-10.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lei Mingxuan further consolidated progress on several projects. Early in the morning, he completed his first strength training session of the week. During the day, he went to the bank to keep the western Sichuan funds in a separate account, and had an in-depth conversation with illustrator Chen Yu. After a warm evening playing chess with his father, he went to bed early, feeling relaxed in both mind and body.

events.name: Morning strength training
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan did his 30-minute strength training session on time. Today’s focus was on the upper body and back: assisted pull-ups, dumbbell rows, bent-over reverse flyes, plus core crunches. After training, he stretched as usual. He felt his muscles were activated and stayed energized all day.

events.name: Deepen the illustration collaboration.
events.description: In the morning at the shop, Lei Mingxuan sent Chen Yu the techwear-style outfit photos he had taken the previous two days and suggested using them as the dressing references for modern characters in the illustration. Chen Yu was very interested, and the two discussed the composition of the second illustration over WeChat—the protagonist drinking pour-over coffee at the entrance of a traditional alley—and sparked a lot of inspiration. Lei Mingxuan transferred the advance payment for the second illustration on the spot.

events.name: Manage the Western Sichuan travel fund
events.description: In the afternoon, he found time to go to the bank. Lei Mingxuan formally deposited 11,000 yuan of the previously transferred rental income into a time deposit passbook called “Chuanxi Fund” and set up automatic renewal upon maturity. He also asked financial manager Xu Feng for advice on short-term funds and finally bought a low-risk money market fund to reserve emergency funds for the store.

events.name: Store management and casual chat with regular customers.
events.description: Customer traffic was decent that day. In the afternoon, a new customer who had found the store through the link in Shen Jie's WeChat Moments came in, bought a set of outdoor cookware and a windbreaker. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically introduced the store's coffee experience area and gave the customer a pour-over coffee experience voucher.

events.name: Father and son playing chess, talking, and going to bed early
events.description: After dinner, Father Lei Jianguo rarely took the initiative to propose a game of Chinese chess. Lei Mingxuan happily agreed, and the two set up the chessboard on the coffee table. While playing, Lei Mingxuan chatted about his follow-up plans for the store's delayed opening and his rough idea for a self-driving route through western Sichuan. Father listened attentively and, after winning the game, said, 'It's better to do things steadily.' Because of his morning workout and the fulfilling day, Lei Mingxuan felt sleepy before 10:30, washed up, and went to bed early.

In the evening, he completed his second high-intensity interval training session of the week and declined a weekend dinner invitation. Seeing his increasingly defined muscle definition in the mirror, a sense of accomplishment welled up inside him.

events.name: Quality inspection of samples from a new Southeast Asian brand
events.description: In the morning at the store, a courier delivered a package from supplier Lao Zhou containing spring samples from a niche Southeast Asian brand. Lei Mingxuan opened it and carefully checked the fabric, stitching, and hang tags. He was quite satisfied with two tie-dye shirts and planned to introduce them for a trial sale. He took photos and sent them to Shen Jie for her opinion.

events.name: Visit Zhao Min's company and refine the plan
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan drove to Zhao Min's international exhibition company near Lujiazui. Zhao Min showed him physical models of past pop-up exhibitions and the materials warehouse, and displayed data from several successful cases. In the conference room, the two held printed mall floor plans and discussed the booth layout, lighting plan, and budget allocation in detail. After more than two hours of discussion, a preliminary memorandum of cooperation was drafted, and the two signed it separately. Lei Mingxuan felt that the pop-up exhibition had moved from an idea to a feasible project.

events.name: Evening systematic workout
events.description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan rested briefly and started his second systematic workout of the week at 7:30 p.m. He repeated the previous HIIT exercises and added two extra sets of push-ups and weighted squats. Sweat soaked his vest. After training, he stretched carefully and observed the faint outline of his abs in the mirror. The scale showed 79.8 kg, and he planned to push harder.

events.name: Declined the dinner gathering invitation.
events.description: During a break in training, he checked his phone and found that his sports buddy Han Dong was inviting people in a WeChat group to hotpot on the weekend and play billiards afterward. Lei Mingxuan replied with a smile: 'Bro, I'm rebuilding my fitness for Western Sichuan right now. The hotpot is on me—when the time comes, I'll treat you to highland yak meat!' Han Dong replied with a rolling-eyes emoji but said he understood.

events.name: Healthy meal logging and bedtime stretching
events.description: The day's diet was strict: breakfast was a whole-wheat sandwich and almond milk; lunch was a bento with roasted pumpkin, pan-seared chicken breast, and chickpeas; for dinner his mother made steamed egg with shrimp, stir-fried spinach, and multigrain porridge. Before bed, Lei Mingxuan used a foam roller to thoroughly relax his body, especially his thighs and back, and fell asleep peacefully before 11:30.

During the day, he decisively increased his winter stocking. In the evening, he relaxed with Han Dong over billiards, and after focused writing, he loosened his muscles, getting ready for the month-end summary.

events.name: Morning run 5 km, monthly goal achieved.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan set foot on the Century Park running track again. This time he deliberately increased his cadence and ran 5 kilometers at a pace of 5:20 per kilometer. After finishing, he felt lighter than the previous few times. By now, his cumulative running for the month reached 30 kilometers, completing a small goal he hadn't imagined at the beginning of the month. After the run, he stretched carefully for 10 minutes, went home and weighed in at 80.0 kg, very satisfied.

events.name: Finalizing Winter Fabrics with the Supplier
events.description: In the morning at the shop, Lei Mingxuan had a nearly half-hour phone call with fabric supplier Zhou Tao. Based on recent sales data, he decided to increase the stocking quantity of winter techwear down jackets by 30%. Zhou Tao promised to complete delivery by mid-November and sent over the latest fabric color swatches.

events.name: Leisure time playing billiards with Han Dong

Han Dong praised his feel for the game, and they chatted about recent news, agreeing to meet up more often in November.

events.name: Writing and sharing creative insights
events.description: After playing billiards and returning home, Lei Mingxuan opened a document in his study, looked back on over a month of novel writing, and wrote a short essay, "The Literary Dream of a Clothing Store Owner." 2025-10.daily_overview: On the last day of October, Lei Mingxuan had a rewarding day. The store saw a small peak on the final day of the warm-up period. Healthy eating and consistent exercise kept his weight steady at 80 kilograms. In the evening, he carefully completed the monthly financial analysis and reviewed the online promotion results with his partners. In his diary, he recorded the month's growth and outlined the November camping festival and the Western Sichuan training plan, looking forward to the new month with anticipation.

events.name: Busy morning at the store and Shen Jie's belated gift
events.description: In the morning, on the last day of the promotional warm-up, there were noticeably more customers. His cousin Shen Jie also came to the store specially, bringing a co-branded T-shirt from a techwear brand as a belated birthday gift. Lei Mingxuan accepted it with a smile. The two each had a cup of pour-over coffee and chatted by the bar counter about their November plans.

events.name: Morning weigh-in and journaling
events.description: After getting up at 6:30 in the early morning, Lei Mingxuan stood barefoot on the smart scale, and the screen showed 80.0 kg, the same as yesterday. He returned to the bedroom and wrote in his leather notebook: "October 31. Since adjusting my diet and exercise on the 22nd, my weight has come down from 81.5 to 80.0, successfully dropping back. My body feels lighter and my confidence has doubled."

events.name: Publicity sprint on the final day of the warm-up
events.description: Qian Duoduo, as planned, published the new product preview video for the pop-up exhibition on Xiaohongshu, along with the booth number and transportation guide. Shen Jie launched a “check-in for techwear stickers” activity in her Moments, attracting more attention. Lei Mingxuan updated the reservation count in the group chat in a timely manner and urged Xiao Lin to check the exhibit list.

events.name: Month-end financial review and reconciliation
events.description: After the store lights were turned off at 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan stayed alone at the cash register to organize and file the electricity and rent transfer receipts for the entire month of October. He opened the profit and loss statement on his laptop, entered all of the month's income and expenses, calculated the net profit, and drew a simple cash flow trend chart. The chart showed that the mountain-inspired functional category contributed 45% of gross profit, and the pop-up exhibition investment would be amortized in November.

events.name: Monthly fitness report and physical fitness assessment
events.description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan opened his fitness app and checked this month's stats: 9 workouts (total duration 9 hours) and 30 kilometers of running. He then examined himself in the mirror and felt his muscle definition was faintly visible, especially with a clear improvement in endurance. In his training plan, he set November's goal as 'run four times a week, add one long-distance run'.

events.name: Online promotion review meeting and pre-bedtime stretching
events.description: At 9:30 PM, Lei Mingxuan, Qian Duoduo, and Shen Jie held the final online review. Lei Mingxuan summarized the week's warm-up data: Xiaohongshu posts had a total of 15,000 impressions, WeChat group interactions exceeded 200 messages, and 32 people made reservations through direct messages. The three summarized effective strategies, and Qian Duoduo suggested livestreaming on the day of the exhibition, which was unanimously agreed upon. After the meeting, Lei Mingxuan did 5 minutes of bedtime yoga stretching, then turned off the lights at 11:15 PM sharp and fell asleep with expectations for the future.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the morning of New Year's Day, Lei Mingxuan went for a short morning run as usual, then rushed to the store for the annual inventory count. In the evening, he celebrated the New Year simply with his family.

events.name: Morning run
events.description: After getting up at 7:30, Lei Mingxuan ran a quick 3 kilometers near the residential area at a pace of 5:50 per kilometer. The cold wind was biting, but he felt invigorated.

events.name: New Year breakfast.
events.description: Returned home at 8:00. Mother Wang Xiuying served glutinous rice balls as the holiday breakfast. The three of us exchanged New Year wishes and wished the whole family reunion and happiness.

events.name: Set off for the store.
events.description: At 9:00, Lei Mingxuan put on a thick coat, wrapped his scarf, and walked from home to the mall. The streets along the way were quiet, with occasional firecracker sounds.

events.name: Year-end data review
events.description: From 9:30 to 20:00, Lei Mingxuan, in his clothing store on the 2nd floor of a mall on Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, exported the full-year 2024 sales data, purchasing costs, and profit details from the cashier system and supplier reports, checked them item by item, and compiled them into a summary table for subsequent analysis. At noon, he only had a simple bowl of noodles in the mall's fast-food area.

events.name: Closed the store, returned home, and had a small celebration with family.
events.description: At 20:30, after completing the inventory, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop and walked home. His mother had prepared several home-cooked dishes. The three sat around the table, raised their cups with tea instead of wine, and warmly spent the first day of the New Year in simple togetherness.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Although he stayed up late for New Year's Eve, he got up early on New Year's Day and felt fairly refreshed.

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Completed the stocktake, but felt a little anxious about the declining data.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 3 km

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first workday, Lei Mingxuan carefully analyzed the data after opening the shop and found a clear decline in performance. He felt low, and in the evening confided in his childhood friend Li Na, gaining comfort.

events.name: Waking up early and breakfast.
events.description: Got up at 8:00, washed up briefly, ate the deep-fried rice cake and soy milk Mother had prepared, and listened to Father Lei Jianguo complain about rising vegetable prices while eating.

events.name: Opening the store and in-depth data analysis
events.description: Opened for business at 9:30. Behind the cash register, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and compared sales data with the same period in 2023. He found that the sales growth rate had dropped significantly and the profit margin had fallen by about 5%. He realized that the traditional offline retail model had hit a bottleneck, mainly due to the loss of old customers and the slow growth of new ones. He highlighted the key points in red, printed them out, and pasted them into the ledger.

events.name: Lunch and occasional store duty.
events.description: At 12:30, Lei Mingxuan ordered a takeout of braised chicken rice. While eating, he chatted briefly with staff member Xiao Lin about recent foot traffic. Xiao Lin also said that regular customers were coming less often.

events.name: Afternoon chatting with neighboring merchants
events.description: At 15:00, the owner of the neighboring shoe store came over to chat. The two discussed the impact of e-commerce, and the other suggested trying Douyin live streaming. Lei Mingxuan said he needed to research it.

events.name: Closing the store and evening family conversation
events.description: At 19:30, he closed the shop and went home. During dinner, Lei Mingxuan frankly admitted to his father that the shop's business had hit a bottleneck. His father comforted him, saying that business has ups and downs, and the key is to find a new way forward; he shouldn't put too much pressure on himself.

events.name: Confided in Li Na via WeChat
events.description: At 21:30, Lei Mingxuan was tossing and turning in bed. He couldn't help sending a WeChat message to his childhood friend Li Na to talk about the store's difficulties. Li Na cheered him up with exaggerated emoji stickers and suggested he pay attention to the operating model of internet-famous stores in Hangzhou. Lei Mingxuan felt a little comforted.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Slept enough but feeling slightly sluggish.

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Worried but somewhat comforted, and curious about the Hangzhou model.

2025-01.daily_overview: Lei Mingxuan continued thinking about the transformation direction in the shop and noted down various possibilities. That evening, while playing chess with his father, he received encouragement and felt slightly better.

events.name: Morning preparations
events.description: He got up at 7:50, splashed his face with cold water to refresh himself, had the boiled eggs and milk his mother had prepared, and left ten minutes early.

events.name: Opening the store and clarifying ideas.
events.description: After opening the shop at 9:30, Lei Mingxuan spread his notebook on the counter and, while keeping an eye on the store, repeatedly wrote down directions such as introducing livestream e-commerce, adjusting product selection strategies, launching member repurchase discounts, and hosting offline community events. The draft was full of scribbles and corrections.

events.name: Had a phone call with supplier Wu Fang.
events.description: At 11:00, he proactively contacted Wu Fang, a Guangzhou accessories supplier, asking whether she had any trendy accessories suitable for young men as a test run for adjusting his product selection. Wu Fang recommended several industrial-style necklaces and bracelets.

events.name: Lunch and relaxing reading
events.description: At 12:30, he had a plate of fried noodles at the mall food court, then read the historical novel Ming Dynasty 1566 on a Kindle for half an hour, temporarily putting his anxiety out of his mind.

events.name: Afternoon reception and deep contemplation
events.description: From 14:00 to 17:00, customers kept coming into the store. In between serving customers, Lei Mingxuan used his phone to search for the operating models of several nearby internet-famous stores and recorded the inspiration in his memo app.

events.name: Close the store and play chess in the evening
events.description: Closed the store at 19:30 and went home. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to set up the chessboard and played a game with his father. As they played, his father shared his experience of handling work changes when he was young, encouraging him with 'You'll cross that bridge when you get to it.' Lei Mingxuan's thinking gradually relaxed.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Anxious, did not sleep well all night

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Still somewhat lost, but a vague sense of direction is beginning to emerge.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday afternoon, Lei Mingxuan and his basketball buddy Xie Fei and others played a thoroughly enjoyable basketball game at Yuanshen Sports Center. After exercising, he felt relieved of stress, and in the evening he also arranged a billiards game with Han Dong for next week.

events.name: Prepare basketball gear in the afternoon.
events.description: At 13:30, after showering, Lei Mingxuan changed into sportswear and basketball shoes, checked the basketball's air pressure, water bottle, and towel, and confirmed that his phone had sufficient battery.

events.name: Set off for the court.
events.description: At 13:50, whistling, he left his home on Zhangyang Road and walked about 15 minutes to the outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center, mentally calculating how many games he wanted to win today.

events.name: On-site warm-up and pleasantries
events.description: At 14:10, he arrived at the court and met up with Xie Fei and the others. After greeting each other with pats on the shoulders, they warmed up together with stretching and shooting drills. Xie Fei said he had been working too much overtime lately and had been waiting for this game to relax.

events.name: Fierce match
events.description: 14:30 to 16:30, they played half-court 4v4 in groups. Lei Mingxuan relied on his strong physique to grab rebounds and score multiple times. Sweat soaked his jersey, and he high-fived his teammates after every basket. After the game, he felt slight soreness in his right knee, so he applied ice right away.

events.name: Post-race stretching and making plans.
events.description: At 16:30, the match ended, and the group stretched and drank water while sharing today's highlights, and they agreed to continue next Wednesday evening. Xie Fei joked that he would treat everyone to barbecue next time.

events.name: Purchased supplies on the way back
events.description: At 16:50, Lei Mingxuan left the court and headed home along the same route. Passing a convenience store, he bought a bottle of Gatorade and a Snickers bar, and sat on a bench by the road to quickly refuel.

events.name: Go home, shower, and evening leisure
events.description: Arrived home at 17:20, took a nice hot shower, changed into clean loungewear, and ate the fruit salad his mother had cut. In the evening at 19:30, he curled up on the sofa watching the new arc of 'Demon Slayer', exclaiming from time to time. At 21:00, he contacted his billiards buddy Han Dong on WeChat and arranged to practice at the pool hall next Wednesday evening. Han Dong readily agreed.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: A little tired, but looking forward to the afternoon basketball game.

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Pleasant; the refreshment after exercise and the company of billiards friends eased work pressure.

state.daily_exercise: Basketball (2 hours of high-intensity competition)

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lei Mingxuan spent a relaxing day at home. In the morning he helped his mother with housework; in the afternoon he went roller skating and organized blind boxes; in the evening he chatted online with his anime friend Gao Yuan about new series.

events.name: Sleeping In and a Loving Breakfast
events.description: Woke up at 9:30. His mother specially made his favorite pan-fried buns, crispy on the bottom and full of meat filling; Lei Mingxuan ate six in one go.

events.name: Accompany mother to buy groceries
events.description: At 10:00, Lei Mingxuan offered to accompany his mother to the nearby vegetable market. As they strolled, they discussed the New Year supplies to stock up on for Spring Festival. He helped her carry three large bags of ingredients, and on the way back he also bought sugar-roasted chestnuts.

events.name: Family lunch.
events.description: At 12:00, his father personally cooked a meal of Shanghai-style braised pork and yandu xian soup. Lei Mingxuan was full of praise and had another bowl of rice, saying that since he had been exercising less recently, he needed to watch his portions.

events.name: Afternoon roller skating
events.description: At 14:00, Lei Mingxuan put on his roller skates and skated for about an hour on the riverside trail near his neighborhood. Although the cold wind hit his face, the sense of speed lifted his spirits.

events.name: Reading a novel and sorting blind boxes
events.description: He went home at 15:30, made a cup of hot tea, and read “The Longest Day in Chang'an” in his study until 17:00. Then he spent an hour reorganizing his Pop Mart blind boxes, placed two newly received SP series figures into the display cabinet, took photos, and sent them to the designer toy group.

events.name: Evening online interaction with Gao Yuan
events.description: At 7 p.m., the family of three had dinner. At 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan logged on to QQ and found that his anime enthusiast friend Gao Yuan was discussing the new season's show 'Undead Girl Murder Farce'. The two got more and more engaged in the conversation, which lasted until 10 p.m. Gao Yuan also recommended several similar works.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Lazy; I completely wanted to stay in bed.

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Relaxed. The new-knowledge episode recommendations gave the weekend more to look forward to.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, Lei Mingxuan returned to work at the store. In the afternoon, he saw Song Jia’s skiing proposal in the outdoor sports group and was immediately drawn to it. He decided on the spot to join and began planning the weekend trip to Anji, shedding the gloomy mood of the previous few days.

events.name: Getting up early and preparing to open the store
events.description: Got up at 8:00, ate the congee and side dishes cooked by his mother, arrived at the store early at 9:00 to open up, tidied the shelves, and cleaned the glass of the display cabinets.

events.name: Received regular customers in the morning
events.description: At 11:00, two regular customers came to pick out new clothes for the New Year. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically recommended several newly arrived down jackets, closed a sale, and felt a little better.

events.name: Lunch and information gathering
events.description: At 12:30, he ate a bowl of Japanese ramen at the mall food court while scrolling on his phone, and saw a skiing proposal posted by Song Jia in the roller-skating group along with information about skiing in Anji.

events.name: Responding to the ski plan
events.description: At 14:00, drawn by the thrilling sense of speed, Lei Mingxuan immediately replied in the group to join, and privately chatted with Song Jia to confirm the departure time for January 11-12, the meeting point in Pudong, and the choice of Guanyintang Ski Resort.

events.name: Afternoon store work and searching for guides
events.description: At 15:00, while tending the shop, I used my phone to search for Anji skiing guides, jotted down the required gear checklist in my memo, and found that I needed to buy ski goggles and protective gear.

events.name: Evening sharing with parents
events.description: At 19:30 he closed the shop and went home. During dinner, he excitedly told his parents about going skiing on the weekend. His father urged him to pay attention to safety, and his mother worried about frostbite. Lei Mingxuan agreed to everything.

events.name: Gear research before bed
events.description: At 21:00, he lay in bed and repeatedly compared ski goggle brands on JD.com and Taobao. He added several models from Decathlon and Nanen to his cart but did not place an order, planning to ask friends for advice. Sitting for too long had made his lower back a bit sore, so he got up and moved around for ten minutes.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Just so-so; subconsciously still preoccupied with the store's performance.

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Excited, looking forward to the weekend skiing trip, and temporarily setting aside worries.

events.name: A cloudy, rainy morning.

events.name: Daily store routine and organizing new products.

events.name: Chatted with neighboring stores
events.description: At 11:00, the owner of the neighboring milk tea shop came over to borrow a charger. The two chatted about how to run promotions during the slow winter season. The other said they could do a co-branded event, and Lei Mingxuan found it quite interesting.

events.name: Simple lunch
events.description: At 12:00, I ordered steamed dumplings and a stewed soup from Shaxian Snacks and quickly ate them at the cashier counter.

events.name: Afternoon minding the store and the topic of designer toys
events.description: At 14:00, a regular customer who also enjoys designer toys came to the store, and the two excitedly discussed the new SKULLPANDA craze. Lei Mingxuan showed his collection photos.

events.name: Tried on at Decathlon, but no luck.
events.description: At 18:30, Lei Mingxuan closed the store early and went to the nearby Decathlon store to try on ski goggles, only to find the suitable model sold out, so he had to note down the size.

events.name: Shopping online for ski goggles
events.description: At 20:00, after finishing dinner with his parents, Lei Mingxuan went into his study, opened his laptop, logged into Taobao, compared the anti-fog ski goggles from Decathlon and Nan'en, and after considering reviews and prices, finally placed an order for the Decathlon G-SKI sports sunglasses, spending 299 yuan.

events.name: Report progress to Song Jia.
events.description: At 21:30, I told Song Jia on WeChat that I had bought ski goggles. Song Jia replied that protective gear should also be prepared, and she recommended a set on JD.com.

events.name: Morning wake-up and breakfast.

events.name: Arriving at the store and reconciling accounts

events.name: Early rising and simple stretching
events.description: Woke up at 8:05. Lei Mingxuan did a few stretching moves in the room, felt a bit stiff in his body, and decided to resume morning runs starting next week.

events.name: Opening the store and organizing member records
events.description: The store opened at 9:30. In the morning, he sat at the cash register using the computer to update member information and noticed that many regular members hadn't come in for half a year, so he came up with the idea of sending text messages to win them back.

events.name: Discuss the promotion with Xiao Lin
events.description: At 11:30, Lei Mingxuan called Xiao Lin over, and the two discussed posting a limited-time discount on Moments. Xiao Lin volunteered to operate WeChat.

events.name: Hotpot lunch
events.description: At 12:30, Lei Mingxuan ate a one-person hot pot upstairs, feeling warm and cozy. He took a photo of the bubbling broth and sent it to the family group.

events.name: Checking shipment tracking and photographing new products
events.description: At 13:30, he opened Taobao and JD.com and confirmed that the ski goggles and protective gear had been shipped and were expected to arrive tomorrow. Then he used his phone to take a few flat-lay photos of the newly arrived men's clothing, preparing them for online promotion.

events.name: Chatted with property manager Zheng Kai
events.description: At 16:00, Zheng Kai came over to say hello while patrolling the mall. The two chatted about the mall's pre-Spring Festival lucky draw event, and Zheng Kai suggested that Lei Mingxuan could sponsor a piece of clothing as a prize to increase exposure.

events.name: Posted an ad on Moments.
events.description: At 18:30, Lei Mingxuan finished editing the caption and photos and posted on WeChat Moments: "Year-end clearance, some winter clothes 30% off, welcome to the store to try them on~" Shortly after, he received several likes.

events.name: Closed the store, returned home, and talked with his cousin.
events.description: Closed the shop at 19:30 and went home. After dinner at 20:30, Lei Mingxuan had a video call with his cousin Yang Fan. Yang Fan shared the news that he had successfully become a regular employee in Hangzhou. Lei Mingxuan talked about the store's difficulties and his skiing plans. Yang Fan suggested that he try live streaming on Douyin.

events.name: Livestreamed trial teaching practice
events.description: At 22:00, on a whim, Lei Mingxuan simulated a livestream in front of the bedroom mirror, talking about outfit matching. After ten minutes, he noticed his expression was stiff, smiled wryly, and sat down to record the points that needed improvement.

2025-01.daily_overview: Friday was an extraordinarily busy day for Lei Mingxuan. In the early morning, after walking and talking with his father in Century Park, he returned to the shop and finalized the new fabric samples with supplier Zhou Tao over a video call. At noon, he had lunch with shop assistant Xiao Lin and listened to suggestions for improvements. In the evening, he received the ski gear and contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei to arrange dinner the next day. It was a packed schedule.

events.name: Morning walk in the park with father
events.description: At 6:30, Lei Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes and running shoes and walked with his father, Lei Jianguo, from their home on Zhangyang Road to Century Park. The two walked slowly along the lake for about 40 minutes. His father asked about the current situation of the shop and reminded him to carefully go over the accounts and recover funds before the Spring Festival. Lei Mingxuan listened attentively and promised to go home at the end of the month to straighten things out.

events.name: Bought breakfast at the park entrance
events.description: At 7:15, the walk ended. Father and son bought hot soy milk and fried rice cakes at a breakfast stall outside Century Park, and Lei Mingxuan rushed to pay.

events.name: Going home and breakfast
events.description: At 7:30, the two returned home carrying breakfast. Mother had already prepared porridge. The three sat at the dining table, and Lei Mingxuan soaked his fried rice cake in soy milk, eating with great relish.

events.name: Open the store and contact suppliers.
events.description: At 9:30, Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store. At 10:00, he had a video call on WeChat with Zhou Tao, a supplier from Hangzhou, and discussed in detail whether it was feasible to introduce mountain-style functional fabrics. Zhou Tao showed sample images and performance specs of several waterproof and wear-resistant fabrics, and finally agreed to send samples within a week.

events.name: Morning store work
events.description: At 11:00, Lei Mingxuan guided Xiao Lin to move the new down jackets out of the warehouse and readjusted the main display position by the door.

events.name: Lunch alone
events.description: 12:00, Lei Mingxuan ate a bowl of shredded pork in garlic sauce rice at the mall food court, jotting down key points from his communication with Zhou Tao in his notebook.

events.name: Had a talk with store clerk Xiao Lin
events.description: At 14:00, Lei Mingxuan verbally invited Xiao Lin to have dinner together in the fast-food area after the evening rush hour, wanting to hear his thoughts.

events.name: Afternoon store operations
events.description: From 14:30 to 17:00, Lei Mingxuan received several customers and applied an additional 10% discount to some winter items, hanging eye-catching price tags in the discount section.

events.name: Evening discussion with Xiao Lin
events.description: At 17:30, after the evening rush hour, the two chatted over a simple meal in the mall's fast-food area. Lei Mingxuan seriously asked Xiao Lin for his views on upgrading the store. Xiao Lin suggested strengthening online promotion and shared what younger customers prefer. Lei Mingxuan encouraged Xiao Lin to get involved in the follow-up renovation, and their relationship shifted from boss-and-subordinate to partners.

events.name: Return to store records
events.description: 18:30, after dinner, returned to the store. Lei Mingxuan used his notebook to write down Xiao Lin's online promotion suggestions and young customers' preferences, and began to draft the renovation steps.

events.name: Close the store, go home, and pack up gear
events.description: Closed the store at 19:30, and the package arrived just after he got home. Lei Mingxuan opened it in the living room, tried on the ski goggles and protective gear, adjusted the straps, confirmed the size fit, and put them into his backpack with satisfaction.

events.name: Contact childhood friend Zhang Wei
events.description: At 21:00, Lei Mingxuan contacted Zhang Wei via WeChat and arranged to have dinner at a hotpot restaurant near Century Avenue in Pudong at 6 p.m. the next evening, planning to ask Zhang Wei for advice on running the shop.

events.name: Final check before bed
events.description: At 22:00, Lei Mingxuan checked his ski backpack again to make sure all the gear was complete, then showered and went to bed. During that time, he received Song Jia's notice that a cold wave would arrive over the weekend, so the skiing plan was postponed to next week. Lei Mingxuan was a little regretful but understood.

start_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Awake and ready to start a fulfilling day.

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: My plan is clear. Although skiing has been postponed, I feel an increasing sense of direction for the transition.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, after learning that the skiing trip was postponed, Lei Mingxuan first went to the billiard hall to get his fix. In the afternoon he played basketball as usual, and in the evening he had a long dinner with his childhood friend Zhang Wei, gaining valuable advice about transforming the store.

events.name: Weekend sleep-in and breakfast.
events.description: At 9:30, Lei Mingxuan got up and ate the scallion-oil noodles his mother had made, then let out a satisfied burp.

events.name: Confirm the skiing postponement and billiards plan.
events.description: At 10:30, he received a WeChat message from Song Jia saying that due to the sudden drop in temperature in Anji and time conflicts among some partners, the skiing plan was moved to next Saturday. Lei Mingxuan was disappointed but immediately decided to go to the billiard hall to pass the time; he reorganized his skiing equipment and put it into the cabinet.

events.name: Billiards practice at the pool hall
events.description: From 11:00 to 13:00, Lei Mingxuan practiced his stroke and positioning at his usual billiards hall. His touch was good, and he made a beautiful combination shot, feeling very pleased.

events.name: Afternoon basketball game
events.description: At 14:00, Lei Mingxuan hurried to Yuanshen Sports Center for the regular Saturday basketball match with Xie Fei and other regular players. He did well scoring inside. After the game, everyone stretched together. Xie Fei announced that he might bring a new friend next Saturday, and Lei Mingxuan welcomed it.

events.name: Returning home to bathe and preparing for the appointment
events.description: 16:30, after basketball, I went home to shower and changed into casual clothes, ready to go out to meet Zhang Wei.

events.name: Attending a scheduled dinner
events.description: At 18:00, he walked to the hot pot restaurant near Century Avenue, where he met up with Zhang Wei, who had arrived early. After exchanging pleasantries, they ordered and chose the half-spicy, half-mild broth.

events.name: In-depth conversation at a hot pot restaurant.
events.description: During the meal, Lei Mingxuan described in detail the recent decline in foot traffic at his store. Zhang Wei advised him to build a personal IP and use short-video platforms to attract younger customers, and reminded him that a full store upgrade might require setting aside a budget of 200,000 to 300,000 yuan. The two exchanged in-depth views on renovation style and online operation strategies. events.name: Early rising and self-reflection

events.name: Healthy lunch.

events.name: Arranged afternoon tea with his cousin Shen Jie.

events.name: Starbucks afternoon tea discussion on the outdoor techwear trend

She cited several successful transformation cases and pointed out that adding an outdoor category to Lei Mingxuan's store could attract new customers and raise the average order value. Lei Mingxuan listened attentively and asked questions from time to time, and the two exchanged views on product selection, supply chain adjustments, and marketing strategy. Shen Jie also shared contact information for several reliable outdoor fabric suppliers. The conversation lasted an hour and a half, and Lei Mingxuan became determined to introduce the outdoor category.

events.name: Say goodbye and return to their respective posts

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lei Mingxuan, along with his roller-skating buddy Song Jia, childhood friend Zhang Wei, and sports buddy Han Dong, drove to Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort in Anji, Zhejiang, for his first-ever snowboarding experience. With the instructor's guidance and repeated practice, he initially mastered braking and the falling-leaf move, but he also took quite a few falls. On the way there and back and during breaks, the friends shared laughter. Lei Mingxuan also recorded the whole trip with an action camera, then edited and shared it after returning home. It was a fulfilling and thrilling weekend outdoor day.

events.name: Get up early, organize gear, and gather.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan organized his skiing gear (ski suit, protective gear, action camera) at home and confirmed the meeting time with Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong via a WeChat group. At 7:00 he drove his own car, picking up Zhang Wei (Jinqiao Road, Pudong) and Han Dong (Hongmei Road, Minhang), and finally met up near Song Jia's home (Qixin Road, Minhang) at 7:30; the four set off together.

events.name: Drive to Anji Cloud Grassland
events.description: At 7:30, Lei Mingxuan drove, taking the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and then the Hangzhou-Changsha Expressway to Anji, Zhejiang. Along the way, music played in the car and everyone chatted relaxed. Han Dong was responsible for using his phone navigation to remind about road conditions. After about 2.5 hours, they arrived at the Anji Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort parking lot at 10:00.

events.name: Bought tickets and rented ski equipment.
events.description: After arriving at 10:00, the four bought all-day ski tickets at the ticket hall (including ski equipment rental). Lei Mingxuan rented a snowboard, snowboard boots, a helmet, and protective gear; Song Jia rented skis; Zhang Wei and Han Dong each chose their own equipment. After changing into ski suits, they went to the beginner slope. Lei Mingxuan used an action camera to film the snowy scenery.

events.name: Hiring a coach to learn snowboarding basics
events.description: At 10:30, Lei Mingxuan hired a ski instructor for one-on-one coaching. The instructor first explained techniques for falling safely and getting up on a snowboard, then taught heel-side sideslip and falling leaf. Lei Mingxuan fell more than ten times during practice, with his hips and the backs of his thighs aching badly, but he gradually mastered his balance and could complete a short-distance falling leaf. He recorded the falls and the moment of his first successful glide with the action camera on his helmet. Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong practiced on their own nearby.

events.name: Midday break: socializing and observing ski jacket designs
events.description: At 12:00, the four went to the restaurant in the ski resort's rest area. Lei Mingxuan ordered beef noodles and a hot drink. They sat around a table sharing their morning skiing experiences. He showed the video of his falls from the action camera, making everyone laugh. He also paid special attention to the windproof, waterproof fabrics and pocket designs of the ski jackets, which reminded him of the outdoor techwear style he follows, and he discussed the design details with his friends. The lunch break lasted about 40 minutes.

events.name: Afternoon independent practice and progress
events.description: At 13:00 they returned to the ski slope. Lei Mingxuan no longer hired an instructor and independently practiced the falling leaf and tried switching edges on the beginner slope. Thanks to the falls accumulated in the morning, he fell noticeably less often and was able to complete continuous diagonal descents and experience the thrill of high-speed gliding. Song Jia gave him some balance tips, and Lei Mingxuan also used his action camera to record videos of his progress. However, a heavier backward fall caused sharp pain in his hip, after which his movements became noticeably more cautious. At 15:30 everyone decided to end skiing, packed up their gear, and prepared to head back.

events.name: Returning Equipment and Heading Back
events.description: At 16:00, the four of them returned the rental ski equipment, changed back into their own clothes, and set off from the Anji Cloud Grassland parking lot to return to Shanghai. Zhang Wei drove (Lei Mingxuan rested in the back seat due to his fall injury and fatigue), taking the same route back. They made one brief rest stop at a service area on the way, and everyone discussed plans for the next skiing trip. They arrived in Shanghai at about 18:30, then Lei Mingxuan dropped off Han Dong and Zhang Wei one by one, said goodbye to Song Jia last, and returned to his home in Pudong at 19:00.

events.name: Editing and sharing the skiing video
events.description: At 19:00, returned home. After a brief rest, Lei Mingxuan imported the videos and photos taken by the action camera into his phone, selected clips of a few spectacular falls and successful runs, and used his phone to edit them into several short videos. He then posted the videos to his Moments and the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group with the caption 'First Anji ski experience, fell so much it was awesome!' Then he had a lively interaction with Song Jia, Zhang Wei, and Han Dong in the group, reminiscing about the fun events of the day.

events.name: Family dinner and rest
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan had dinner with his parents and talked about his skiing experience. His mother was worried to see him limping and told him to put on a medicated patch. At about 21:00, he ended the social interaction, took a shower, and went to bed early. His body was tired, but his mind was excited. There was extensive bruising on his buttocks and thighs, with obvious pain.

start_state.mood: Excited and expectant

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Satisfied, physically tired.

events.name: Daily store operations and display fine-tuning
events.description: On Monday, when the shop opened, Lei Mingxuan worked the full day. He organized last week's sales data, adjusted the display positions of several winter coats, and placed the previously selected techwear fabric samples in a corner of the workbench to observe customer feedback at any time. Because his hip still hurt, he stood most of the time and avoided hard seats.

events.name: Morning run changed to indoor stretching.
events.description: He had originally planned to go for a jog in the morning, but the bruise on the back of his thigh made it hard to lift his leg. Lei Mingxuan instead did a set of upper-body stretches and 10 minutes of light yoga at home to stay active.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lei Mingxuan focused his energy on recruiting new store staff. He screened resumes in the morning and arranged three interviews in the afternoon. After careful review, he ultimately hired a young person with sales experience in sports brands, building up important staffing for the store upgrade after the Chinese New Year. Although it drizzled that day, the recruitment went smoothly, which made him more confident about the transformation. The bruises on his hips and legs were starting to fade, and the pain had eased.

events.name: Screen applicant resumes and notify candidates for interviews.
events.description: In the morning at the store, Lei Mingxuan used a lull in business to open the recruitment platform and browse the resumés that had arrived that morning. He initially shortlisted three candidates with retail experience and an interest in clothing, and sent them in-platform messages to invite them to the store for interviews in the afternoon.

events.name: Interviewing the first candidate
events.description: From 1:00 to 1:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan organized the resumes and interview questions in the store. At 1:30, the first candidate, Candidate A, arrived. He asked in detail about the candidate's past retail work experience, knowledge of outdoor apparel brands, and sales skills, but found that the candidate lacked a sports brand background.

events.name: Interview the second candidate
events.description: 2:00–2:30, Lei Mingxuan interviewed the second candidate (B), who had apparel sales experience but a slightly lower education level, an average reaction to fashion trends, and a mediocre performance.

events.name: Interviewed the third candidate, who left an excellent impression
events.description: 2:30-3:00, the third candidate (C) was a young man who had worked as a salesperson at a well-known sports brand. He was passionate about outdoor functional clothing and had solid sales skills. Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth exchange with him about the store upgrade plan. They had a very pleasant conversation and left an excellent impression.

events.name: Evaluating and deciding on hiring
events.description: 3:00-3:30, Lei Mingxuan was alone in the store reviewing the performance of the three candidates. He compared their retail experience, sports brand background, communication skills, and work attitude, and ultimately decided to hire the third candidate and prepared to contact them.

events.name: Phone notification of the hiring result
events.description: From 3:30 to 4:00, Lei Mingxuan contacted the young candidate he had hired by phone, informed him that he had passed the interview, and briefly discussed the start date (tentatively set for the eighth day of the first lunar month after the New Year), salary and benefits, and job responsibilities. The candidate readily accepted. Afterwards, he politely sent rejection text messages to the other two candidates.

events.name: Reviewing the interview and organizing the store
events.description: After all the interviews ended, Lei Mingxuan organized the interview records, backed up the resumes, and cleaned the interview area. He felt relieved and looked forward to the store's staffing structure after the new staff member joined.

end_state.mood: Satisfied

2025-01.daily_overview: On Wednesday, an unexpected power outage in the mall due to aging circuits closed the store. Lei Mingxuan quickly adapted, moving work home; he focused on organizing inventory data, planning online operation strategies, and held a video conference with staff member Xiao Lin to optimize WeChat Moments promotion. Although he lost revenue, he used this time to deepen his online strategy and also grew closer to property manager Zheng Kai, turning a passive situation into an active one. The bruise had mostly faded, and he could move freely.

events.name: Sudden power outage at the mall and emergency response
events.description: In the morning, the mall where Lei Mingxuan's clothing store was located suddenly lost power due to a circuit breaker tripping from aging wiring, and the entire floor was blacked out, forcing the store to close temporarily. He immediately contacted the mall property manager, Zheng Kai, and learned that emergency repairs would take two days. Lei Mingxuan cooperated with the property management to conduct a power-off safety inspection of the store, turned off the main switch, locked the store door, and used the shutdown time to work from home.

events.name: Taking inventory at home and analyzing online operations
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in his home study, pulled up the inventory list, carefully reviewed the best sellers and slow movers, and used Excel to analyze recent online operation data (interactions on Moments and Xiaohongshu), researching how to further increase sales through social media. He considered a future strategy combining offline and online channels, and drafted an initial online content calendar.

events.name: Had a video call with store clerk Lin Yue to discuss promotion optimization
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan connected with staff member Lin Yue (Xiao Lin) via WeChat video and discussed the optimization plan for the shop's Moments promotional content, including image selection criteria, copywriting style, and optimal posting times. He also assigned several specific tasks to be executed immediately after reopening, such as taking a set of outdoor-style outfit photos.

events.name: Improve communication with the property manager, Zheng Kai.
events.description: During the power outage, Lei Mingxuan communicated with Zheng Kai multiple times by phone and WeChat about the repair progress. Zheng Kai said the mall would take the opportunity to comprehensively check the electrical circuits and thanked the merchants for their understanding. Because of this, the two exchanged messages more often, and their relationship moved from purely work-related to cordial. Zheng Kai also revealed that the mall would organize a merchant social gathering after the New Year.

events.name: Indoor exercise at home
events.description: During an afternoon break at work, Lei Mingxuan felt his strength had recovered. He laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did a set of bodyweight exercises (push-ups, plank) and stretching. The wound no longer hurt, and he could exercise normally.

end_state.mood: Smooth due to clear planning

2025-01.daily_overview: On Thursday afternoon the mall's power was restored, and Lei Mingxuan rushed back to the store to reopen as soon as possible. He carefully checked the safety conditions and quickly dealt with the backlog, and store operations returned to normal. After work he dragged Han Dong to play a game of billiards to relax; his body had fully recovered. In the evening he discussed Spring Festival preparations with his parents.

events.name: Restored the store's power supply and conducted inspections before reopening.
events.description: In the afternoon, the mall's power was restored. After receiving Zheng Kai's notice, Lei Mingxuan immediately went to the store and carefully checked whether the electrical equipment, lighting, and goods had been damaged. After confirming everything was normal, he opened the store and put up a notice saying business had resumed. He also checked the backup lighting and emergency power in the store to prepare for future emergencies.

events.name: Handle backlogged matters from the store closure
events.description: After reopening, he quickly handled two days of backlogged order shipments, replied to unread customer messages, and adjusted some displays, placing the winter coats featured in the skiing video in a prominent position.

events.name: Briefly discussed store safety with my father.
events.description: During dinner, Lei Mingxuan talked with his father Lei Jianguo about the mall power outage. His father reminded him to pay attention to store electrical safety and insurance matters. Lei Mingxuan said he had already considered buying commercial insurance.

events.name: Relaxing with Billiards
events.description: After work, Lei Mingxuan invited Han Dong to a billiard hall for five games of American 8-ball. He still had his touch and won three games. After playing, they had pan-fried buns at a nearby snack shop and chatted about Spring Festival plans.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Friday, Lei Mingxuan arranged the Spring Festival holiday schedule for the store, completed the final inventory count, posted the holiday closure notice, and confirmed the holiday online customer service assignments with store clerk Lin Yue. After wrapping up work, he accompanied his mother to buy Chinese New Year goods, cleaned the house in the evening, and welcomed the upcoming Lunar New Year, shifting from a busy work rhythm to family reunion mode.

events.name: Store Spring Festival holiday preparations and inventory count
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan completed the final preparations at the store before the Spring Festival. He took inventory, flagged out-of-stock items, organized the spring new-product launch plan, and posted the Spring Festival holiday notice (closed from January 25 to February 4) at the store entrance and in the customer group. He also put away some samples and locked the warehouse.

events.name: Briefed store clerk Lin Yue on holiday work
events.description: In the afternoon, store clerk Lin Yue came in. Lei Mingxuan had a face-to-face talk with her and explained the rotating online customer-service duty schedule during the holiday period (Lei Mingxuan and Lin Yue would each cover a few days), and reminded her to keep up with WeChat Moments interactions. Lin Yue agreed to post one selected outfit recap every day.

events.name: Accompany my mother to shop for Chinese New Year goods.
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan accompanied his mother Wang Xiuying to the nearby supermarket to buy New Year goods, including Spring Festival couplets, 'fu' characters, candies, and ingredients, in preparation for the upcoming Lunar New Year's Eve. On the way home, they talked about arrangements for visiting relatives and friends during the Spring Festival. His mother again hinted at the daughter of her cousin, and Lei Mingxuan smiled and changed the subject.

events.name: Clean the room to welcome the New Year.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan tidied up his study and bedroom, rearranged some trendy toy blind boxes for display, threw away unnecessary clutter, and dusted for the New Year. He also packed a small box of old clothes to donate.

start_state.mood: Relaxed (getting ready for the holiday)

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lei Mingxuan, home on his day off, spent a leisurely day. After a morning jog, he helped his mother prepare make-ahead items for the New Year's Eve dinner, experiencing a family tradition; in the afternoon he immersed himself in a historical novel, with ample spiritual nourishment; in the evening he arranged a post-holiday gathering with his sports buddies. Life felt calm and comfortable.

events.name: Morning run and watering flowers.
events.description: After getting up at 8:00 a.m., Lei Mingxuan jogged 2 kilometers in the residential community to stretch his limbs. After returning home, he watered the potted plants on the balcony and noticed that the Christmas cactus his mother had planted had already formed flower buds.

events.name: Help his mother prepare make-ahead dishes for the New Year's Eve dinner.
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother Wang Xiuying prepare pre-made dishes for the New Year's Eve dinner in the kitchen, including deep-fried meatballs, egg dumplings, and other traditional Shanghai New Year foods. As he worked, he listened to his mother tell stories from past New Years. When frying the meatballs, he accidentally splashed hot oil onto his wrist, and his mother quickly told him to rinse it with cold water.

events.name: Reading historical fiction
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan curled up on the sofa reading a historical novel about Shanghai's Maritime Silk Road during the Ming Dynasty. He was immersed in it for over two hours, enjoying a rare leisurely reading time. When he came to exciting parts, he annotated a few passages on his phone.

events.name: Rescheduled the ball game with Han Dong, a sports buddy, on WeChat.
events.description: In the evening, Han Dong invited Lei Mingxuan via WeChat to play billiards after the Spring Festival. Considering the Spring Festival arrangements, they agreed to meet before the sixth day of the new year (January 31). Lei Mingxuan suggested going to his usual billiard hall on the evening of the fifth day, but final confirmation was still needed.

events.name: Found the hoarded snacks
events.description: While tidying the room in the evening, Lei Mingxuan found two bags of chips and sandwich cookies stocked in the bedside cabinet from the Double 11 shopping day. Craving a snack, he opened a bag of chips and ate a few pieces, then reminded himself to control himself during the Spring Festival.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, following his father's suggestion, Lei Mingxuan spent the morning going over the family's annual accounts together. What should have been an ordinary process was disrupted by his mother's sudden urging to get married, putting him under great pressure. In the afternoon he went alone to play billiards to relieve his mood, and in the evening he had a long talk with his childhood friend Zhang Wei. His emotions gradually calmed, and he came to appreciate the importance of family communication and the support of friends.

events.name: Sorting out the family’s annual accounts with my father
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan sat in the living room with his father Lei Jianguo, took out the family income and expense ledger and bank statements, and sorted through the family's total income and expenses over the past year. His father worked an abacus while advising him to run the business steadily, and Lei Mingxuan reported on the shop's profitability and his transformation plan for the new year.

events.name: Mother's pressure to get married caused a tense family atmosphere.
events.description: While sorting out the accounts, his mother Wang Xiuying brought over fruit and took the opportunity to bring up Lei Mingxuan's marriage again, complaining that people his age already had children in elementary school. Lei Mingxuan grew irritated and talked back a few times, and the atmosphere suddenly became tense. After his father smoothed things over, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room in a sulk. His mother sighed and continued with the housework.

events.name: Went out by himself to play billiards to clear his head.
events.description: In the afternoon, to ease his mood, Lei Mingxuan drove alone to his usual billiards hall and practiced American eight-ball for 2 hours. Focusing on his shots let him temporarily forget his worries, and his skill improved slightly, with several nice long shots. But at one point he accidentally knocked the cue ball off the table, drawing sidelong glances from the neighboring table.

events.name: Evening phone call with childhood friend Zhang Wei
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan called Zhang Wei and talked about the things that had gone wrong during the day. Zhang Wei consoled him with his own married life experience, advised him to be more understanding of his parents, and shared his feelings before being sent on assignment to Singapore. After half an hour of chatting, Lei Mingxuan felt much better. Zhang Wei also invited him to have a farewell meal before he left after the New Year.

events.name: Scrolling through anime updates before bed
events.description: Before bed, lying in bed, Lei Mingxuan watched two episodes of a new anime and found that the protagonist was also being pressured to get married. He couldn't help smiling wryly.

start_state.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: A little annoyed but relieved

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, Lei Mingxuan adjusted his life rhythm around social plans. In the morning, he confirmed a get-together for the third day of the Chinese New Year with old high school friends; in the afternoon, he quickly booked the restaurant, handling things efficiently. In the evening, he handled the last few online customer service matters and sent holiday greetings to his cousin, fully warming up his social circle for the Spring Festival. He also went for a jog in the park near his home to maintain his exercise routine.

events.name: Discussed the Spring Festival gathering in the high school classmates group and booked a restaurant
events.description: In the morning, Chen Hao proposed in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group that they get together in Shanghai during the Spring Festival, and Lei Mingxuan and Liu Yang immediately responded. After discussion, the three settled on meeting on the evening of January 31 (the third day of the Lunar New Year) at a local Shanghainese restaurant in Pudong. Liu Yang said he would bring the latest designer toy news from Shenzhen, and Lei Mingxuan offered to host and treat everyone. After about half an hour of finalizing the details, Lei Mingxuan called the restaurant in the afternoon to book a private room for 6 PM, confirmed the dishes and per-person budget, and sent a screenshot of the reservation to the group.

events.name: Final online store maintenance before the Spring Festival
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan logged into the store's WeChat backend on his phone, replied to the last batch of customers' Chinese New Year greetings and inquiries, and posted a WeChat Moments update previewing new items after the holiday. He also checked whether the holiday auto-reply settings were working properly.

events.name: Send a New Year's greeting to my cousin Shen Jie.
events.description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan sent Shen Jie a WeChat message wishing her a happy Spring Festival, and arranged to meet and chat when he went to his uncle's house on the second day of the New Year (the 30th). Shen Jie replied that she was at KTV with colleagues and sent a group photo.

events.name: Jogging in the park.
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan found some time, put on his running shoes, and ran 3 kilometers in the park near home at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer. A gentle breeze brushed his face and the sunshine was mild. After the run, he did a set of stretches and felt light and agile.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Chinese New Year's Eve, Lei Mingxuan spent a warm and peaceful night at home in Pudong, Shanghai with his parents. His mother's specialty dishes, toasts with his father, a flurry of red envelopes for the store staff and customers, and designer toy news shared by an old friend—all kinds of warmth intertwined. The family gathered around to watch the Spring Festival Gala and stay up late. During the countdown to the new year, Lei Mingxuan felt that the root of his family and the root of his career were firmly planted together. The food was abundant, and his weight had noticeably increased.

events.name: My mother carefully prepared the New Year's Eve dinner.
events.description: On the afternoon of New Year's Eve, mother Wang Xiuying was busy in the kitchen all afternoon, carefully cooking a sumptuous reunion dinner, including Lei Mingxuan's favorite Shanghai-style braised pork belly, pan-fried buns, steamed sea bass, oil-braised shrimp, and a family reunion casserole. Father Lei Jianguo helped as a sous-chef, while Lei Mingxuan put up the Spring Festival couplets and Fu characters. The kitchen was filled with aroma, and Lei Mingxuan kept sneaking in to steal a piece of braised pork.

events.name: New Year's Eve dinner and family reunion
events.description: At 6 p.m., the family sat around the dining table. Lei Mingxuan poured yellow rice wine for his father and drank a few cups with him, while his mother chatted about cousin Shen Jie's new job and plans for the coming year. The three raised their glasses to toast one another's health and happiness, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious. The earlier nagging about marriage had completely melted away. Lei Mingxuan ate two big bowls of rice and five pieces of braised pork.

events.name: Send a red envelope to shop assistant Xiao Lin
events.description: After the New Year’s Eve dinner, Lei Mingxuan used his phone in the living room to send an 888-yuan red envelope to store clerk Lin Yue on WeChat, along with thanks and New Year wishes, encouraging Xiao Lin to keep working hard in the new year. Xiao Lin quickly replied with thanks and New Year wishes.

events.name: Send red envelopes in customer groups to extend New Year greetings
events.description: Afterwards, Lei Mingxuan sent a carefully edited New Year greeting in his clothing store's customer WeChat group and followed up with several lucky red envelopes to thank customers for their support over the past year. The group was lively, and many regular customers replied with blessings. In total, he sent 500 yuan in red envelopes.

events.name: Received Liu Yang's designer toy share and chatted about it
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan received new designer toy product materials from Liu Yang in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group, including sample images of several Pop Mart co-branded blind boxes not yet released in China and videos from the Shenzhen Designer Toy Exhibition. He browsed through them with great interest, replied with his collecting insights, and agreed with Liu Yang to discuss in detail at the gathering on the third day of the Lunar New Year. Liu Yang also mentioned an AR game that their company was about to launch.

events.name: The whole family watches the Spring Festival Gala and stays up for the New Year
events.description: At nearly 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan sat in the living room with his parents watching the Spring Festival Gala, cracking sunflower seeds and commenting on the shows, enjoying a rare moment of leisure. As midnight approached, the sound of fireworks outside gradually grew, and the family exchanged New Year greetings. Lei Mingxuan posted a family photo on Moments with the caption 'May every year bring good health.' He stayed up until 1 a.m. before going to bed, while his parents had already gone to sleep at 12:30 a.m.

start_state.mood: Festive

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of the Lunar New Year, Lei Mingxuan went with his parents to visit relatives and friends, paying New Year calls to his uncle and aunt's homes and feeling the strong family atmosphere. After lunch, he went home to rest. In the afternoon, his younger paternal cousin dragged him into two rounds of Honor of Kings. In the evening, he exchanged New Year greetings with old friends, spending a traditional and warm first day of the Spring Festival. His diet continued to be rich in meat and fish, and his only exercise was walking.

events.name: Get up early to organize Lunar New Year greeting gifts
events.description: On the morning of the first day of Lunar New Year, Lei Mingxuan and his parents organized and prepared gifts for New Year visits at home, including fruit baskets, health products, and pastry gift boxes, and planned the route for the day's visits, intending to first visit his uncle and aunt who live in Pudong. He had gone to bed late the night before and was a little sleepy, so his mother handed him a cup of strong tea.

events.name: Went with my parents to pay New Year's visits at my uncle and aunt's home.
events.description: In the morning, the family of three set off by car and paid New Year visits to his uncle's and aunt's homes in turn. Lei Mingxuan wished the elders a happy New Year, gave gifts, and chatted with his cousins about recent news. Everyone sat together drinking tea and eating snacks, and the atmosphere was lively. His uncle also asked about the business of Lei Mingxuan's clothing store and praised him highly. He had a hearty lunch at his uncle's home; the braised pork hock made Lei Mingxuan have another bowl of rice.

events.name: After lunch, returned home to rest
events.description: After having lunch at his uncle's house at noon, the family returned home at 2 p.m. Lei Mingxuan was a bit tired, so he went to his room and napped for an hour. After waking up, he watched TV sports programs with his father in the living room. His younger male cousin came over and dragged him into playing Honor of Kings together. After losing two games in a row, Lei Mingxuan made an excuse to stop.

events.name: Exchanged New Year greetings with Zhang Wei and Li Na on WeChat.
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan had a 20-minute video call with Zhang Wei and Li Na in the Pudong Three Musketeers group. They exchanged New Year greetings. Zhang Wei showed photos of the lavish New Year's Eve dinner at his parents' home, and Li Na was making dumplings at her home in Hangzhou. The three agreed to find time to get together after the New Year.

events.name: In the evening, accompanied his mother to watch the New Year special.
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan accompanied his mother to watch a Spring Festival special program on a TV channel. While watching, his mother knitted, and Lei Mingxuan scrolled on his phone replying to New Year greeting comments on WeChat Moments. He also ate quite a lot of candy and melon seeds.

start_state.mood: Festive

end_state.location: Home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Cozy and relaxed.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of the Lunar New Year, Lei Mingxuan went with his parents to his maternal uncle's home to pay New Year calls. A deep conversation with his cousin Shen Jie about store transformation opened his eyes, and at her suggestion he settled on a small-step, fast-iteration strategy for the mountain-style functional look. When he got home, he acted decisively, opened a dedicated fund, and transferred 150,000 yuan into it, laying the financial foundation for the post-holiday renovation. That day was both a family connection day and a business milestone.

events.name: Visiting my maternal uncle's home with my parents to pay New Year calls.
events.description: On the morning of the second day of the Lunar New Year, Lei Mingxuan's family took carefully prepared gifts (fruit and health supplements) and drove to his maternal uncle's home in Jing'an District to pay New Year's greetings. The uncle's family welcomed them warmly, and everyone sat around drinking tea, chatting about the changes over the past year. His cousin Shen Jie was also home, and the two were especially close. Lunch was another big meal; the steamed mandarin fish made Lei Mingxuan eat with great relish.

events.name: Had an in-depth discussion with Shen Jie about the store's transformation direction
events.description: In the living room of his uncle's home, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie sat together alone. Shen Jie, drawing on trends observed at Paris Fashion Week during the New Year period, further analyzed the global popularity of the mountain-style techwear trend, and suggested that Lei Mingxuan's store first test the waters with small batches of outdoor-style T-shirts and jackets, while building the concept of 'urban techwear'. Lei Mingxuan agreed with this direction and decided on the spot to set up a special fund to support the renovation. Shen Jie promised to compile a whitelist of suppliers after returning to the company.

events.name: After lunch, record the budget plan in the phone memo
events.description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan sat on the balcony at his uncle's house, basking in the sun, and used his phone's memo app to organize his financial plan: he planned to redeem 50,000 yuan from an index fund in mid-February, reduce unnecessary personal expenses (such as pausing blind box collecting and eating out less), and top up the special fund to 250,000 yuan before the renovation started in March. He screenshotted the plan and sent it to himself for reference.

events.name: After finishing the New Year visits, return home and set up a dedicated fund account.
events.description: In the evening, back at his home in Pudong, Lei Mingxuan immediately used mobile banking (ICBC app) to open a new demand deposit account and transferred 150,000 yuan from his own account into the new account as dedicated funds for the store's upgrade and transformation. After the transfer, he took a screenshot to save the voucher.

events.name: Updated the family asset spreadsheet and recorded the special fund.
events.description: Afterwards, Lei Mingxuan opened the family assets Excel spreadsheet on his laptop, added a new row, listed it separately as 'store renovation special fund,' noted the account number suffix and an initial amount of 150,000 yuan, and noted the source of funds and the planned replenishment time. He saved the updated file to cloud backup.

events.name: In the evening, watch a Lunar New Year movie with my parents.
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan bought a few online movie tickets and watched a Lunar New Year comedy with his parents at home on the projector; the laughs kept coming. After the movie ended, it was nearly midnight, so he washed up briefly and went to bed.
