2025-01.daily_overview: On the third day of the Lunar New Year, Lei Mingxuan had his long-awaited reunion with old high school friends. After a little rest during the day, he spent the evening drinking and chatting happily with Liu Yang and Chen Hao at a restaurant, gaining business inspiration and deep friendship. After dinner, they revisited their alma mater and reminisced about their youth, bringing the Spring Festival holiday to a warm close. The day was spent in joy and nostalgia, leaving Lei Mingxuan energized for the new year, although his weight reached a recent high.

events.name: Resting at Home in the Morning and Preparing for the Evening Gathering
events.description: On the morning of the third day, Lei Mingxuan slept in and woke up naturally at home (9:00). After breakfast, he sorted through the trendy toy information he had collected over the past few days, planning to share it with Liu Yang and Chen Hao in the evening. He also specifically checked the restaurant he had booked and confirmed it was correct. At noon, his mother made plain noodle soup, and he ate two bowls, broth and all.

events.name: Communicated with Shen Jie on WeChat about the detailed store plan
events.description: In the afternoon, Shen Jie sent a preliminary outline for outdoor brand research via WeChat. Lei Mingxuan had a 20-minute voice call with her, discussed the tone of several potential partner brands, and agreed to visit some outdoor multi-brand stores in Shanghai together after the New Year.

events.name: Arrived at the restaurant early in the evening to welcome classmates.
events.description: A little after 5 p.m., Lei Mingxuan put on his newly bought casual jacket and arrived early at the private room he had reserved in the Shanghainese restaurant. He checked the room setup, ordered cold dishes and drinks, and waited for Chen Hao and Liu Yang.

events.name: High school classmates reunited during the Spring Festival.
events.description: At 6 p.m., Chen Hao and Liu Yang arrived one after another, and the three shook hands and hugged excitedly. The dinner went on in a lively atmosphere as everyone tasted Shanghai cuisine and chatted freely about their recent lives. Liu Yang shared more details about the new designer toys and revealed that his game company was looking for a co-branding supplier for Chinese-style clothing, encouraging Lei Mingxuan to expand his online business; Chen Hao shared updates on the internet industry in Hangzhou. Lei Mingxuan also told them about his store renovation plan, and everyone offered suggestions. The gathering lasted three hours. Lei Mingxuan paid the bill, and friendship and business opportunities were intertwined. During the dinner, Lei Mingxuan ate quite a few dishes and also drank two bottles of beer.

events.name: After dinner, strolled around the alma mater and reminisced about youth.
events.description: After the meal, the three of them took a walk to their old high school. The campus was empty and quiet because of the Spring Festival holiday. They went to the basketball hoop on the playground and reminisced about the days they used to play ball. Lei Mingxuan sighed at how time flew, but their friendship remained unchanged. They took a group photo with their phones and agreed to meet again next year. About forty minutes later, they said goodbye and went home.

events.name: After returning home, sorted out the party photos and posted them on Moments.
events.description: It was almost 11 p.m. when he got home. Lei Mingxuan posted the gathering photos and alma mater photos on Moments with the caption 'Old friends for ten years, still young at heart.' He chatted a few more lines with Chen Hao and Liu Yang in the group, then washed up and rested, bringing the Spring Festival holiday to an end. Lying in bed, he was still savoring the day's gathering and felt a little excited, so he fell asleep late.

events.name: Receive the advanced pour-over coffee certificate and verify it with hands-on practice.

He invited his father, who was watching TV, and his mother, who was preparing lunch, to taste it, using the flavor wheel to guide them in distinguishing citrus and jasmine floral notes. Lei Mingxuan recorded the suggestions in his phone memo and agreed to discuss them further during next week's display adjustment.

2025-08.daily_overview: After the color difference dispute subsided, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to strengthen the supply chain relationship. He dialed Zhou Tao's number in the shop to express thanks. The 45-minute conversation not only reviewed the lessons learned from the incident, but also extended to each other's growing-up backgrounds and family stories, greatly deepening trust in the business relationship. Zhou Tao promised to increase pre-shipment quality inspections and give priority to Lei Mingxuan for future product selection. The business partner thus became a close personal friend. In the evening, encouraged by the highly liked science post, Lei Mingxuan suddenly felt a surge of creative inspiration. He opened a dusty document and tried writing the opening of the historical novel "The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane," writing late into the night and still feeling he hadn't had enough.

events.name: Called Zhou Tao to thank him and strengthen mutual trust in the partnership.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan dialed Zhou Tao's phone in the store's rest area. He first thanked Lao Zhou for his understanding and promise regarding the color-difference issue, then, in the tone of asking for advice, inquired how to reduce color variation in handmade goods from the source. Zhou Tao explained in detail the current situation of the old dyeing workshops in Wenzhou, Zhejiang, where he was from, and his words betrayed his regret over the decline of traditional craftsmanship. Lei Mingxuan then brought up how his mother had come to Shanghai alone from Nantong when she was young to make a living, and the warmth of the whole family's recent health plan. The two found more and more common ground, and Zhou Tao confided that his parents having no one to care for them in Wenzhou had always been a hidden pain for him, and that he admired Lei Mingxuan's family atmosphere. Finally, Zhou Tao solemnly promised that from now on every batch shipped to 'Xiafei Ji' would include an additional sampling inspection step, and gave Lei Mingxuan the right to preview new products online twice per season. Lei Mingxuan thanked him repeatedly and agreed to visit him in person during his business trip to Hangzhou next week.

events.description: At ten in the evening, Lei Mingxuan sat down at his desk after washing up. He had planned to review Japanese, but couldn't help rereading his own Xiaohongshu science post and readers' comments. A strong urge to tell stories surged up. He created a new document and rapidly typed out the title of the first chapter of 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Fang,' weaving in his mother's struggles in her youth and the old Shanghai stories of Aunt Zhu next door. Before he knew it, he had written nearly two thousand characters, and the clock had passed midnight. It wasn't until the cat A Fu jumped onto the keyboard that he realized how late it was. He hastily saved, yet felt an unprecedented sense of exhilaration.

He introduced in detail his concept for the integrated complex: combining pour-over coffee, designer-toy blind boxes, and clothing sales. Zhang Wei did precise calculations with a pen on a napkin, pointing out that the initial renovation would cost at least 250,000 yuan, monthly operating costs would increase by 20,000 yuan, and daily sales would need to rise by 15% to break even. He directly asked whether Lei Mingxuan could guarantee such growth. Lei Mingxuan was stumped and realized he needed a detailed business plan.

Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer in the study to review the store's sales revenue and cost structure over the past year, listed the key points that needed to be calculated, and prepared for the business plan. He worked until 0:30 in the morning and, due to fatigue, forgot to do his daily Japanese check-in.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday, Lei Mingxuan's follow-up physical examination still showed high blood lipids. The doctor gave a serious warning, and this became a turning point in his health management. He resolved to strictly follow his morning running plan and adjust his daily routine. At the same time, he sketched a store renovation plan to prepare for communicating with property management, and in the evening officially began writing his business plan.

events.name: Went to the hospital to have blood drawn for a lipid recheck.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Lei Mingxuan went alone to the physical examination center at the East Campus of Renji Hospital for a follow-up blood lipid test. While waiting for the results, he dealt with store WeChat messages and had a vague premonition about the outcome.

events.name: Doctor's Warning Mandates Morning Running Plan
events.description: In the afternoon, he got the report. The doctor pointed out that his blood lipids were still above the warning line and warned that if they went any higher, he would develop moderate fatty liver disease, so he must exercise systematically. Lei Mingxuan was deeply affected and decided on the spot to start a systematic morning running routine from the next morning, at least four times a week for no less than 30 minutes each time. He also set his alarm for 6:00 the next morning.

events.name: Drew a preliminary sketch of the store renovation plan.
events.description: After returning from the hospital to the shop, Lei Mingxuan conceived the design of the cafe experience area, drew preliminary renovation sketches in the study, marked the coffee bar location, rest area, and display adjustment areas, and listed a materials checklist, considering fire escape routes and electrical load.

events.name: Write the first draft of the business plan in the evening.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer and began writing a business plan, organizing the industry data collected over the past few days into chapters, drafting the executive summary and market analysis sections, and scheduling his writing time from 9 to 11 p.m. to ensure he got enough sleep.

2025-11.daily_overview: The Shanghai Outdoor Camping Festival opened. Lei Mingxuan, as an exhibitor, set up a booth outside the mall on Century Avenue, showcasing trendy outdoor outfits and pour-over coffee experiences. He got up early in the morning to complete his daily routine. The morning was bustling with visitors, and in the afternoon a sudden shower came, which he handled cleverly. Manager Liu, a representative of a camping coffee equipment brand, became interested in his hybrid model and proactively left contact information. After a busy day, he went home to organize his supplies, excited and exhausted.

events.name: Morning routine and departure for the exhibition
events.description: After getting up at 6:45, Lei Mingxuan quickly brewed a cup of pour-over single-origin Ethiopian coffee in the kitchen while opening Duolingo to complete his Japanese check-in. After refilling the cat A Fu's food bowl, he took the carefully selected clothing samples and coffee equipment and took the subway to the exhibition plaza.

After the exhibition officially opened at 9:00, he demonstrated the waterproof test of the shell jacket to visitors, invited them to taste pour-over coffee, and guided them to scan a QR code to join the store's community. The booth was constantly surrounded by trendy people and family customers.

events.description: At 2:30 pm, a moderate rain suddenly fell, and the booth canopy leaked at the seams. Lei Mingxuan quickly took out his own spare tarp to reinforce the cover, and without missing a beat, showed the onlookers the waterproof fabric performance of the clothing on site, saying humorously, "This is our signature waterproof and breathable fabric—no need to fear the rain." The accident instead attracted more people to stop by. Manager Liu, the representative of the camping coffee equipment brand nearby, saw this, took the initiative to come over and talk, left a business card, and proposed a consignment partnership, agreeing to discuss details next week.

2025-11.daily_overview: Today Lei Mingxuan had the long-awaited city orienteering race. He left in a hurry in the morning without making pour-over coffee and did his Japanese check-in on the subway. He met his teammates at Expo Source, warmed up, and ran along both banks of the Huangpu River, checking in at historic buildings such as the Old Wharf and Nanshi Power Plant. The team worked well together and ultimately finished fifth in their group. After the race, he shared his joy on Moments and received many likes from friends. While organizing photos in the afternoon, he also admitted that he had recently stopped working out regularly; this race was more of an occasional bout of exercise, and the slight drop on the scale might be dehydration. He reminded himself to get back into regular training.

events.name: Pre-competition assembly and warm-up
events.description: Got up at 6:15 a.m., had a quick breakfast of the sandwich and milk prepared by his mother, and at 6:40 rode a shared bike to Expo Source Square. He arrived at 6:55, met up with teammates Lao Zhang, A Jie, and new partner Xiao Chen, and picked up their number bibs, timing chips, and task sheets. The four followed the event warm-up leader through a 15-minute full-body dynamic stretch and jogging warm-up, and team captain Lao Zhang stressed safety points and the checkpoint order at the end.

events.name: Full orienteering race
events.description: The starting gun fired at exactly 8:00, and Lei Mingxuan's Team 4 set off along the planned route. They checked in at Shipyard 1862 on the Pudong riverside and the former Lujiazui Fire Station (bonus task: pose as firefighters carrying a hose for a photo), then took the ferry to the Puxi side of the Bund, weaving through the North Building of the Peace Hotel and the old warehouse complex at the Old Wharf. At checkpoint 10, they found an old streetlamp hidden behind a brick wall. Lei Mingxuan, relying on his sense of direction, handled the navigation and took shortcuts several times. The team finally completed all 10 checkpoints and 2 bonus tasks in 2 hours and 17 minutes, finishing fifth in the group (out of 28 teams). At the finish line, he high-fived his teammates, and drenched in sweat, they took their first finish photo together.

events.name: Shared the competition experience on Moments.
events.description: At 12:30 pm, Lei Mingxuan got home, simply had a bowl of noodles, then selected 9 photos and color-adjusted them with Meitu, captioning: "Finished the half marathon in 2h17min along both banks of the Huangpu River; my lungs and heart were cursing me. But running past century-old buildings with teammates made the sweat worth it! #CityOrienteering #OldFriendsNewCourse". After posting, he received likes and comments from Zhang Wei, Song Jia, Han Dong, Qin Lang, and others. He replied to each one. Han Dong teased, "You should practice long-distance running," Song Jia said, "Next time, let's form a roller-skating cheerleading squad," and his social circle was lively and warm.

events.name: Exercise enthusiasm and reflection on the interruption
events.description: After sorting out the photos in the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan checked his WeChat Sports records and found that only today and the exhibition on the 2nd this month counted as decent exercise. He looked at the fitness goals he set at the beginning of the year, observed his slightly slack abdomen in the mirror, and wrote in his phone memo: 'The orienteering race proves my fitness isn't completely ruined, but regular training must restart. From December, run at least three times a week.' Then he didn't take immediate action; instead, he lay lazily in bed scrolling through anime on Bilibili. This exercise did not directly translate into sustained motivation to work out.

2025-11.daily_overview: Lei Mingxuan officially began preparations for upgrading his brand multi-store. In the morning, he organized detailed materials and a budget framework in the store; in the afternoon, he invited freelance designer Liu Tao for an on-site survey and discussed the renovation plan. However, the designer's complete proposal came with a budget as high as 350,000 yuan, 30% more than expected, which put real financial pressure on him. That night, he tossed and turned thinking about how to raise funds. The soreness and tightness in his neck had worsened during the day. While searching online for relief videos, he saw a recommendation for meditation and decided to try it.

events.name: Organize the store upgrade plan and budget framework.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was in the office inside the store, organizing the scattered ideas from the past few months into an 8-page Xiafei Collection Multi-Brand Store Upgrade Plan, including customer flow analysis, functional zoning, and an initial budget of 270,000 yuan. He marked the dimensions of each area with a CAD sketch and printed out several reference renderings. After sitting at his desk for a long time, the stiffness in his neck spread to his shoulders, forcing him to get up and move around every half hour.

events.description: At 2 PM, the designer Liu Tao arrived at the shop. Lei Mingxuan walked him around and explained the requirements in detail: keep the industrial-style tone, strengthen the lighting layers, and customize modular display racks. Liu Tao quickly drew a floor plan with a laser rangefinder and verbally proposed a plan that included custom stainless steel hanging racks, a coffee bar counter, and a movable wooden crate activity area. But the calculated all-inclusive budget was about 350,000 yuan, and Lei Mingxuan gasped. He asked Liu Tao to produce design renderings first and said he needed to reassess the budget, clearly feeling the pressure.

events.name: Anxiety-driven insomnia and searching for ways to relieve it.

His father suggested not rushing into major changes and using simple materials for the renovation instead. But Lei Mingxuan was already unsettled inside. That night, lying in bed, he couldn't fall asleep for a long time, numbers churning in his mind. He picked up his phone and searched for "relief for neck soreness and stiffness," saved a few stretching tutorials and guided meditation audio, and tried following along with 10 minutes of deep breathing. He didn't drift off until 0:30.

His father noticed that he hadn't exercised for days and looked low on energy, and reminded him to watch his health. In the afternoon, he prepared the application materials and booked an appointment with the account manager at SPD Bank for tomorrow morning. In the evening, he continued editing his novel in the study, but his neck hurt badly. events.name: Cash flow calculation and loan decision
events.description: At 10 a.m., Lei Mingxuan sat at his computer and used Excel to pull up the itemized figures: the store's current account had about 100,000 yuan, his personal savings 50,000 yuan, and his parents could lend him 50,000 yuan temporarily, but he was still 200,000 yuan short of launching Liu Tao's full plan. After discussing with his father, who happened to be home resting, Lei Jianguo supported trying a bank loan first, but looking at the dark circles under his eyes, he said, "Take your time with the money. Have you been losing weight lately? Have you not been exercising properly? Your belly's gotten bigger instead." Lei Mingxuan gave an awkward smile and rubbed his sore neck.

events.name: Prepare bank loan materials
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan went to the store to pick up a copy of the business license, the store's bank statements for the past six months, and his personal credit report, then photocopied and organized them at home. During this time, he also called a friend who worked in finance to confirm the key points for the self-employed business application. The friend reminded him that the policy had recently tightened and collateral might be required. Lei Mingxuan's heart sank, but he still prepared all the materials one by one and put them into a document folder.

events.name: Novel writing and neck physiotherapy.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and continued writing Chapter 8 of "The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane." He was describing the scene where the protagonist's home is burglarized during the Spring Festival of 1946, but after less than half an hour of writing, his neck hurt so much that he couldn't concentrate, so he had to lie down and apply a hot compress. Then he opened the yoga video he had saved that morning and followed along with 10 minutes of neck-specific stretches. After the pain eased, he continued writing and completed nearly 2,000 characters.

start_state.mood: Pressure coexists with decisiveness

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area

2025-11.daily_overview: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan went to SPD Bank full of hope to submit his loan application, but was mercilessly rejected due to unstable cash flow. A sense of frustration hung over him. He returned to the store in the afternoon and turned stress into appetite, eating an entire bag of chips and chocolate. After adjusting his mood, he revised his plan: he decided to significantly cut the physical renovation budget and instead focus on online mini-program development and the necessary coffee area renovation. In the evening, he stayed home alone watching Cowboy Bebop: The Movie, soothing his emotions with the film and coffee, then completed a full set of neck stretches and meditation, feeling a long-missed sense of relaxation. Late at night, he called his younger cousin Shen Jie to pour out his worries, received encouragement, and resolved to start fresh the next day.

events.name: Loan application rejected
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan, dressed in formal attire, went to the Pudong Sub-branch of SPD Bank. After waiting half an hour in the credit department, he met the manager. The manager flipped through the materials and pointed out that his store's cash flow fluctuated greatly and, without property collateral, the risk was uncontrollable. After more than ten minutes of communication, the manager shook his head and handed the materials back. Lei Mingxuan sat blankly on a chair in the bank hall for a while, then left helplessly, feeling dejected.

events.name: Emotional eating and adjustment plan.
events.description: In the afternoon, back at the store, Lei Mingxuan felt a surge of inexplicable anger. He opened the small snacks prepared for customers at the counter and wolfed down a whole large bag of potato chips and a few chocolates. After calming down, he deleted the original design drawings and replaced them with the following plan: only renovate the coffee experience area and the designer toy display wall (keeping the budget within 50,000 yuan), and redirect the 150,000 yuan originally set aside for renovation toward accelerating the development of the online mini program. He then contacted Chen Lei, a freelance developer he had worked with before, moved the deadline to mid-December, and agreed on a quote of 12,000 yuan for the additional features.

events.name: Movie night and self-healing
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan closed his door and played Cowboy Bebop: The Movie on the projector. He deliberately brewed a pot of Colombian coffee. With Spike's flight path and the jazz, he gradually relaxed. After the movie, he followed a video and did a 15-minute neck stretch and meditation session, which greatly relieved the stiffness in his shoulders and neck. Late at night, he couldn't help sending a voice message to his cousin Shen Jie, pouring out his frustration about the rejected loan. Shen Jie comforted him: “A blessing in disguise — taking your business online has more of a future.” Lei Mingxuan's confidence was reignited. He posted a Moments update saying “Everything will be okay” before going to sleep.

start_state.mood: With hope but also hidden concerns

end_state.location: At home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area
end_state.mood: Disappointed but at ease, renewing my determination

2025-11.daily_overview: Today Lei Mingxuan reaped multiple gains. He got up early, completed his morning routine, and did neck stretches; the scale showed that he had crossed 81kg for the first time, but his mood was unaffected. In the morning, the co-branded blind boxes arrived. He was thrilled to pull a hidden figure and immediately arranged the store's blind box area, then took photos and posted them on Xiaohongshu, attracting likes. In the afternoon, he had a video call with his childhood friend Zhang Wei. After reviewing the upgrade proposal, Zhang Wei suggested implementing it in phases and promised to help connect him with a contract manufacturer. In the early evening, he finalized the participant list for the end-of-month camping trip and shared a new chapter in the novel group. Later in the evening, after contacting the mini-program developer to finalize the schedule, he went home alone to enjoy the dinner his parents had left for him, then reviewed the day, soaked his feet, and recorded expenses late at night. Since he was tired from the day, he went to bed at 23:30. Neck stretching has become a habit, but his body still felt tired.

events.name: Morning routine and weight warning
events.description: He got up at 6:45. Despite not getting enough sleep, Lei Mingxuan still brewed himself a cup of Yirgacheffe pour-over and completed his daily Japanese study check-in. After filling the cat Afu's food bowl, he did a 10-minute neck stretch in front of the mirror. Then he stepped on the scale and frowned at the 81.0 kg number, but with important matters on his mind today, he put it aside.

events.name: The blind box arrived and unboxing revealed the hidden figure
events.description: At 10 AM, the SF Express courier delivered two boxes of the collaboration blind boxes to the store. Lei Mingxuan carefully opened them behind the counter, and in the first box he pulled the hidden figure, No. 067 Steam Owl. He let out an excited 'wow.' He immediately placed the hidden figure at the highest spot in the designer toy area, paired it with the techwear vest and cargo pants he was wearing that day, and took a set of 'Unlocking the Steam Era' themed photos with his phone.

events.name: Post blind-box outfit content on Xiaohongshu
events.description: At 11 a.m., Lei Mingxuan imported the photos he had just taken into his phone, used the Xingtu app to add a gear filter and vintage frame, and wrote: "The steampunk collab I grabbed on Double 11 finally arrived! The hidden brass gear actually spins, and it oddly matches my techwear vest. The store now has three items from the same series—collectors are welcome to come trade. #PopMart #Steampunk #TechwearStyle". Within less than an hour of posting, it received 73 likes. Someone in the comments asked about the price of the vest, and he immediately replied and directed them to private messages.

events.name: Video call with Zhang Wei to review the proposal.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan initiated a WeChat video call to his childhood friend Zhang Wei. He shared his screen to present the newly revised upgrade plan. After reading it, Zhang Wei pointed out: “Investing everything at once is too risky. I suggest you first renovate with the existing shelves, and put the saved money into a mini-program and a pop-up event to test the market. I know a few contract manufacturers in the FMCG industry and can help you find cheap, good display props.” Lei Mingxuan readily accepted, and Zhang Wei promised to provide the contacts next week.

events.name: Confirmed participants for the camping activity.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lei Mingxuan opened the camping activity group, tallied the sign-ups, and finally confirmed 12 people (including himself): childhood friend Zhang Wei, high school classmate Chen Hao, sports buddies Han Dong and Xie Fei, roller skating partner Song Jia, regular customer Qian Duoduo, college classmate Zhao Min, and others. He sent each person the electronic final itinerary and equipment suggestions via private message, and coordinated carpooling.

events.name: Novel sharing and finalizing the mini program
events.description: At 6 p.m., Lei Mingxuan posted the novel excerpt he had written the previous night to the "Shanghai History Pen Friends Club" group asking for feedback. After receiving multiple revision suggestions, his inspiration came flooding in, and he planned to update again next week. At 8 p.m., freelance developer Chen Lei sent over the adjusted development schedule; the total development period was compressed to four weeks, with the test version to be delivered on December 15. Lei Mingxuan confirmed the milestones via DingTalk on his phone and paid the first installment of 6,000 yuan.

events.name: Late-night review and foot soaking
events.description: In the evening, because he had been busy during the day, his parents left dinner for him. After arriving home alone, Lei Mingxuan reheated the food, ate simply, then soaked his feet in hot water, briefly recorded the day's diet (but forgot to log the dessert), and reviewed the day's achievements. As the excitement faded, he felt physically exhausted. He turned off the lights and went to bed at 23:30, not forgetting to do a short set of neck stretches before sleeping.

2025-11.daily_overview: Early Sunday morning, Lei Mingxuan reorganized the blind box display area in the store, using the scarcity of hidden blind boxes to promote on social media, successfully attracting both online and offline customer traffic and driving sales. In the afternoon, he and his basketball buddies including Xie Fei took part in a community basketball game at Yuanshen Sports Center, sweating it out and relieving stress. After the game, the group chatted at the courtside and agreed to play again next month. In the evening, he had a celebratory dinner with his parents at a local Shanghainese restaurant near home, feeling the warmth of family. After returning home, faced with the reality of the rejected loan, he calmly adjusted the renovation plan for the store upgrade, contacted the designer to cut the budget, and shifted funding to store cash flow and his own capital.

events.name: Morning neck stretching
events.description: After getting up, his neck still felt a bit sore and swollen. Lei Mingxuan lay in bed and followed a 10-minute neck yoga stretching routine on his phone, feeling his muscles loosen up a bit.

events.name: Organizing the blind box display area and social media promotion to drive sales.
events.description: After opening the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan focused on rearranging the trendy-toy blind box display area. He placed the steampunk co-branded hidden-edition blind box he had grabbed during the Double 11 shopping festival in the most prominent position and adjusted the spotlights to focus the light. He took multiple detail photos and short videos with his phone, carefully edited them, and posted them to WeChat Moments, a trendy-toy collector WeChat group, and Xiaohongshu, sharing the excitement of unboxing and the design highlights of the hidden edition. Starting in the afternoon, collectors who left online messages began to ask questions via WeChat private chat, and passers-by were also attracted into the store by the display. Lei Mingxuan replied and introduced items enthusiastically one by one, taking the opportunity to show the store's trendy-toy T-shirts and caps, and successfully sold 2 co-branded T-shirts and 1 regular blind box on the spot.

events.name: Basketball pre-game warm-up preparation
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan arrived at the outdoor court at Yuanshen Sports Center with his sports backpack, changed into basketball jersey and shoes, and greeted early-arriving ballmates such as Xie Fei. Together they did warm-up exercises like high knees, lunge stretches, and dynamic stretching, then practiced passing and catching in pairs and took turns doing spot shooting drills. While practicing, they discussed today's tactical assignments and gradually got into game mode.

events.name: Play in a community recreational basketball game
events.description: After warming up, Lei Mingxuan and five fellow players including Xie Fei formed a team and started a self-organized community basketball game. The game was half-court with a four-on-four rotation. Although Lei Mingxuan had recently interrupted his systematic training due to store matters and his stamina had dipped slightly, his shooting touch was good; several mid-range jump shots and one steal-and-fast-break layup all went in cleanly. The whole team played well together, chatting and laughing, enjoying the pure fun of basketball.

events.name: Rest after the match and scheduling the next match
events.description: After the nearly hour-long friendly match, Lei Mingxuan, Xie Fei, and the others rested on benches by the court and rehydrated. As they wiped away sweat, they savored the exciting rallies just played, praised each other's performances, and joked about each other's mistakes. Lei Mingxuan suggested organizing another match in mid-next month, both to maintain everyone's exercise routine and to strengthen their bond. Everyone responded enthusiastically and set a preliminary time right away in the small WeChat group.

events.name: Family celebration dinner
events.description: In the evening, to celebrate the success of the blind box marketing and the smooth progress of the project, Lei Mingxuan had dinner with his parents at a Shanghainese restaurant near home. He ordered dishes his parents liked, and the family enjoyed a warm and happy time together. His father, Lei Jianguo, raised a glass to toast his thriving career, while his mother reminded him to take care of his health no matter how busy he was. After dinner, the family walked home, and Lei Mingxuan felt the warmth and support of home.

events.name: Adjust the store upgrade and renovation plan.
events.description: At home in the evening, in response to the bank loan rejection, Lei Mingxuan took out the renovation plan and budget sheet again. He called designer Liu Tao and clearly changed the originally planned coffee experience area into a temporary pop-up spot (saving about 40,000 yuan), and also reduced the trendy-toy area and switched to low-cost metal shelves (saving about 20,000 yuan), strictly keeping the total budget within 280,000 yuan. At the same time, he decided to stop relying on loans and instead pay in installments from the store's daily revenue and his own working capital, and suspended all non-essential custom furniture purchases.

Another online collector who had booked an appointment also arrived as expected. Nearly half of the day's in-store customers were attracted by the blind box display, and Lei Mingxuan leveraged the art toy enthusiasm to drive related sales of clothing and accessories.

events.name: Pre-Opening Display Fine-Tuning and Online Maintenance
events.description: After arriving at the store at 9:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan checked the unread WeChat messages from the previous night and replied to several customers who had inquired about blind boxes late at night. He then tidied the shelves, restocked the T-shirts that had been sold the day before, and rearranged a techwear-style blind box outfit in the styling area to make it more eye-catching. He also took a new photo of the display area with his phone and posted it to the blind box interest group with the caption, "A new week, the hidden figure continues to wait for someone who appreciates it."

events.name: Morning neck stretching and walking commute
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Lei Mingxuan did a 10-minute neck stretch and felt a little better than yesterday. He then walked to the store, using his phone to count steps along the way, starting the day's accumulation of 10,000 commuter steps.

events.name: Regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store to talk and made a purchase.
events.description: Around 2 p.m., regular customer Qian Duoduo saw the Moments post and came to the store out of curiosity. Lei Mingxuan took out the physical hidden-edition blind box and let her feel it. He also introduced the series' backstory, design details, and his own collecting insights in detail. The two chatted about designer toy collecting for about 40 minutes. Qian Duoduo couldn't put down the hidden edition and bought two regular blind boxes from the same series and a co-branded hoodie on the spot, and said she would help promote it on her social media.

events.name: Online collector friends came to the store to buy designer toys and accessories.
events.description: Shortly after seeing off Qian Duoduo, a collector who had made an appointment on WeChat two weeks earlier arrived at the store on time. Lei Mingxuan greeted him just as warmly, not only showing him the hidden edition but also guiding him through a new batch of trendy accessories that had just arrived, including earrings, necklaces, and more. The collector picked out a steampunk blind box and a pair of gear-shaped earrings, praised the store's taste, and added the store's WeChat to keep up with future updates.

events.name: Customer guidance and full-day sales summary
events.description: Throughout the day, Lei Mingxuan received about five groups of customers, three of which were new faces who came in after seeing the blind box display. He used every reception opportunity to naturally transition from the blind box topic to introducing the store's techwear clothing and designer toy accessories, successfully converting several sales. Before closing in the evening, he quickly reviewed the day's sales and found that blind boxes and related products contributed about 60% of the revenue, further strengthening his confidence in the 'designer toys + clothing' composite display.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lei Mingxuan talked with fabric supplier Zhou Tao on the phone about the order requirements for the brand upgrade. Facing the pressure of a 30% advance deposit, he decided to postpone it and look for alternatives. At the store, the mystery box topic remained popular, so he used WeChat to create a temporary interest group for operations. In the afternoon, a regular customer, Feng Xiaoyu, came to the store to show support during her business trip, and several new customers who had discovered the store via Xiaohongshu also came. That evening, he also contacted his college classmate Wang Lei to finalize the coffee course appointment.

events.name: Discussed the order with fabric supplier Zhou Tao over the phone.
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan had a phone conversation with Zhou Tao, his main fabric supplier, in the small office behind the store. He explained in detail the positioning upgrade plan for the brand collection store and hoped to increase orders for high-quality fabrics and a small number of co-branded items. Zhou Tao expressed support, but suggested that he visit the Hangzhou factory in March next year to discuss the specific cooperation plan in person. He also stressed that new orders would require a 30% advance deposit to lock in production capacity. Considering the current tight cash flow, Lei Mingxuan replied that he needed to calculate more carefully. The two agreed to confirm the initial order quantity in early December. After hanging up, Lei Mingxuan wrote down a reminder to find alternative suppliers in his notebook.

events.name: Create a blind box interest group and interact online
events.description: After the previous two days of promotion, online inquiries increased. In the morning, Lei Mingxuan pulled more than a dozen enthusiastic collectors into a newly created blind box interest WeChat group, shared more photos of in-store trendy toys and clothing combinations in the group, and answered various questions about the difference between hidden and regular editions. He also livened up the atmosphere by launching a mini-game of "guess the blind box weight to win a discount," and the group members responded enthusiastically.

events.name: Regular customer Feng Xiaoyu came to the store to chat and made a purchase.
events.description: In the afternoon, Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer he had met before, happened to be on a business trip to Shanghai and dropped by the store. She showed great interest in the design stories behind the hidden blind boxes. Combining his own collection experience, Lei Mingxuan gave a vivid explanation, starting with the illustrators and then the collaboration backgrounds. Although Feng Xiaoyu did not buy a blind box, she was attracted by the new dresses in the store. After trying them on, she bought two, saying she wanted to support Lei Mingxuan's business, and promised to spread the word among her colleagues in Suzhou.

events.name: New customer visit after hearing about the store, and styling consultation
events.description: After Feng Xiaoyu left, three young unfamiliar customers came to the store, all of whom had come specifically after seeing the blind box post on Xiaohongshu. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically served as their shopping guide, mainly introducing how to pair the blind boxes with the store's trendy techwear outfit ideas. Two of the customers each bought an outfit (jacket + pants), and the other bought 3 blind boxes. The day's sales were about 1,200 yuan, showing a clear synergy between designer toys and clothing.

events.name: Contact a college classmate to book a coffee course
events.description: After closing the store in the evening, Lei Mingxuan contacted his college classmate Wang Lei via WeChat to get more details about the coffee studio Wang Lei had previously recommended, including its specific address, course schedule, and fees. Wang Lei quickly sent the detailed information and the owner's WeChat contact card. Lei Mingxuan then communicated with the studio manager by phone and confirmed signing up for the introductory pour-over coffee course on the evenings of November 19 and 26, preparing to improve the professionalism of the store's coffee experience area. Before bed, he also browsed some basic pour-over coffee videos online, making him fall asleep a bit later than usual.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Lei Mingxuan continued to deepen blind box community operations in the store, launched a share-your-order activity, and organized a small on-site collector exchange, attracting more new customers. In the evening, he went to the coffee studio for his first pour-over coffee class and, under the teacher's guidance, made a full pot of pour-over coffee for the first time. During the day, he also used spare moments to put together a written summary of the recent store upgrade, and talked with his mother about financial pressure, receiving a promise of temporary financial support from her.

events.name: Blind box community event and on-site exchange
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan sorted through the sales data and customer feedback from the previous days, rearranged the store's blind box area, and added more designer toy merchandise and styling reference photos. At noon, he launched a “Share Your Order and Get a Gift” activity in the blind box interest group, encouraging customers who had already purchased to take photos, share, and @ the store; the first three would receive a small gift. In the afternoon, three group members from the same city happened to meet at the store. Lei Mingxuan spontaneously organized a small unboxing gathering, sharing his unboxing tips and collecting journey, and the atmosphere was lively. Later, two young women visiting for the first time were drawn in by the lively atmosphere and each bought 1 blind box after learning more. About 10 customers came to the store throughout the day, 7 of whom had come directly because of the blind box topic.

events.name: Video-guided shopping with an online collector friend
events.description: During a break in store traffic, Lei Mingxuan also held a WeChat video call with a collector friend from Hangzhou. Holding up his phone, he gave the friend a 'cloud shopping' tour of the store, showing different blind boxes in detail and recommending matching outfits based on the friend's preferences. Although the collector didn't place an order that day, he was impressed by the store's product selection and Lei Mingxuan's enthusiasm, and said he would definitely come to the store next time he is in Shanghai.

events.name: Organize the written summary for the upgrade preparations and seek mother's support
events.description: In the evening, during a slow period at the shop, Lei Mingxuan organized this week's upgrade preparation work on the computer at the cash register and put together a simple written summary, including designer plan adjustments, financial responses after the loan rejection, acceleration of mini-program development, and supplier communication results. He made a plan for next week: finalize the renovation design, contact other loan channels (such as small loan companies), nail down the prepayment ratio with Zhou Tao, and start the mini-program UI design. Returning home with these thoughts, he had an honest conversation with his mother, Wang Xiuying, in the living room about recent financial pressure. She immediately said she could temporarily provide 50,000 yuan from her savings and told him not to worry.

events.name: First lesson in pour-over coffee
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived on time at the coffee studio in Pudong New Area that Wang Lei had introduced. The coffee instructor, Instructor Chen, first explained the basics of coffee bean origins, roast levels, and grind sizes, then focused on guiding him through pour-over practice: how to control the pouring water flow, water temperature (88–92°C), and bloom time (30 seconds). Lei Mingxuan concentrated intently through about two hours of repeated attempts and finally brewed a cup of coffee with good balance. Tasting his first creation, he felt both curious and fulfilled.

events.name: Morning neck stretches and reflection
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Lei Mingxuan did his daily 10-minute neck stretch. Today his shoulders and neck felt much lighter, and it seems that persisting has paid off. He silently resolved to keep this small habit even amid a busy schedule.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, his mother Wang Xiuying came to the store early in the morning to help tidy up the place. At noon, mother and son shared the nutritious lunch she had prepared with her own hands. In the afternoon, before leaving, she quietly slipped Lei Mingxuan 20,000 yuan from her private savings to help him out, which moved him deeply. In the evening, after returning home, Lei Mingxuan budgeted the money into his accounts, paid the final installment for the Double Eleven blind box and the price of the ukulele and other items, and set up an emergency fund for store upgrades. Meanwhile, the blind box campaign entered its last day; he focused on following up with potential customers and began preparing for the Christmas event.

events.name: Mother came to the store to help and had lunch together.
events.description: At 10 a.m., his mother Wang Xiuying came to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store in the Century Avenue Mall and immediately started helping without asking: tidying the clothes on the racks, checking inventory tags, wiping the display cabinets with a rag, and sweeping the floor. Lei Mingxuan attended to customers nearby, and the mother and son exchanged bits of everyday conversation, working together in perfect harmony. At noon, Wang Xiuying took out a low-oil, high-protein lunch she had carefully prepared at home, including braised pork belly with less oil, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and fresh fruit salad. The two ate together in the small rest area behind the store. During the meal, his mother asked in detail about how the store was doing. Lei Mingxuan shared everything, and his mother felt both proud and concerned, repeatedly encouraging him to hold on to his dream.

events.name: Mother privately gave 20,000 yuan.
events.description: In the afternoon, when his mother was about to go home, she took advantage of there being no other customers in the store to take out a kraft paper envelope from her bag and quietly slip it into Lei Mingxuan's hand, whispering, "Don't let your father know." She said it was 20,000 yuan she had saved privately over the years, knowing that he had been worried about the store upgrade recently, and she hoped to help him at a critical moment. Lei Mingxuan was stunned at first, then his eyes reddened, he hugged his mother tightly, all words stuck in his heart, and he only said, "Thanks, Mom." His mother patted his back, smiled, and left.

events.name: Financial planning and fund receipt.
events.description: After closing the store and returning home at 9 PM, Lei Mingxuan sat down at the desk in his bedroom, opened the family ledger, and recorded the 20,000 yuan cash given by his mother as extra income. After thinking it over, he decided to set aside 10,000 yuan as an emergency fund for store upgrades, transferring it via mobile banking to a dedicated savings account. The remaining 10,000 yuan was immediately used to pay the balance payment for the limited blind boxes he had pre-ordered during Double 11 (about 2,500 yuan) and the cost of a second-hand ukulele (about 800 yuan). After the transfers, he took screenshots and saved the receipts. He then updated his daily expense budget for late November and December based on the remaining balance of about 6,700 yuan, and separately noted that next month's budget for the store's online mini-program development must be no less than 8,000 yuan, to ensure the cash flow would not break.

events.name: Final day of the blind box event promotion and Christmas preparations
events.description: Daytime foot traffic was slightly lower than the previous two days, but there were still occasional online inquiries. Lei Mingxuan focused on following up with potential customers who had asked before but had not purchased, sending each a store coupon and a preview of new blind boxes. At noon, a friend referred by Qian Duoduo came to the store. Lei Mingxuan accompanied the friend throughout the guided shopping and ended up selling 4 blind boxes and one jacket. In the afternoon, he sorted and packed several sold blind boxes and sent them to collectors in other cities via same-city express delivery. Meanwhile, he placed a small message board in the store, inviting customers to write down their expectations for designer toys and Christmas, and took photos and posted them on Moments as a keepsake of the event, starting to collect a customer list for next month’s “Christmas Designer Toy Theme Week.” Total sales for the day were about 800 yuan, and the blind box cross-selling effect remained considerable.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, Lei Mingxuan made final preparations for the weekend Chongming Camping Festival while contacting his old roller-skating friend Song Jia to arrange a catch-up next week. He also used time before and after store hours to sort out the exhibit list for next week's pop-up exhibition. After arriving at the store in the morning, he personally fine-tuned the blind box display area and shot new material to post online. In the evening, he loaded the camping gear into the car and checked the vehicle, fully preparing for the next day's departure.

events.name: Contact old roller skating friends to arrange a catch-up
events.description: Before opening the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan contacted his roller-skating partner Song Jia via WeChat, his message carrying a long-missed warmth. He said he had been busy with the store upgrade and camping lately, but he had always remembered the days when they skated along the river together, and he wanted to arrange to meet next Tuesday (November 24) afternoon at the Riverside Greenway for a skate and a catch-up. Song Jia quickly replied that she happened to be off work that day and readily agreed. The two agreed to meet at the entrance to the Riverside Greenway at 2 p.m. that day.

events.name: Organizing the exhibit list for the pop-up exhibition
events.description: After handling WeChat messages, Lei Mingxuan opened his computer at his desk and began preparing for the urban techwear pop-up exhibition he would discuss with Zhao Min next week. He selected clothing, accessories, and a few industrial-style designer toys from the store that matched the theme, photographed them while listing an initial exhibit checklist in a document, and wrote down styling concepts and key selling points for each item so he could communicate fully with Zhao Min when the time came.

events.name: Fine-tuning the blind box display area and online release
events.description: After arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan found that customers had moved the display area the day before, so he placed the hidden-edition blind box back in the most prominent position, adjusted the angle of the spotlights to make its luster more prominent, and added a handwritten card that read, "The secret of steampunk awaits you." Then he used his phone to take photos of the display area from multiple angles and a 15-second short video, briefly edited them, and posted them to Moments, the trendy toy group, and the store manager's customer group, with a caption that continued the sense of mystery. After posting, he replied to each comment and interacted with online friends.

events.name: Roller skating gear maintenance and route confirmation
events.description: Returning home from the store in the evening, Lei Mingxuan took out his roller skates, knee pads, and elbow pads from the storage cabinet, wiped them clean with a damp cloth, checked the smoothness of the wheels and the fasteners, and dripped a few drops of lubricating oil onto the bearings. At the same time, he used the map app on his phone to check the route from Zhangyang Road to the Binjiang Greenway, decided he would ride a shared bike there, and confirmed that Tuesday would be cloudy, suitable for outdoor activities.

events.name: Loading supplies for the camping festival and performing final checks
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan and his father Lei Jianguo together carried the packed camping gear - tent, sleeping bags, folding table and chairs, cookware, food ingredients, first-aid kit, and portable speaker - into the trunk of their family car. He carefully checked the fuel level and tire pressure, confirmed everything was normal, and secured the cooler full of ice and the braised food and fruit his mother had prepared. Afterward, he posted the final notice in the camping activity group, reminding everyone to gather promptly at 8:30 a.m. the next morning at the Century Park gate, and attached the grouping and approximate itinerary. With everything ready, he went to bed with anticipation.

2025-11.daily_overview: Saturday was the first day of the Chongming Camping Festival. As the team leader, Lei Mingxuan gathered the convoy early in the morning and set off. After arriving, he efficiently organized the camp setup. In the afternoon he led everyone on a wetland hike to watch birds. In the evening he hosted a bonfire party, organized games, and played music. At night everyone sat around chatting under the starry sky, and the camp was full of joy and warmth. Late at night, he hand-brewed coffee for a few friends, and they looked up at the stars together, enjoying a peaceful moment.

events.name: Morning neck stretches and quick breakfast
events.description: Even though he was excited about the camping day, Lei Mingxuan still got up early and did a simple 5-minute neck stretch. His mother prepared a hearty breakfast, and he quickly finished eating and left.

events.name: Assembly and departure.
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan gathered all 12 participants at the gate of Century Park on time, with three cars ready to go. After briefly explaining the route and precautions and handing out walkie-talkies, the convoy set off in an orderly manner along the Yangtze River Tunnel and Bridge toward Chongming Island. Everyone chatted and laughed over the walkie-talkies along the way, and the atmosphere was relaxed.

events.name: Arrived at the campsite and set up the tent
events.description: Arriving at the campsite near Chongming Dongtan at nearly 11 a.m., Lei Mingxuan directed everyone to carry supplies according to the pre-assigned tasks, and he took the lead in hammering in tent pegs and threading tent poles. Before noon, all the tents, the communal canopy, the cooking area, and the campfire area were fully set up, and the campsite was starting to take shape.

events.name: Afternoon wetland hiking and photography
events.description: After a simple lunch, Lei Mingxuan led a group of those willing to join on a hike of about 2 kilometers to the wetland bird-watching spot. He explained migratory bird knowledge to everyone and helped them observe with binoculars. Zhao Min, who was with him, and another camping friend captured wonderful moments with their cameras. Lei Mingxuan also shot a lot of footage with his phone, planning to post it on Xiaohongshu later.

events.name: Bonfire party and social activities
events.description: As dusk fell, Lei Mingxuan lit the campfire and the party began with him as host. Everyone sat in a circle. He gave a welcome speech first, then organized a game of Werewolf, acting as the moderator to keep the atmosphere lively. After the game, he played light music through a Bluetooth speaker; some people sang, while others continued chatting. Lei Mingxuan moved through the crowd taking photos and sending them to the event group in real time, so friends who did not attend could also feel the scene. Late at night, everyone was still reluctant to leave, sharing stories and snacks around the campfire until the firewood nearly ran out, and only then did they head back to their tents one by one.

events.name: Late-night pour-over coffee and meditation under the stars
events.description: As the bonfire party was winding down and most friends had returned to their tents to rest, Lei Mingxuan took out the portable pour-over kettle he had brought from the store and his favorite Kenyan coffee beans. Using the residual heat of the bonfire, he boiled a pot of hot water and brewed a cup of coffee each for Zhang Wei and Han Dong, who were still chatting. The three sat on folding chairs, drinking hot coffee, looking up at the clear starry sky on the outskirts of Chongming, and quietly talking about their plans for the future. The peace and contentment of this moment made Lei Mingxuan feel that all the busyness and pressure were worth it. He jotted down his feelings in a memo on his phone, then slipped into his tent.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area
start_state.mood: Excited and nervous.

end_state.location: Inside the tent at the Chongming campsite
end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied, immersed in the joy of outdoor activities

2025-11.daily_overview: On the second day of the camping festival, Lei Mingxuan organized everyone to pack up the campsite after breakfast and clean up the trash. At noon, after a simple meal at a nearby restaurant, the convoy headed back. In the afternoon, he returned to his home in Pudong, spread out the wet tent and sleeping bags to air dry, cleaned the outdoor stove, sorted and stored the gear, and thanked everyone in the event group chat for participating. He began collecting photos to make a commemorative video.

events.name: Campsite cleanup and trash removal
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was the first to get up, boiled water on a portable stove, and started preparing a simple breakfast (porridge and bread). The participants gradually woke up, and after breakfast at 8, he led everyone in packing up the campsite according to the Leave No Trace principles: striking camp, folding tents, picking up and sorting litter. He checked the shared gear item by item against the checklist to make sure nothing was left behind.

events.name: Return trip lunch and convoy back to Shanghai
events.description: At 10 a.m., all gear was loaded into the vehicles, and the convoy headed to a nearby farmhouse restaurant for a group meal. Lei Mingxuan thanked everyone for their cooperation over the past two days and announced that he would produce and share an event video next week. After lunch, around noon, the convoy set off back to Shanghai, arriving safely in Pudong around 3 p.m. Everyone said goodbye and went home.

events.name: Cleaning and storing equipment after returning home
events.description: Back at home on Zhangyang Road, Lei Mingxuan spread the wet tent and sleeping bag out on the balcony to dry, wiped the ground mat and folding table and chairs with a damp cloth, carefully cleaned the used stove head and cookware, and put them into storage cabinets by category. He noted a few small issues that needed repair, such as one bent tent peg, so he could deal with them before the next trip.

events.name: Collecting Feedback and Photos from the Event Group
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan sent dozens of selected photos taken by him and Zhao Min in the activity group and wrote a warm message thanking everyone for their participation. He asked everyone to share the good photos from their phones in the group, and planned to make a memorial video of about 2 minutes as a wrap-up for the camping trip, while also accumulating some outdoor material for the store's Xiaohongshu content. Because he was tired from camping, he went to bed early tonight to recover his strength.

start_state.mood: Just woke up, feeling a little attached to the campsite.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area
end_state.mood: The relaxation and warmth after successfully completing the task

2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday, after leaving the store to his staff, Lei Mingxuan met with his college classmate Zhao Min at a café in Jing'an District in the morning and discussed in detail the division of labor and schedule for the co-hosted urban techwear pop-up exhibition in December. In the afternoon, he met his old roller-skating friend Song Jia on the riverside greenway to catch up and skate. They chatted while skating about changes in recent years, and their friendship deepened.

events.name: Discuss the pop-up exhibition plan with Zhao Min.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived on time at the agreed café in Jing'an District and met Zhao Min. Zhao Min had prepared a draft plan based on his initial ideas, including the venue zoning layout (main display area, interactive check-in area, coffee tasting corner), lighting design, and social media interaction segments. Lei Mingxuan showed his curated list of exhibits and photos of several designer toy combinations. After a lively discussion, they settled on an initial division of work: Lei Mingxuan would handle exhibits, designer toy supply, and display effects, while Zhao Min would be responsible for overall planning, venue coordination, and on-site execution. They also finalized a timeline: material preparation would start this week, followed by weekly meetings, with the project landing in mid-December.

events.name: Catching up with Song Jia while rollerblading along the riverfront.
events.description: At 1:50 PM, Lei Mingxuan walked from the subway station to the entrance of the riverside greenway carrying his roller skating bag, and saw Song Jia waving from a distance. The two skillfully put on their protective gear and began skating slowly along the river, occasionally stopping to lean on the railing and gaze into the distance. Lei Mingxuan talked about his experience transitioning from being a clothing store owner to running a coffee fusion shop. Song Jia happily said she had also just started learning hand-drip coffee, and the two immediately found a new common topic. With the river breeze blowing, their former roller skating friendship deepened through life changes and mutual appreciation. They agreed to switch to an indoor ice rink if it got too cold in winter. Lei Mingxuan also noted in his phone memo: "Song Jia is also learning hand-drip coffee; next time I can invite her to the shop to exchange ideas."

events.name: Cleanup after the event and return
events.description: At 5 p.m., the event ended. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia said goodbye at the entrance and each took the subway home. After arriving home, he cleaned and stored his roller skating gear and prepared for the next day's shop work. Before bed, he used a foam roller to relax his calves, which were a bit sore after skating.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to two important meetings today

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area
end_state.mood: The warmth of friendship and the sense of fulfillment from cooperation.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lei Mingxuan organized the notes from yesterday's meeting with Zhao Min in the morning and began preparing materials for the pop-up exhibition. At noon, he took part in a creative discussion in the historical novel group. In the evening, while browsing Instagram at home, he was deeply drawn to a vintage coffee shop in Osaka, Japan, and promptly marked several shops on the map. This led him to adjust his Japanese learning goal to practical shopping conversations, download an app, and start learning kana.

events.name: Organizing meeting minutes and preparing materials.
events.description: During a steady morning period of store traffic, Lei Mingxuan sat at the cash register and, based on yesterday's discussion with Zhao Min, used the computer to draft detailed meeting minutes, including the exhibit list, venue layout points, material requirements list, task assignments, and schedule. He sent them to Zhao Min via WeChat for confirmation. Then he contacted supplier Zhou Tao to request quotes on several special fabric samples, and searched online for the prices of props such as artificial plants and metal grid panels needed for the exhibition, conducting preliminary research for next week's purchasing.

events.name: Historical fiction group creation discussion
events.description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan opened the historical fiction lovers WeChat group. This was the third discussion in November. Based on the feedback he had collected from group members last time, he revised a passage from his novel Afternoon at Xiafei Lane and shared it again, asking for comments. The group members had a lively discussion about clothing details from the Republican era. Someone also shared a link to old photos, and Lei Mingxuan quickly saved it, feeling it would be very helpful for his writing.

events.name: Discovered a vintage coffee shop in Osaka and marked it.
events.description: After showering at night, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed and casually scrolled Instagram to relax. A photo posted by a Japanese coffee account, “[Vintage Coffee Tool Shop]”, caught his eye—the walls were lined with Showa-era coffee grinders, siphon brewers, and pour-over stands, and the aged copper and glass glowed beautifully in the warm light. Excited, he sat up and used a phone translation app to carefully read the shop owner's blog, learning that the shop was in Chuo Ward, Osaka. He opened the map, saved the shop, and also found three other similar vintage shops recommended in the comments, marking them all. He then planned a walking route for visiting the shops and labeled it “Japan Coffee Treasure Hunt”.

events.name: Adjust Japanese learning goals and start studying.
events.description: Inspired by discovering the vintage store, Lei Mingxuan downloaded two apps from the app store that night: Duolingo and Japanese Gojuon. He briefly planned five-day initial learning goals: first master the gojuon chart and basic hiragana pronunciation, then move on to simple sentence patterns related to shopping, asking prices, and describing items. Sitting on the bed, he followed the app and recited 'a i u e o' for half an hour. Although it was a bit tongue-twisting, he felt motivated, planting the seed for a future buying trip to Japan.

events.name: Regular customers bring new customers into the store.
events.description: In the afternoon, Qian Duoduo brought two new friends, Ms. Li and Ms. Wang, to the store. Lei Mingxuan greeted them warmly, personally showed them around the blind box display area, explained in detail the stories behind the hidden figures and the design details, and recommended some matching clothing and accessories. Qian Duoduo bought a new techwear jacket for herself, and the two new friends each bought a steampunk blind box set, all praising the store's atmosphere.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday evening, Lei Mingxuan went to the coffee studio as scheduled for his second pour-over coffee class. Under the teacher's guidance, he practiced basic latte art techniques and successfully made his first heart-shaped pattern. After class, he shared with the teacher his idea of combining coffee with outdoor camping, and took some practice beans home to keep practicing at the store.

events.name: Daily daytime work and neck stretches
events.description: During the day, Lei Mingxuan opened the store as usual and, during his spare time, did neck stretches and reviewed Japanese vocabulary. His neck was almost pain-free.

events.name: Second coffee course: latte art basics
events.description: At seven in the evening, Lei Mingxuan came to the coffee studio again. Today, Teacher Chen taught the basics of latte art: first demonstrating how to steam fine, silky milk foam, emphasizing that the milk temperature should be controlled at 60–65°C, the angle of the steam wand, and the hissing sound of frothing. When Lei Mingxuan practiced, the first two attempts had foam that was either too thick or too thin. After Teacher Chen patiently corrected him, he gradually got the hang of it and successfully steamed a pitcher of glossy, flowing milk foam. Then he learned to pour milk into espresso and tried to make a heart shape by swinging his wrist. After practicing with more than a dozen cups, he finally produced a heart pattern that was blurry at the edges but clearly recognizable. Excitedly, he took a photo to remember the moment. After the class, Lei Mingxuan rewarded himself with a steaming bowl of Japanese ramen at a nearby noodle shop, which caused his weight to rise slightly that evening.

events.name: Discussed the idea of outdoor coffee with the teacher.
events.description: After the class, Lei Mingxuan helped Teacher Chen clean the equipment while talking about his idea of combining coffee with outdoor camping in his store. Teacher Chen was very interested and suggested that he could use portable pour-over equipment and simple, durable utensils at the initial stage, and shared some information about coffee beans suitable for outdoor brewing. Before leaving, Teacher Chen gave him a small bag of practice coffee beans and a few plastic measuring spoons, encouraging him to practice his technique in the store more often to lay a solid foundation for a permanent coffee corner in the future.

start_state.mood: A bit tired during the day, but looking forward to the evening class.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thanksgiving Day, Lei Mingxuan closed the store early in the afternoon and went home to have dinner with his parents. His mother cooked his favorite Shanghai-style braised pork and pan-fried buns. At the dinner table, his father gave him advice on running the store. He sincerely thanked his parents for their years of support, and the family spent a warm and harmonious evening together.

events.name: Close the shop early and buy fruit.
events.description: After 3 p.m., customers in the store gradually thinned out, and Lei Mingxuan decided to close early at four o'clock. He briefly went over the next day's matters with part-time clerk Xiao Lin, sorted out the day's accounts, then walked home from the mall. Passing the fruit shop at the community entrance, he specially picked a basket of imported cherries and honey tangerines that his parents loved and carried it home.

events.name: Mother carefully prepared a Thanksgiving dinner.
events.description: At four-thirty in the afternoon, his mother Wang Xiuying began bustling in the kitchen. She took out the pork belly and flour she had bought in the morning and handled them quickly: she cut the pork belly into chunks, blanched them, and then braised them in the pot. At the same time, she kneaded dough, prepared filling, and wrapped shengjian buns. Soon, a rich aroma of meat and caramelized sweetness wafted from the kitchen. She also stir-fried two seasonal vegetables and made a pot of borscht. His father Lei Jianguo was reading the newspaper in the living room, occasionally coming into the kitchen to pass bowls and plates.

events.name: Family Thanksgiving dinner
events.description: At six in the evening, plates of home-style dishes were set on the table, and Lei Mingxuan's family of three sat around. His mother kept putting food on his plate. After tasting a piece of braised pork belly, Lei Mingxuan praised repeatedly, “Still Mama's cooking tastes the best.” While eating, his father asked with concern about the recent business situation of the shop. When he learned that the blind box marketing had worked well, he suggested that Lei Mingxuan should adjust the product mix while the buzz lasted and keep pushing on the online side. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully and nodded in agreement. The three also chatted about how Aunt Zhu, a neighbor in the community, had recovered from her leg pain, and amusing stories from his mother's choir rehearsals, with laughter filling the room.

events.name: Gratitude speech and warm moments
events.description: As dinner drew to a close, Lei Mingxuan stood up and poured a cup of tea for each of his parents. He raised his own cup and said solemnly, “Dad, Mom, thank you for your unconditional support over all these years, especially during this period… Without you, I wouldn't have made it.” His father, Lei Jianguo, patted his shoulder and said in a strong voice, “There's no need for such formality at home. Just go ahead and push forward; your dad will always support you.” His mother's eyes were slightly red, and she smiled as she reminded him, “Take care of your health. Don't push yourself too hard.” In the plain but sincere conversation, the family felt the deep love they had for one another.

events.name: After-dinner walk and family communication
events.description: At 7:30, dinner ended. Lei Mingxuan suggested taking a walk around the community garden to help digest the meal. His mother linked arms with his father, Lei Mingxuan walked alongside, and the three of them strolled slowly along the path, chatting about topics ranging from neighbor Aunt Zhu's flowers and plants to amusing stories from Lei Mingxuan's childhood. Half an hour later, they returned home. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table and, together with his mother, wrapped the leftovers in plastic wrap and put them in the fridge, and carefully washed the greasy pots and pans. His father turned on the TV in the living room and switched to the news channel.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and sleeping early.
events.description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan soaked his feet in hot water for 20 minutes as usual and felt completely relaxed. Thanks to the warmth and contentment of Thanksgiving, he decided to turn in early tonight and was in bed before 11 o'clock, recharging for the busy days ahead.

end_state.mood: Full of happiness and tranquility

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, Lei Mingxuan used his free afternoon to analyze November's trendy toy sales data and confirmed that the hidden-edition blind box event drove a 15% month-on-month increase in sales. He wrote down his marketing insights and started designing the Christmas-themed display plan for December.

events.name: Morning bodyweight training and stretching session
events.description: Inspired by the warm atmosphere of Thanksgiving, Lei Mingxuan decided after waking up this morning to do a little light exercise to wake up his body. He did 10 minutes of neck stretches, then tried 15 push-ups and a 30-second plank. Though his strength had clearly declined, he felt good.

events.name: Trendy toy sales data analysis
events.description: At two in the afternoon, with few customers in the store, Lei Mingxuan opened the cash register system backend and exported sales data for designer toy products from November 1 to 27. He carefully compared the sales with the same period in October and calculated a month-over-month increase of about 15%. The steampunk co-branded blind boxes contributed the most, driving associated sales of T-shirts and hats. In the store's operation log, he wrote: 'Hidden-edition display + social media promotion has obvious effects; this model can be continued during the Christmas season.' He also used Excel to create a simple data chart, ready to use as a case study in his next discussion with Zhao Min.

events.name: Prepare the Christmas season display plan.
events.description: After analyzing the data, he walked to the display area and began planning the Christmas window and in-store decor. He decided to match the existing techwear clothing with red Christmas designer toys and add an activity where customers who check in at the store receive small ornaments. While taking photos, he wrote down the key points for a 'Christmas Designer Toy Theme Week' in his phone memo: exclusive blind box lucky bags, spending-threshold raffles, and traffic diversion linked to Zhao Min's pop-up exhibition. He planned to draw the specific layout sketch over the weekend.
