2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday evening, while surfing the internet at home, Lei Mingxuan was deeply moved by a video of someone playing ukulele by a campfire, which sparked a new interest in camping music. He immediately searched for related videos on Bilibili, looked up beginner ukuleles and portable speakers, and developed a strong desire to buy. Before bed, he did a short bodyweight workout to prepare for the restart in December.

events.name: Watched a camping music video and got hooked
events.description: At 9 pm, after washing up, Lei Mingxuan leaned on the bed and browsed Bilibili on his laptop. The homepage recommended a video titled Playing Ukulele by the Campfire | Healing Camping Vibes. In the video, flames danced under the starry sky while a person played a lively melody, and the atmosphere was relaxed and romantic. Lei Mingxuan was deeply attracted, watched it three times, favorited and liked it, and images of someone playing and singing at his future campsite emerged in his mind.

events.name: Searched for ukulele and camping gear.
events.description: The video stirred a strong longing in him. He immediately searched keywords such as 'camping ukulele' and 'campfire sing-along' on Bilibili, watched a dozen or so related videos in one go, and noted down several beginner ukulele models mentioned in the bullet comments. Then he switched to the Taobao app, searched for the prices, materials, and reviews of these ukuleles, and also browsed portable Bluetooth speakers, comparing several models with good waterproofing and battery life. He added the ones he liked to his shopping cart and decided to make a decision tomorrow.

events.name: Pre-bed bodyweight training and reflection
events.description: After shutting down the computer, Lei Mingxuan remembered his neglected fitness and decided he couldn't wait until tomorrow. He did 2 sets of 15 push-ups, 2 sets of 30-second planks, and 20 squats on the floor, taking about 15 minutes in total. Though he was breathless afterward, it strengthened his resolve to resume systematic training in December. He opened the memo app on his phone and wrote, “Starting December 1: morning runs + strength training, executing the Western Sichuan physical fitness reserve plan.”

2025-11.daily_overview: On the last day of November, Lei Mingxuan joined a QQ group for camping and music enthusiasts in the morning to exchange experience, and in the afternoon decisively ordered an entry-level ukulele and accompanying tutorial. In the evening, he conducted a monthly financial review, fitness reflection, and display effectiveness evaluation, and took out the unused ukulele at home to clean and tune it, set a daily practice plan, and made comprehensive preparations for a fresh start in December. He also completed a simple bodyweight workout in the morning and strictly followed the new routine of going to bed early and waking up early.

events.name: Join a camping and music community to get some beginner experience
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan found the QQ group link for Camping Music Enthusiasts in the comment section of yesterday's Bilibili video and applied to join; he was quickly approved. He greeted the group members politely and said he had just been drawn to the camping ukulele and wanted to learn about getting started. The group members enthusiastically sent many videos and photos of themselves playing, recommended two beginner ukuleles widely recognized for good feel (Tom TUC200 and Enya EUC-X1), and shared free teaching resources. Lei Mingxuan exchanged WeChat contacts with two of the group members who also enjoyed collecting and outdoor activities, opening up a new corner in his interest circle.

events.name: Morning bodyweight training and Japanese study
events.description: After getting up at 6:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan spent 10 minutes doing neck stretches (almost symptom-free now), then did two sets of push-ups, planks, and squats, continuing yesterday's recovery training. After washing up, he brewed a cup of pour-over coffee and used the Duolingo app to complete 20 minutes of Japanese kana practice, feeling he had recognized most of the gojūon chart.

events.name: Placed an order for a ukulele and tutorial
events.description: After a morning of gathering information and repeated comparisons, Lei Mingxuan selected a walnut-colored Enya EUC-X1 beginner ukulele and a “Zero-Basics Ukulele Fingerstyle Tutorial” on Taobao. At 3 p.m., after confirming the price and asking customer service about the complimentary tuner and spare strings, he clicked pay and entered his home address for delivery. When the payment success page popped up, he stared at the order as if he could already hear the sound of the instrument by the campfire, and the corner of his mouth curled up involuntarily.

events.name: Monthly financial review
events.description: At eight in the evening, Lei Mingxuan opened the electronic ledger at the store checkout counter and spent an hour entering all personal and store income and expense data for November: daily store revenue, blind box purchase costs, the 20,000 yuan funded by his mother, and various expenses paid. Comparing with October data, he found that although total revenue increased slightly, extra expenses such as renovation preparations and coffee courses made cash flow tight. He specifically noted that the Double Eleven blind boxes sold out quickly with little backlog, and reminded himself to stock up reasonably for the December Christmas season and set aside funds for mini-program development.

events.name: Reflection on the fitness break and plans to restart in December
events.description: After reviewing the finances, Lei Mingxuan stood on the body fat scale at home and saw the number 80.5 kg (up from the beginning of the month but already down from the peak). He frowned slightly, then let it go. He realized that in November, due to the camping festival, store renovation preparations, and a string of social events, he had only played basketball twice and gone roller-skating once, and systematic training had been completely interrupted. But he had started to recover at the end of the month. He sat down, took out his fitness log, and wrote down the December restart plan: morning runs of 5 km every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday; strength training on Tuesday and Thursday evenings (mostly bodyweight); and basketball or roller-skating once on Saturday. He opened his phone and activated the dormant gym annual card app, booked a body composition test for the morning of December 1, and resolved to get his BMI back to a healthy range before the western Sichuan road trip. When his mother passed by, she said with concern, 'Take care of your body, don't go on a diet.' He nodded and smiled.

events.name: Evaluating and archiving the display effect
events.description: Before going to bed, Lei Mingxuan photographed the blind box display area from multiple angles with his professional camera as this month's display record. Standing in the center of the store, he looked around and felt the current layout and lighting were already quite refined, so he wrote in his notebook, 'Keep the current plan and add Christmas elements in December,' deciding to continue this arrangement into the following month. After importing the photos to his computer, he sorted them into the '2025 Store Display' folder for easy future reference.

events.name: Clean the unused ukulele and set a practice plan
events.description: After completing the financial and fitness plans, he found an unused ukulele that someone had given him in the corner of the storage room. He wiped off the dust with a polishing cloth, noticed the neck felt a little rough, so he applied a few drops of lemon oil to condition it and tuned it with a phone tuner. Then he downloaded the Youde Tuner and Finger Ukulele Lessons apps on his phone and selected a beginner chord-strumming video course. He created a recurring daily 18:00-18:30 reminder in his phone calendar titled Ukulele Practice, deciding to start the next day. With everything ready, he looked at the ukulele, feeling excited about the upcoming musical journey, and turned off the lights at 23:40 sharp to welcome the new December.

events.name: Completed the annual report for the individual business.
events.description: In the morning at the store office, he logged into the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and, based on the materials he had compiled in advance, entered the 2024 annual operating revenue, total tax paid, asset status, and employee information one by one. After checking that everything was correct, he submitted it for public disclosure and saved screenshots. The whole process took about 2 hours to ensure compliance.

When Lei Mingxuan saw that the 'Xiafei Ji' trademark had officially entered the examination stage, he was very excited. He immediately took a screenshot and sent it to his parents, his childhood friend Zhang Wei, and his cousin Shen Jie to share the good news, and decided to frame the paper original and hang it in the store as a memento once it arrived.

events.name: Packing the pour-over surprise kit

After confirming the quality was correct, they counted and put the items into storage. The two then discussed how to display this batch of functional-style items, and decided to replace the central display in the store entirely with the new mountain-style pieces, matching them with existing outdoor backpacks, trekking poles, and other accessories to create an immersive outdoor scene. He used an interval rowing mode, keeping his pace at 2 minutes 15 seconds per 500 meters and his heart rate at 140-160 beats per minute, focusing on the latissimus dorsi and core muscles. After the workout, he carefully did 10 minutes of back and shoulder stretches, recorded the training data on his phone, and added another contribution to his physical preparation for the self-driving trip to western Sichuan.

events.name: Bringing coffee to the basketball game to repair his relationship with basketball buddies.

2025-04.daily_overview: This day belonged to family. To make up for the recent neglect of family companionship caused by the busy store, and to respond to his mother's repeatedly expressed wish to go on a trip, Lei Mingxuan's long-planned spring trip to Suzhou finally came to be. Early in the morning, he drove off with his parents, full of laughter and joy along the way. At the Humble Administrator's Garden, he explained the sights like a tour guide, making his mother beam with joy. On Pingjiang Road, the three strolled along the old street and ordered a full table of Suzhou dishes at a restaurant. Lei Mingxuan proactively poured tea and served food. His mother told amusing stories from his childhood, and his father rarely showed a relaxed expression. In the evening, the family photo by Jinji Lake captured the warmth. On the way back, both parents fell asleep. Looking at their peaceful faces in the rearview mirror, Lei Mingxuan felt that all the running around was worth it. The tacit understanding and intimacy between mother and son were fully restored, and the power of family support settled deep in his heart.

events.name: Drove his parents to Suzhou.
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan drove his family car from his home on Zhangyang Road in Pudong, carrying his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, along the Huning Expressway to Suzhou. On the way, old songs his mother loved were playing. Lei Mingxuan proactively brought up that he had been busy with the shop lately and had spent less time with them, and he sincerely apologized. His mother smiled and waved her hand, saying, "I know you're busy, it's fine." The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.

events.name: Visit the Humble Administrator’s Garden.
events.description: After arriving in Suzhou, Lei Mingxuan accompanied his parents into the Humble Administrator's Garden. In April, the garden was full of spring scenery, with colorful flowers and green willows among pavilions and terraces. Lei Mingxuan had done his homework in advance and took the initiative to explain the historical allusions of scenic spots such as the Hall of Distant Fragrance and the Lotus Breeze Pavilion, stopping many times to take photos for his parents. His mother, Wang Xiuying, said happily, "Better than a tour guide's narration," and his father, Lei Jianguo, nodded approvingly. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

events.name: Pingjiang Road Walk and Family Lunch
events.description: Around noon, Lei Mingxuan took his parents to the Pingjiang Road Historical and Cultural District, walking along the stone-paved road to experience the charm of the Jiangnan water town. After the three of them browsed a few small shops, Lei Mingxuan chose an authentic local Suzhou restaurant. After they sat down, he proactively poured tea for his parents and picked up food for them with chopsticks, specially ordering squirrel-shaped mandarin fish, water shield soup, and other dishes his parents loved. During the meal, his mother talked about the mischievous things Lei Mingxuan did in the alley when he was little, and the three of them laughed heartily. The gloom of the busy previous two weeks completely dissipated.

events.name: Stroll by Jinji Lake and family group photo
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan drove his parents to the shore of Jinji Lake. The three strolled along the lake, admiring the blend of the modern city skyline and the light on the lake. At an iconic spot, Lei Mingxuan asked a passerby to take a family photo of the three of them. His mother smiled brightly, and his father also wore a rare relaxed smile. Lei Mingxuan set the photo as his phone wallpaper, feeling deep down that the warmth of family was his greatest motivation.

events.name: Drove back to Shanghai.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Lei Mingxuan drove his parents back to Shanghai from Suzhou. On the way, the three continued to chat happily. His mother looked through the day's photos, while his father asked about the store's recent situation. They got home safely at 7:30 p.m. Lei Mingxuan felt relaxed in body and mind, and his relationship with his mother had grown closer.

2025-04.daily_overview: Early Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan's car was loaded with camping gear and five friends, and they drove to Fengxian Bay Forest Park. This camping trip was the final test of his equipment and physical fitness before the western Sichuan trip. After arriving at the campsite, everyone worked together to set up tents. Lei Mingxuan specially tested the windproof stove and the new sleeping bag, and everything worked perfectly. Barista Xiao Ma gave an on-site lesson, guiding him to stabilize his pour-over parameters outdoors. Lei Mingxuan practiced controlling the water flow repeatedly, and the coffee he finally brewed won praise from his friends. In the afternoon, the group took a lakeside hike. The light filtered through the forest, and Lei Mingxuan used his phone to identify plants and flowers while Zhao Min shared photography tips. At dusk, they lit a campfire and sat around it talking. Lei Mingxuan told stories from his childhood in the alleyways, Xiao Ma shared his experiences with Yunnan coffee, and Han Dong talked about interesting road-trip stories. Laughter and firelight intertwined. Lying in the tent, he looked up at the starry sky, filled with unprecedented anticipation for the upcoming western Sichuan journey.

events.name: Organize a camping trip to Bay Forest Park to test equipment
events.description: On the morning of April 26, Lei Mingxuan drove his own car, carrying a full set of camping gear including a two-person tent, sleeping bags, ground mats, a windproof stove, and portable pour-over coffee equipment, and set off from his home in Pudong for the campsite at Bay Forest National Park in Fengxian District. Joining him were barista Xiao Ma (Ma Lei), college classmate Zhao Min, childhood friend Zhang Wei, and billiards buddy Han Dong. On the way, everyone excitedly discussed the camping plan and pour-over techniques, while Lei Mingxuan quietly noted the car's power performance under a full load.

events.name: Set up camp and test equipment.
events.description: After arriving at the campsite, Lei Mingxuan and his friends worked together to set up tents in the designated camping area. He took the initiative to carry heavy gear such as tents and food, and hiked ahead to scout the best camping spot, actually testing the results of the past few weeks of physical training and feeling that his cardiopulmonary and load-bearing abilities had clearly improved. After setting up the tent, he immediately tested the newly purchased windproof stove and portable kettle, confirming that the burner flame was stable and the kettle's boiling efficiency met expectations, verifying the durability of the core equipment for the Western Sichuan self-drive trip.

events.name: Outdoor pour-over coffee teaching and hands-on practice
events.description: After the tent was set up, barista Xiao Ma formally guided Lei Mingxuan on how to control pour-over parameters in an outdoor setting at the camping table and chairs. The two used portable equipment to compare brewing with coarse, medium, and fine coffee grounds, testing flow rate and flavor differences. Zhao Min recorded with her phone and helped time the process. Lei Mingxuan focused on practicing the stability of pouring in a circular motion, and successfully brewed a pot of clean-flavored black coffee to share with everyone. His friends praised it one after another, which made him look forward to enjoying coffee on the way through western Sichuan.

events.name: Park hiking and nature observation

Lei Mingxuan used his phone to photograph roadside plants and the occasional passing birds. Zhao Min shared outdoor photography tips, while Xiao Ma hummed a tune. After about two hours of hiking, they returned to the campsite, tired but in high spirits.

Lei Mingxuan shared family stories from his childhood in the alleyways of Shanghai, Xiao Ma talked about what he had seen in the coffee-producing areas of Yunnan, Han Dong mentioned bizarre cases from car repair, and Zhang Wei also joined the discussion. Zhao Min was in charge of grilling food and adding firewood. The topic gradually turned to imagining the western Sichuan road trip and adventures in each person's life; the firelight illuminated everyone's smiling faces.

After the run, he returned to the campsite, grabbed his portable pour-over kit, and went to a flat rock by the lake to practice pour-over again. Amid the birdsong and morning breeze, his water flow control was especially steady, and the coffee he brewed had a dew-like freshness. This solitary lakeside coffee moment gave him a completely new sense of peace. In the morning, everyone packed up the campsite and took all the trash away with them. Lei Mingxuan did a final check of the equipment to confirm that everything was in good working condition. After returning home in the afternoon, he took a hot shower and a nap. In the evening, he did 20 minutes of yoga stretching to completely shake off the fatigue of camping. Then he shared photos with his parents and went to bed early.

At that moment, pour-over was not just a skill but a way of talking with nature. 2025-04.daily_overview: The last day of April was also the last business day before departure. Lei Mingxuan ran the store as usual during the day, with decent customer traffic. After closing, he first carried out the clearance presale post drafted on April 29, having Xiao Lin publish it to the community group. Then he began the monthly sales review: he cleaned and classified April's data item by item, and used an Excel pivot table to analyze the sales differences between the new mountain-style products and traditional styles. The results were bittersweet: the new products raised the overall average transaction value by 15%, but basic styles were clearly piling up in inventory. Based on this, he fine-tuned the May clearance and new-product mix strategy and wrote it in his notebook, ready to hand over to Xiao Lin. When the review was finished, it was already 9:30 pm. He stretched and looked at the empty mall corridor, feeling deeply fulfilled. Before leaving, he did a final safety check of the store and gently pulled down the rolling shutter door. On the drive home, he received a message from Han Dong: 'Safe travels tomorrow.' April ended with hard work, and May was already beckoning from the foot of the snow mountains in western Sichuan.

He fine-tuned the May strategy he had made on April 29: promoted mountain-style outfits with accessories, implemented bundle promotions or threshold discounts to clear slow-moving basic items, and adjusted discount intensity. He noted the key points in his notebook and prepared the memo to hand over to Xiao Lin the next day.

After arriving home, he moved quietly; his parents were already asleep. He stuck the prepared memo on the refrigerator, washed up briefly, lay down, and fell asleep almost instantly. Tomorrow, western Sichuan.

His mother, Wang Xiuying, immediately objected, saying a stray cat was unhygienic and demanding that it be sent away; his father, Lei Jianguo, remained neutral. Lei Mingxuan patiently explained and promised to take care of it. That night, he crouched beside the sofa several times and called softly, but Afu did not come out.

The two exchanged contact information, laying the groundwork for introducing new brands to the store.

events.name: Comforting Afu at night

events.name: A Fu's adaptation progress: accepting feeding and initial exploration.

Taking advantage of Ah Fu's lowered guard, Lei Mingxuan approached the edge of the sofa with cat treats. After hesitating, Ah Fu began to accept food from his hand. He kept calling and stroking him gently, and Ah Fu gradually stopped trembling. In the afternoon, Ah Fu carefully came out from under the sofa and explored the living room, looking back every few steps. Lei Mingxuan sat on the floor the whole time without moving to give him a sense of security. His mother, Wang Xiuying, still complained when she saw this, but no longer insisted on sending Ah Fu away.

2025-07.daily_overview: Launch day for systematic health management: morning run, review of the physical exam, and meal planning; evening core training and a healthy meal, kicking off the family diet transition; serialized novel begins, and the pace of life changes dramatically.

events.name: Go for a morning run as planned and increase the distance.
events.description: Woke up at 5:30 in the morning, put on workout gear, set out from home on Zhangyang Road, jogged along Century Avenue to Century Park, and ran 4.5 kilometers in loops, taking about 32 minutes. Wearing a heart rate strap, he kept his heart rate at 140-150 bpm. After the run, he stretched on a park bench and recorded the session.

events.name: Review the physical examination report and establish clear health goals.
events.description: After running, I went home and took out the June physical examination report in the living room. I carefully read the warning items about the fatty liver tendency and high cholesterol, and recorded key data such as weight 80.1 kg, BMI about 27.0, and blood lipids in my phone memo. I confirmed that losing weight and lowering blood lipids were the priority areas for improvement.

events.name: Create a one-week high-protein, low-fat meal plan
events.description: In the study, he opened the healthy eating app, entered his height of 172 cm, weight of 80.1 kg, and health indicators. Following the recommended template, he gradually added ingredients and meals to create a one-week meal plan including oatmeal with milk for breakfast, chicken breast salad for lunch, and steamed fish with vegetables for dinner, then synced it to calendar reminders.

events.name: Made a grocery shopping list and checked the inventory
events.description: Made a detailed shopping list based on the recipe, including chicken breast, salmon, broccoli, eggs, Greek yogurt, etc., then opened the fridge to check existing ingredients, removed duplicates, and made sure nothing was wasted.

events.name: Evening core strength training.
events.description: In the evening, I did core strength training at home as planned: push-ups 3 sets × 20 reps, planks 3 sets × 45 seconds, sit-ups 3 sets × 20 reps. The quality of completion was good, and I recorded it in my training log.

events.name: First time making a healthy dinner.
events.description: In the evening, he cooked chicken breast salad and multigrain rice himself. When he served it, his father Lei Jianguo complained it 'had no oil or fat,' while his mother Wang Xiuying voiced support and promised to adjust the daily menu. After trying it, his father reluctantly accepted. For the first time, the family diet moved away from the traditional heavy-oil-and-dark-soy-sauce style.

events.name: Begin the online serialization of the historical novel The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane
events.description: After dinner, in his study, he used a laptop to register on the Fengdu platform under the pen name Nongtang Xiaolei and uploaded the first chapter of his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, formally turning writing into a long-term creative project and setting it to update daily.

events.name: Day 3 of A Fu's adjustment: taking the initiative to bond and being accepted by the family
events.description: Afu began to actively leave the living room and explore the hallway and the doorways of the bedrooms. While Lei Mingxuan was reading on the sofa, Afu approached him on its own for the first time, rubbed against his legs, and purred. When his mother came home in the afternoon and saw Afu quietly lying beside Lei Mingxuan, her attitude clearly softened; she took the initiative to ask about its diet and reminded him to get it vaccinated. When his father came home in the evening, he reached out and touched Afu on his own, showing obvious acceptance for the first time since it was adopted in June.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Firm and focused, determined to change his lifestyle habits

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied: healthy eating launched, novel began serialization, and Afu has settled into the family.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the morning, he opened the store as usual. In the afternoon, he purchased healthy ingredients and contacted his younger female cousin to plan the Xiaohongshu promotion. In the evening, he had a heated argument with his father over the store upgrade proposal, creating a tense family atmosphere, but A Fu unexpectedly softened his mother's mood.

events.name: Morning store work and brand material coordination
events.description: Went to the Century Avenue store, served customers together with store clerk Xiao Lin, and in free time browsed the detailed product catalog of Southeast Asian brands sent by Lao Zhou, selected the first batch of styles that might be introduced, and printed them to show his father.

events.name: Purchasing healthy ingredients and pre-processing
events.description: At noon, walk to Lianhua Supermarket on Zhangyang Road and buy chicken breast, salmon, vegetables, sugar-free yogurt, and so on according to the list. Carefully check the production dates and nutrition facts labels. After returning home, divide into portions, label the dates, arrange them neatly in the refrigerator, and discard old packaging.

events.name: Called cousin Shen Jie to discuss the Xiaohongshu plan
events.description: At home in the afternoon, he had a detailed WeChat video call with Shen Jie about the content positioning, cover style, and posting frequency of the store's Xiaohongshu account. Shen Jie suggested focusing on two series: 'urban functional commuter menswear' and 'weekend outdoor dressing.' Lei Mingxuan agreed and scheduled a face-to-face meeting and test shoot for next week.

events.name: The father and son broke into a heated argument over the store upgrade.
events.description: At Friday dinner, Lei Mingxuan formally proposed to his father using family savings or applying for a loan to bring in the Southeast Asian brand that Lao Zhou had mentioned and upgrade the store's experience area. His father immediately put down his chopsticks, took out the family income and expense ledger, and listed income, expenditures, and emergency funds item by item, pointing out that the savings were only enough to maintain basic operations for six months and that a loan would be extremely risky. Lei Mingxuan retorted that traditional retail was at a dead end. Their voices gradually rose, and his mother tried to mediate several times but failed. Finally, his father slapped the table and said, 'If you want to do this, we split the family.' Lei Mingxuan slammed the door and left, not returning until late at night.

events.name: Afu melts Mother's heart
events.description: After Lei Mingxuan slammed the door, his mother cried in sadness. A Fu voluntarily jumped onto her lap, nuzzled her head, and purred. Wang Xiuying was touched by A Fu's clingy behavior, and her attitude shifted from being reserved about the cat to genuinely caring for it, so she began planning a daily care routine.

start_state.location: Living room at home
start_state.mood: Feeling refreshed after waking up, and looking forward to communicating with my father.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Frustration, anger, and guilt are intertwined, and the father-son relationship has become strained.

2025-07.daily_overview: In the morning, rock climbing released pent-up emotions; in the afternoon, the cold reconciliation over accounts with his father brought slight progress in financial discussions; in the evening, billiards maintained friendship, and his mother's healthy dinner was recognized. The family rift began to heal.

events.name: Resumed rock climbing and incorporated it into cross-training.
events.description: In the morning, he resumed the regular climbing day with his college classmate Zhao Min at the climbing gym, and climbing was included in cross-training. Lei Mingxuan successfully completed several V2 routes and tried V3, and his upper-body strength improved significantly compared with before. After climbing, he discussed with Zhao Min the plan to combine climbing with weighted training for camping.

events.name: Payday: regular fund investment and savings for Western Sichuan
events.description: Before rock climbing, Lei Mingxuan used mobile banking to complete the monthly fund investment plan scheduled on the 5th, and transferred 800 yuan into a dedicated savings account for a self-driving trip in western Sichuan, maintaining his financial management habit.

events.name: Father and son jointly collected and verified family financial data.
events.description: In the afternoon at home, Lei Mingxuan and his father collected the family income-and-expense ledgers, the store's revenue details for the last six months, rent receipts, and daily expense records. Then they checked the savings balance, fixed expenses, and the store's previous six months of revenue together in the living room, making sure the numbers were accurate.

events.name: Calculating loan risk and having the first rational discussion
events.description: Based on the verified data, father and son calculated together: current savings can only support about six months of basic store operations; if they take a loan of 200,000 yuan and repay it over 12 months, the monthly payment would account for more than 40% of the store's monthly net income. For the first time, they rationally discussed the feasibility of expansion in the study based on specific numbers. Although they did not fully agree, the mood clearly eased. Lei Mingxuan understood his father's concerns, and his father acknowledged his son's initiative.

events.name: Evening billiards socializing with Han Dong.
events.description: In the evening, he went to Pudong Billiards Club to play against Han Dong for two hours, chatting about recent news while playing. Han Dong found Lei Mingxuan's new coffee hobby intriguing and teased him for 'getting more and more fun'. Lei Mingxuan laughed and said he wanted to create a coffee corner in his clothing store.

events.name: Mother makes a healthy dinner for the first time, and the whole family tries it
events.description: Mother tried making low-oil, low-salt dishes in the kitchen, such as steamed vegetable salad and chicken breast dishes. After Father and Lei Mingxuan tasted them, they felt the flavor was a bit bland, but with Mother's encouragement they finished it all. After the meal, Lei Mingxuan stepped on the scale, which showed 80.4 kg. Mother reassured him that it was normal fluctuation, and the whole family agreed to stick with it for another week.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Still a bit depressed from last night's argument, but looking forward to rock climbing to let off steam

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Slightly eased; the financial discussion made progress, and the family is beginning to work together.

His father's expression clearly softened, and he said he was willing to see his son's actual performance. During the meal, his mother kept adding food to their bowls, and the icy atmosphere thawed.

2025-07.daily_overview: Early in the morning, he continued climbing the mountain and had a scary slip. Realizing his physical fitness was a weak point, he gave up reaching the summit, descended, and returned to Shanghai. In the evening, he filmed and published his first Xiaohongshu note at the store, then did bedtime yoga to relax and updated a chapter of his novel.

events.name: Slip-and-fall accident and descent.
events.description: Got up at 5 a.m., packed the tent and had breakfast, then continued climbing along the ancient trail toward the main peak on the north side at 6:30. Around 9 a.m., on a stone-step section with a slope of about 60 degrees, because his pack was too heavy and he was physically exhausted, his feet slipped and he lost control, sliding about 2 meters down. His right wrist was scraped by sharp rocks. He sterilized and bandaged it with his first-aid kit, rested, then gave up the summit attempt. He began a cautious descent at 10 a.m., returned to the parking lot at 2 p.m., washed up briefly, drove back to Shanghai, and arrived home in the evening.

events.name: Publish first Xiaohongshu note
events.description: At the counter, he used the Xiaohongshu app on his phone to write the post, describing his outfit-matching ideas and how the clothes felt to wear, attached the edited photos, tapped publish, and successfully published the first note on the store account.

events.name: Interaction and feedback
events.description: Within two hours of posting, the note received 23 likes and 8 comments, and one user asked where to buy it. Lei Mingxuan replied to each comment, sent the user who asked a private message with the store address and business hours, and thanked the other users.

events.name: Conversation with Shen Jie
events.description: At 10 p.m., Lei Mingxuan excitedly sent screenshots of the note data to his cousin Shen Jie via WeChat. The two discussed the highlights and user feedback of the note. Shen Jie suggested optimizing the tags and the tone of the copy, and Lei Mingxuan said he would update the second article next week and continue the discussion.

events.name: Bedtime yoga
events.description: After replying to comments, Lei Mingxuan did 20 minutes of gentle yoga in the bedroom, focusing on stretching his legs to help relieve fatigue from hiking, while being careful to avoid his scraped wrist.

events.name: Update the serialized novel
events.description: Despite being tired, he persisted in updating his novel chapter, weaving the tension of the Huangshan hike into the writing.

events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan finished work at the store and returned home, only to find his father Lei Jianguo smoking alone on the balcony in a tense atmosphere. He took the initiative to walk to the balcony and sit down, apologized for rashly proposing the store upgrade plan, and admitted that he had not fully considered the family's financial situation or his father's opinion. Lei Jianguo sighed and expressed his concerns about the risks of expansion. Then the two honestly reviewed the store's development since it opened in 2020 and the changes in the market environment. Lei Mingxuan explained in detail the plan to upgrade it to a multi-brand store and the expected returns, while listening carefully to his father's worries. After nearly an hour of conversation, Lei Jianguo's attitude softened, and he finally said: wait until autumn to see the store's performance; if revenue is stable, he would agree to take part of the family savings to support a small-scale pilot upgrade. After the conversation, his father patted him on the shoulder in encouragement, and the two returned to the living room, where the family's tense atmosphere dissipated. Lei Mingxuan made tea for his father, and the understanding and trust between father and son were rebuilt.

Lei Mingxuan sincerely explained that in the past few months he had become fascinated with camping, pour-over coffee, and writing, and these new hobbies had taken up a lot of his weekend time, making it impossible to play basketball as often as before. Xie Fei listened quietly, said he understood the changes at this stage of life, but admitted he would need time to get used to it. Lei Mingxuan listened attentively and proactively shared his takeaways from meeting Xie Fei that day. His father nodded, indicating his understanding of changes in young people's social circles. The atmosphere between father and son, which had been taciturn for years, has become natural and smooth.

He also listed a detailed equipment checklist in his notebook: two-person tent, moisture-proof mat, sleeping bag, outdoor stove and gas canister, pour-over coffee set, headlamp, etc. He also planned self-driving routes and a schedule of leaving early and returning late. At night he organized his camping gear and completed the day's core strength training, making final preparations for the upcoming first trip.

events.name: Politely decline Song Jia’s roller skating invitation
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, roller-skating partner Song Jia sent a WeChat message, warmly inviting Lei Mingxuan to go to the Pudong Riverside roller-skating track on Saturday (June 7), saying she had recently learned a set of fancy moves to share. Lei Mingxuan frowned at his phone and quickly replied: 'This Saturday doesn't work—I've planned a camping trip to Sheshan. Next time, next time! I'll definitely invite you next week!' along with an apologetic emoji. Song Jia only replied with an 'okay' bunny emoji. At the time, Lei Mingxuan thought it was just a normal last-minute reschedule and didn't take it to heart.

events.name: Plan two weeks of content scheduling with Shen Jie
events.description: At 3 p.m., Shen Jie came to the store again. The two compared the printed Xiaohongshu backend data and found that impressions for the first post were concentrated among men aged 30-40, so they adjusted the content focus. They settled on publishing a camping gear photo-text post before this Friday, releasing a pour-over coffee video by next Tuesday, and weaving in behind-the-scenes stories about how the store selects products. Shen Jie also taught Lei Mingxuan hands-on techniques for using grid lines and exposure lock when shooting on his phone, and they agreed to hold a fixed online brainstorming session every Tuesday afternoon.

events.name: Daily store operations
events.description: Between 9 a.m. and 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan received about ten groups of customers, sold 3 T-shirts and 2 pairs of shorts, and restocked the shelves. During his free time, he browsed competitors' Xiaohongshu accounts, following and favoriting a few well-executed mountain-style stores, planning to study them after returning home in the evening. At noon, he ordered takeout pan-fried buns and discussed the remaining inventory for the Dragon Boat Festival promotion with store clerk Xiao Lin while eating.

events.name: Home core strength training
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan laid out the yoga mat in his bedroom and did Tuesday's core training according to the May physical strengthening plan. He did 3 sets of sit-ups (20 reps each), 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps each, with the last set being somewhat difficult), and 3 sets of planks (45 seconds each). During training, his mother knocked on the door and brought him cut fruit, reminding him to rest. He felt his abs were stronger than last week and recorded a training log.

events.name: Organizing camping gear
events.description: After the core training, Lei Mingxuan spread out all the camping equipment on the living room floor and checked each item against the previously prepared list: tent (checking stakes and wind ropes), sleeping bag with a suitable temperature rating, sufficient stove heads and gas canisters, and complete coffee equipment. He found that he was missing a portable water bucket, so he immediately ordered a collapsible bucket on JD.com with next-day delivery. After checking, he packed all the equipment into the 65-liter hiking backpack and the trunk storage box, getting ready to depart on Saturday morning.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Energetic and strong urge to plan

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Slight guilt (toward Song Jia) but looking forward to camping; body is a bit sore yet fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Core strength training: sit-ups 3×20, push-ups 3×15, plank 3×45 seconds

2025-06.daily_overview: On Wednesday, showers in the plum rain season brought a chill to the streets. Lei Mingxuan organized newly arrived goods in the store and, following Shen Jie's suggestion, set up a simple photo area and tried shooting a few outdoor outfit sets. After work, he began reading The Song of Everlasting Sorrow at home, wrote some reading notes, and prepared for the upcoming reading group. Because of the rain, he did no outdoor exercise and only did simple indoor stretching in the evening. His weight rose slightly due to two consecutive days of increased food intake.

events.name: Unpacking and organizing new store arrivals and setting up a simple photo studio
events.description: At 10 a.m., the delivery person brought the first batch of spring replenishment goods and several prototype samples sent by Zhou Tao. Lei Mingxuan directed Xiao Lin to help unpack and steam the clothes, while he set up a small photo area in the corner of the store with two fill lights, a gray backdrop, and a phone tripod. He test-shot several outfit combinations of outdoor quick-dry pants and waterproof jackets. Although the lighting was slightly insufficient due to the gloomy rain, the results were acceptable after adjusting brightness in post-processing.

events.name: Midday reading of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow
events.description: At 12:30 p.m., taking advantage of the low customer flow, Lei Mingxuan took out the newly purchased "The Song of Everlasting Sorrow" from behind the cash register and turned to the first chapter. The Shanghai alleyway scenes written by Wang Anyi reminded him of his childhood, and he quickly became absorbed. He used a highlighter to mark sentences describing typical shikumen and jotted down the pigeon's-eye view narrative idea in the margin of his notebook, planning to use it in the book club discussion.

events.name: Store operations and Xiaohongshu replies
events.description: In the afternoon, the rain intensified, and there were not many customers in the store. Lei Mingxuan simply sat by the photo area and used his phone to reply to new comments on Xiaohongshu. A follower asked about the jacket's waterproof rating, and he casually replied with the specific parameter of 8,000 mm and also recommended matching pants. Afterwards, he browsed the platform-recommended topic #ShanghaiBookstores and found a used bookshop in an alleyway, deciding to visit it another day.

events.name: Gathering writing material in the evening
events.description: After dinner, his father Lei Jianguo was watching TV and his mother was knitting. Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, continued reading The Song of Everlasting Sorrow up to page 50, and used Evernote to excerpt five passages of detailed description. Before going to bed, he took a book from the shelf, Shanghai: A City's Chronicle, and, using photos of 1940s longtang alleys as reference, sketched the first scene of his novel in his notebook—the street where the tram passed through Xiafeifang in the afternoon.

events.name: Short indoor stretching
events.description: Because it was rainy all day and he couldn't run, Lei Mingxuan did 15 minutes of post-run stretches in the bedroom (imitating his routine after a morning run), focusing on relaxing the iliopsoas and hamstrings. He felt a bit heavy and couldn't help worrying whether his weight would rebound, so he decided he must go for a morning run tomorrow.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Uneventful, routine

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Composed but with a slight concern about weight; reading and visualizing scenes left him feeling fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: Stretched indoors for 15 minutes and walked about 4000 steps.

2025-06.daily_overview: On payday, Lei Mingxuan took care of his finances early in the morning, completed the automatic fund investment and travel savings, and felt reassured watching his deposits grow steadily. He finished a 5-kilometer outdoor run in the morning, then took his camping gear to Century Park, took a satisfying set of outfit photos in the good cloudy light, and published a Xiaohongshu post. After work, he signed up for the long-awaited historical fiction reading group and carefully prepared an outline of talking points to warm up for the first gathering next Tuesday.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan put on a quick-dry shirt and running shoes, jogged along Zhangyang Road to Century Park, and ran 5 km around the park's outer loop, finishing in 29 minutes 10 seconds at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. He felt in good shape; although he had not exercised yesterday, the morning air was fresh and his run felt light and easy. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes and bought a bottle of water at a convenience store to rehydrate.

events.name: Payday accounting
events.description: At around 9 AM, just as he arrived at the store, mobile banking notified him that this month's operating income and personal salary, totaling about 12,000 yuan, had arrived. Lei Mingxuan quickly completed two operations via mobile banking: he transferred 3,000 yuan from his current account into a regular monthly investment plan for an index fund and bond fund portfolio (according to the 8:2 ratio agreed with Xu Feng), and transferred another 3,000 yuan to an Alipay dedicated savings jar named "Western Sichuan Road Trip Dream." He then recorded these two expenses in his journal and opened the Tiantian Fund app to check last month's portfolio return (+2.1%), nodding with satisfaction.

events.name: Century Park camping gear photo shoot
events.description: At 1 p.m., Lei Mingxuan packed several representative pieces of gear (tent, egg-crate pad, pour-over kettle, coffee beans) and two coordinated outdoor outfits into his hiking backpack, then rode a shared bike to Century Park. He found a grassy spot under a camphor tree and, following Shen Jie's rule-of-thirds composition, first used the tent as a backdrop to shoot a flat lay of the full set of gear. Then he changed into a quick-dry top and workwear shorts and took a few selfies showing the outdoor-style outfit. He also used a phone gimbal to record a 40-second time-lapse of quickly setting up the tent. While shooting, a few tourists were attracted and came over to ask about the brands, and he took the opportunity to hand out the store's business cards.

events.name: Publishing a Xiaohongshu note about camping gear
events.description: Returning to the store at 4 p.m., Lei Mingxuan used a phone editing app to select 9 images and the time-lapse video, added the title 'Weekend Escape from the City | My Lightweight Camping System and Detailed Gear List' as the caption, tagged the official accounts of two camping brands, and posted it. Within an hour it had 30+ likes, and two comments asked about the brand of the egg-crate foam pad; he replied immediately. After Shen Jie saw the link on WeChat, she suggested adding the store's location info to the caption to drive traffic, and he immediately edited it in.

events.name: Signed up for the 'Old Dream on the Sea' reading group and prepared
events.description: At 6 p.m., Lei Mingxuan saw a notice on Douban Events that the Old Shanghai Dream Historical Fiction Reading Group at the Jing'an District Library would hold its first offline event on Tuesday evening, June 10, and that the theme was a group reading of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow. He clicked to register, then took out the notes he had made while reading over the past few days and organized three key points for discussion: the longtang alleyway as the story's container, the symbolic meaning of the pigeon's perspective, and the Pudong longtang memories he planned to write about. He also wrote a short opening line in his phone memo: The pigeon perched on the bamboo clothes-drying pole witnessed all the secrets of everyone in Xiafei Fang.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Felt happy about payday and the fine weather, and was motivated to go for a morning run.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied, body light and agile, full of anticipation for the reading group

2025-06.daily_overview: On Friday, Lei Mingxuan was busy at the store all day and handled the handover for the weekend camping activity. In the evening, he went to the supermarket to buy fresh ingredients and drinks for the camping trip. After returning home, he carefully checked the car and equipment to ensure everything was ready for the next morning. Late at night, he checked the Xiaohongshu backend and saw a few new likes, feeling a little gratified at the initial results of his online operations. Because he was busy all day and did not exercise specifically, he only maintained activity through walking, and his weight dropped slightly.

events.name: Weekend work handover at the store
events.description: In the store all day, Lei Mingxuan assigned the task of managing the store alone over the weekend to staff member Xiao Lin, including the display positions of new products, sales scripts, and how to contact him in an emergency. He specially forwarded the store's landline calls to his mobile phone, and sent a group message to regular customers saying that the owner would be out this weekend but they could still shop normally. After finishing these tasks, he restocked the shelves and adjusted the window mannequins to a functional-style outfit to match the image of the online promotion.

events.name: Pre-camping supplies shopping.
events.description: At 6 p.m., after closing, Lei Mingxuan drove to Carrefour. Pushing a shopping cart, he bought according to the list: two bottles of water, a bag of instant pasta, a pack of bacon, two ears of corn, three tomatoes, a small bottle of olive oil, and a large bottle of charcoal fire starter cubes. Passing the snack aisle, he grabbed a pack of hawthorn slices that his mother liked, intending to bring them home as a small surprise.

events.name: Inspect the vehicle and load up
events.description: Returning home at 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan loaded the purchased supplies and the previously organized camping gear one by one into the trunk of his family's Volkswagen Touran. He checked the tire pressure, oil, and spare tire, and used his mobile phone's navigation to test the road conditions to Sheshan for tomorrow (about 40 minutes). After confirming that everything was in order, he went back inside the house. His mother handed him a thermos of hot soy milk to take in the morning, and his father reminded him to be careful on the mountain roads.

events.name: Evening Xiaohongshu operations summary
events.description: Before going to bed, Lei Mingxuan opened Xiaohongshu and found that the camping gear note he posted during the day had received 96 likes and 32 saves, and his follower count had risen from 8 to 27. Excitedly, he took a screenshot and sent it to Shen Jie. Shen Jie replied that the momentum was good and next week's video would be even more explosive. He browsed the comments section, replied via private message to users asking about the tent brand, and noted down the needs of three potential customers. With this small sense of achievement, he set his alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning.

events.name: Bumped into Aunt Zhu, the neighbor, by chance
events.description: While going downstairs to take out the trash, Lei Mingxuan ran into his neighbor Aunt Zhu, who was out for a stroll. Aunt Zhu smiled and asked why he had gotten thinner lately, then brought up funny stories from his childhood. After exchanging pleasantries, Lei Mingxuan learned that Aunt Zhu's grandson was also into camping, so he promised to bring her some outdoor knowledge booklets next time. This brief neighborly interaction added a touch of warmth to a busy day.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home.
start_state.mood: Slightly excited, looking forward to the first camping trip.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.
end_state.mood: Slightly tired but full of anticipation; interactions with neighbors brought warmth.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 7,000 steps in the store; loaded and moved light loads during the evening packing.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan performed his first pour-over coffee ritual at home, savoring the bright flavor of Colombian beans. He then drove to Sheshan Hill in Songjiang, hiked up to choose a campsite, and set up his tent by hand. In the evening, he brewed coffee with an outdoor stove and cooked a simple meal, enjoying the solitary time in the mountains. As night fell, he read a novel in the tent, experiencing the tranquility of camping for the first time. The day's loaded hiking was physically demanding, and his weight dropped noticeably.

events.name: Morning pour-over coffee ritual (first time)
events.description: At exactly 6:00 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan got up and washed up. In the kitchen, he carefully took out the newly purchased Hario V60 dripper, pour-over kettle, and Colombian Huila coffee beans. He weighed out 15 grams of beans, poured them into the DeLonghi grinder, and ground them to a medium-fine grind. He fitted the filter paper to the dripper. He heated water to 90°C, first blooming the grounds with 30 grams of water for 30 seconds, watching them swell like a volcanic eruption. Then he poured water in a thin, circular stream up to 240 grams, keeping the time within 2 minutes 30 seconds. He poured the coffee into a preheated mug and took a small sip. The bright citrus acidity and caramel sweetness interwove, and he wrote down the flavor notes in his notebook with satisfaction, then photographed the whole process.

events.name: Drive to Sheshan National Forest Park
events.description: At 6:45 a.m., Lei Mingxuan picked up the backpack he had prepared last night, took the hot soy milk his mother had made, and started the Touran parked downstairs. The navigation showed about 35 minutes via the Inner Ring Elevated Road and then Husong Highway. He rolled down the window; the morning breeze carried the smell of early-summer grass, and the car stereo played Li Jian's songs. At 7:30 he arrived at the North Gate parking lot of Sheshan. He shouldered his 60-liter hiking backpack, carried the tent bag by hand, bought a ticket, and entered the park.

events.name: Hiking up the mountain and selecting a campsite
events.description: Starting from the park entrance, Lei Mingxuan hiked along the ridgeline following a track he had downloaded in advance. He carried about 15 kilograms of weight, walked at a moderate pace, and used trekking poles along the way while enjoying the moso bamboo forest and birdsong. After about two hours, at an elevation of 100 meters, he found a flat grassy slope away from the trail with no tall dead trees and few loose stones on the ground. Satisfied, he marked out the camping area. After resting briefly and replenishing with an energy bar and water, he began setting up camp.

events.name: Setting up camp and making pour-over coffee outdoors.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Lei Mingxuan skillfully set up the tent poles, secured the four corner stakes, and laid out the moisture-proof mat and sleeping bag. Then he sat on a folding stool, took out a mini stove head and a butane canister, poured mineral water into a small aluminum kettle and boiled it. Using the V60 dripper and the Ethiopian Guji coffee beans he had brought, he brewed pour-over coffee outdoors in the pine forest. The coffee aroma mixed with the smell of pine resin. Sitting alone in the wilderness, he felt an unprecedented sense of ease. He took a photo of the coffee surface in the cup with his phone and posted on Moments: The first cup of pour-over in the mountains—this is what life is all about.

events.name: Cooking dinner and reading
events.description: At 6 p.m., Lei Mingxuan cut the bacon into small pieces, put it into a small frying pan with corn and tomatoes, drizzled it with olive oil and fried it until cooked. Then he boiled pasta in another pot and simply mixed together a camping dinner. After the meal, he used wet wipes to clean the utensils and put the trash in a sealed bag. As the sky grew completely dark, he got into the tent, turned on the rechargeable LED lamp, leaned against his backpack and continued reading pages 150 to 210 of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, occasionally looking up at the sound of insects. Around 10 p.m., he turned off the light and quickly fell asleep in the profound silence.

start_state.location: Home Kitchen
start_state.mood: Expectant and focused, with a strong sense of ritual about the pour-over.

end_state.location: Inside a tent at Sheshan campsite
end_state.mood: Extremely relaxed and content, at one with nature

state.daily_exercise: Weighted hiking about 6 km, with a cumulative elevation gain of 200 meters.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Lei Mingxuan woke up at the campsite, packed up his gear without leaving a trace, and drove back to the city. After a short rest, he went to the store and recorded the long-awaited pour-over coffee Vlog, then finished editing and publishing it with remote guidance from his cousin Shen Jie. At the family dinner in the evening, he excitedly described the fun of camping to his parents and began planning the next trip to Dianshan Lake. Because the camping trip had been physically demanding and he stayed well hydrated, his weight rebounded slightly.

events.name: Camp cleanup and return
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, sunlight came through the tent's mesh, and Lei Mingxuan woke up. He quickly packed up his sleeping bag and foam pad, took down the tent, and carefully checked the ground for any leftovers. All the trash (including the previous night's food packaging and toilet paper) went into a black garbage bag and was stuffed into his backpack. He took a photo of the lawn restored to its original state and sent it to the hiking group to prove it was Leave No Trace camping. Around 7:30, he headed down the mountain eating an energy bar, arrived at the parking lot at 8:20, and drove back to Pudong.

events.name: Go home to rest and prepare the store
events.description: Arrived home at 9:30 AM, and his mother had already prepared breakfast. Lei Mingxuan took a quick shower, changed clothes, and moved the camping gear into the storeroom. He checked his phone and found a message from Xiao Lin at the shop: the shop had opened normally in the morning and sold two sun-protective jackets. Relieved, he replied, 'I'll be at the shop at noon to shoot the video. You keep watching the store.'

events.name: Record and publish a pour-over coffee vlog.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Lei Mingxuan set up his phone on a tripod in the pour-over coffee area in the corner of the store and adjusted it to 4K resolution. Simulating a morning scene, he started by introducing the origin of Colombian coffee beans, then demonstrated step by step grinding, warming the cup, blooming, and pouring water. When pouring, he deliberately made circular motions while explaining the difference between the one-pour and three-stage methods. After recording twice, he used CapCut to roughly cut out the flawed segments, added background light music and subtitles, and compressed the length to 3 minutes 20 seconds. Shen Jie watched the preview online and pointed out that a few frames were overexposed. After Lei Mingxuan adjusted it, he finally published it with the title: “A Beginner's First Cup of Pour-Over: Colombian Huila Brewed This Way Has Obvious Citrus Flavor #pour-over coffee #vlog.” In one afternoon it gained over 60 likes and more than ten followers.

events.name: Family dinner and camping stories
events.description: At 7 p.m., his mother specially made Shanghai-style braised pork and cucumber salad. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan animatedly described the bamboo forest at Sheshan and his experience brewing coffee outdoors. His father listened with great interest and said, 'Next time remember to bring snake repellent; when I was young and working in the countryside in Songjiang, I encountered a snake.' Lei Mingxuan nodded and made a note. He also took out his phone to show camp photos. When his mother saw the pot used for cooking noodles, she said it was too small and said she would find the large aluminum lunch box at home for him to bring next time. The family agreed that when they go camping at Dianshan Lake in two weeks, his father could come along. The dinner was quite plentiful, and Lei Mingxuan ate a few more pieces of braised pork than usual.

start_state.location: Sheshan campsite tent
start_state.mood: Refreshing, enjoying the outdoor morning

end_state.mood: Fell asleep with the joy of sharing and the warmth of family

2025-06.daily_overview: On Monday, Lei Mingxuan devoted himself fully to store work. He compiled the spring sales data and, combined with feedback on the mountain-style techwear trend from Xiaohongshu, made detailed preparations for the next day's video selection with suppliers. After a busy day, he checked his follower growth on Xiaohongshu in the evening and brainstormed themes for the next content post. At dusk, he went for a restorative jog, but because of work distractions he forgot to do his core training.

events.name: Waking Yoga and Morning Pour-Over
events.description: Waking up at 6:45 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan did a few cat-cow poses in bed to wake up his body, then went to the kitchen and brewed himself an Ethiopian Yirgacheffe pour-over, savoring the citrus and floral aroma. While drinking his coffee, he browsed the Xiaohongshu backend and saw that last night's video had gained 12 new followers; he was in a great mood.

events.name: Compile spring sales and online feedback data
events.description: At 10 a.m., Lei Mingxuan exported the sales reports from March to May this year from the cashier system and organized the sales volume by style, color preference, and size distribution into Excel. Then, he opened the Xiaohongshu backend, extracted the comment keywords from five high-exposure notes, and found that waterproof, multiple pockets, and making legs look longer were high-frequency words. He condensed all the information into one table and used a V-shaped icon to mark six potential styles, ready to present to Zhou Tao tomorrow.

events.name: Daily store operations and online operation ideas
events.description: In the afternoon, the store had many customers. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin served them together, and he paid attention to customers' feedback while trying on clothes. A repeat customer tried on a mountain-style vest and said it would be better if the color were a bit darker; he immediately noted it in his phone memo. During a lull at 4 o'clock, he planned his next Xiaohongshu video: a full record of his day as a shop owner, from opening and display to closing, also including hand-drip coffee clips. He listed a shooting outline and planned to carry it out on Wednesday.

events.name: Evening data review and recovery jog.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes and jogged 2 kilometers around the neighborhood at a pace of 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, feeling his legs still somewhat sore from camping. After the run, he did some simple stretching. Then he went home and opened the Xiaohongshu creator dashboard, where he saw his follower count had climbed to 38 and his previous pour-over coffee video had surpassed 2,000 views. Satisfied, he recorded the data, then opened The Song of Everlasting Sorrow and continued reading, looking for passages describing plants (such as oleander) in Shanghai's longtang to add detail to the novel scene he was conceiving. He also used his phone's notes app to jot down a sudden short line: every blue brick in the longtang had soaked up the plum rain of 1947.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Tuesday morning, Lei Mingxuan had an efficient video selection session with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao, finalizing the first 12 mountain-style techwear new products for autumn and laying the foundation for the second half of the year. In the afternoon, after recording and posting a behind-the-scenes video of the selection, he hurried to the Jing'an District Library for the first gathering of the 'Shanghai Old Dreams' reading group. During the exchange, his remarks tied to memories of longtang alleys resonated with the group, so he decided to participate long-term. When he once again politely declined Song Jia's roller-skating invitation that day, Lei Mingxuan did not expect that a rift in their old friendship was quietly growing. Despite being busy, he still kept up his core training in the evening.

events.name: Politely declined Song Jia's roller skating invitation again
events.description: Shortly after the shop opened in the morning, Song Jia sent a WeChat voice message with an eager tone: Mingxuan, there's a roller skating flash mob on Binjiang Avenue on Saturday afternoon, the 14th, and plenty of veteran skaters are going. You should be free, right? Lei Mingxuan opened his desk calendar and saw Saturday clearly marked with Writing Class (all day). He replied by voice helplessly: I'm really sorry, I signed up for a writing class, and Saturday is the first day of the class. I really can't get away. Next time for sure, next time for sure! After a brief silence, Song Jia only sent "okay," without even an emoji. Lei Mingxuan, busy preparing for a video conference, didn't notice the disappointment behind that brief reply.

events.name: Video call with supplier Zhou Tao to select styles.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Lei Mingxuan set up an iPad in the back room of the store and held a video conference for over an hour with fabric supplier Zhou Tao from Hangzhou. He first shared carefully prepared spring sales data and Xiaohongshu user feedback, emphasizing the core demand for the mountain-style techwear look. On the other end, Zhou Tao showed photos of more than 30 autumn sample garments. The two discussed fabric weight, waterproof ratings, and costs. In the end, Lei Mingxuan selected 12 styles (including 3 hardshell jackets, 4 softshell pants, 3 quick-dry shirts, and 2 vests), and boldly set the initial total quantity at 480 pieces (40 pieces per style), requiring delivery before July 10. Zhou Tao promised to produce them and offered a favorable discount.

events.name: Organizing orders and filming behind-the-scenes footage of outfit selection
events.description: At 12:30 noon, the video call ended. Lei Mingxuan organized the selected items' information into a formal purchase order, including style numbers, colors, and size allocation ratios, and sent it to Zhou Tao via WeChat for confirmation, receiving Zhou Tao's confirming reply. At 2 p.m., he set up his phone and filmed himself unboxing samples and discussing data in front of the computer, interspersing explanations of why he chose this style — because its pocket design is better suited for urban commuting. He invited regular customer Feng Xiaoyu, who was browsing accessories in the store, to make a cameo appearance and give try-on feedback. Once he had enough footage, he edited it into a 4-minute documentary-style video of the store visit and item selection, and published it before dinner.

events.name: Attended the first gathering of the “Old Dreams of Shanghai” reading group.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lei Mingxuan stepped into the seminar room on the second floor of Jing'an District Library on time. Seven or eight group members of varying ages were already seated around the long table. The discussion leader was a retired Chinese teacher, who led everyone in reading the first chapter of Song of Everlasting Sorrow. During the discussion, Lei Mingxuan raised his hand and spoke. He compared his childhood memories of the longtang in Pudong with Wang Qiyao's longtang, and read aloud a short line he had written, 'the pigeon that perched on the bamboo clothes-drying pole...' The group members nodded one after another. An older woman said, 'You captured the spirit of Shanghai.' The activity, originally planned for 1.5 hours, was extended until 9:30. When it ended, Lei Mingxuan voluntarily kept the organizer's WeChat and applied to join the group chat.

events.name: Late-night core training
events.description: After the gathering, he rode home on his bike, nearly 10 p.m. But Lei Mingxuan remembered that today was Tuesday, core training day, and didn't want to break the streak, so he quickly completed a set of core strength exercises in the bedroom: sit-ups 3×20, push-ups 3×17 (an improvement over last week), and planks 3×50 seconds. When he finished, he was drenched in sweat. After showering, it was almost 11 p.m., but he was too mentally excited to fall asleep for a long time.

start_state.mood: A little busy, feeling the strain of multitasking

2025-06.daily_overview: The Wednesday showers made business a little slow. Lei Mingxuan took inventory in the morning, then returned home in the afternoon to immerse himself in the world of a historical novel. After dinner, his father Lei Jianguo brought up stories of his grandfather’s youth, and those long-buried details excited Lei Mingxuan. Before his evening writing session, he did 15 minutes of home stretching, then sketched the outline of the first scene of his novel in the study, and finished washing up and went to bed before 23:00, maintaining a healthy routine.

events.name: Store inventory count and shelf adjustments
events.description: It was drizzling on and off, and only a single-digit number of customers entered the store in the morning. Lei Mingxuan simply had Xiao Lin watch the cash register while he took a barcode scanner and did a complete inventory count. He found that size M quick-dry shirts were low in stock and size XL waterproof jackets were overstocked. He immediately marked restocking and promotions in the ERP system and moved some XL jackets to prominent mannequin display positions. Considering that autumn new products were coming soon, he decided to hold a summer clearance sale through the WeChat community within the week.

events.name: Afternoon at home: reading and planning writing
events.description: After lunch, as the rain intensified, Lei Mingxuan decided not to go to the shop in the afternoon. He curled up on the sofa in his study and continued reading The Song of Everlasting Sorrow on his iPad, focusing on analyzing the author's technique in depicting spatial transitions in Shanghai's lane houses. At a brilliant passage, he jumped up and drew the novel's timeline on the whiteboard: from the victory of the War of Resistance in 1945 to the liberation in 1949, the fate of the protagonist's family in the alleyway. He also used his phone to search for a map of Pudong during the Republic of China era and confirmed that the story took place near Qichangzhan in Pudong.

events.name: Father recounts family stories.
events.description: During dinner, Lei Mingxuan casually mentioned that he was writing stories about the longtang. His father, Lei Jianguo, eyes lighting up, put down his chopsticks and said, 'When it comes to the longtang, your grandfather's story is the most interesting. In 1947, he saved up more than half a year's salary and bought an American radio from Shiliupu. The whole longtang was stirred up, but the idler across the street set his sights on it...' His mother, Wang Xiuying, smiled and added, 'That radio was later hidden in the ceiling, and that was how it was saved.' Lei Mingxuan was captivated. He took out his phone to record and asked his father to tell it slowly. After dinner, father and son, for the first time ever, talked in the living room until 10 o'clock. Lei Jianguo also dug out an old household register and grain coupons from the bottom of a trunk. These would become the most authentic details of the novel.

events.name: Home stretching and core activation workout
events.description: Before evening writing, Lei Mingxuan remembered he hadn't exercised all day, so he laid out a yoga mat in the study and did 15 minutes of home stretching and core activation exercises, including Cat-Cow pose and plank, to loosen up his muscles a bit.

events.name: Writing the first draft of the evening scene
events.description: After leaving the store, he pushed his e-bike onto the Lujiazui ring footbridge for a walk and calmed himself with the Lujiazui night view. During the walk, his Xiaohongshu note's likes passed 20 and comments reached 8; he replied to them and sent private messages with the purchase channels. He arrived home near 10:30 p.m., scooped the cat litter, and in the study sent a screenshot of the backend data to his cousin Shen Jie. She suggested adding the hashtag #outdoor outfits and making the copy tone more relaxed. They agreed to ask her for advice next time, and the exchange lasted about 15 minutes.

In the evening, he had a video call as scheduled with financial advisor Xu Feng and adjusted his fund portfolio to add a safety cushion to his investments. To make up for going to bed late the previous night, he went to bed an hour earlier than usual and did a recovery jog and light core training in the evening.

events.name: Quick morning pour-over
events.description: Because he stayed up late last night, Lei Mingxuan did not get up until 7:15. He quickly made a cup of stronger Colombian coffee to refresh himself; the whole process took only 5 minutes, and although the taste was rough, it worked. He thought to himself that he must not let writing disrupt his routine again.

events.name: Discussion on RedNote interaction and follower-growth strategies.
events.description: At 3 p.m., with few customers around, Lei Mingxuan sat down in a corner of the shop with his laptop and replied to comments on yesterday's video one by one: to those asking about coffee equipment, he recommended the brand he used; to those praising the shooting, he modestly said he still needed more practice. Then he had a video call with Shen Jie for about 40 minutes. Shen Jie suggested he run a prize interaction: follow + comment the mountain-style item you want most, draw three winners to receive a 50-yuan store coupon, and announce the winners in the next video. Lei Mingxuan immediately made a promotional image, posted it with a hashtag, and gained 15 new followers in an hour.

events.name: Routine store operations
events.description: After opening the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan checked the email confirming the autumn orders that had arrived online, printed it, and filed it. He told Xiao Lin to put the newly arrived quick-dry socks on the shelf at the entrance and hang up a summer sale tag. At noon, he ordered Japanese ramen takeout for himself and, while eating, browsed the official website of a popular mountain-style brand in Tokyo, studied the pattern details, and sent screenshots to Zhou Tao as a development reference.

events.name: Evening recovery jog and light core training
events.description: Given that he hadn't exercised at all yesterday and his weight had gone up, Lei Mingxuan changed into his running shoes after work and jogged 2 km along Zhangyang Road (pace 6:30 per km), then did core strength training in the neighborhood garden: push-ups 3×18 (felt a bit challenging, but he still completed them), sit-ups 3×20, and planks for 3×55 seconds. The fatigue in his body eased somewhat after training, but he still needs to adjust his routine.

events.name: Video call with financial advisor Xu Feng in the evening.
events.description: At 7:30 in the evening, Lei Mingxuan opened a WeChat video call in his study and connected with Xu Feng. He reported his current monthly fixed investment of 3,000 yuan and asked whether he should take profits given the recent market fluctuations. Xu Feng analyzed the advantages of bond funds and suggested adjusting the portfolio to 60% stocks and 40% bonds, adding 1,000 yuan per month to bond funds to smooth out volatility. After thinking it over, Lei Mingxuan agreed to adopt the plan, and they agreed that from this month on the monthly investment would rise to 4,000 yuan, with the code of the additional bond fund to be sent by Xu Feng later via WeChat.
