2025-06.daily_overview: On Friday morning, Lei Mingxuan adjusted his fund investment plan at home, adding bond funds and increasing the monthly investment amount. In the afternoon, he took his camera to the Shanghai History Museum and lingered for a long time in the restored old Shanghai lane exhibition area, gathering first-hand photos and notes for his novel. In the evening, he met his billiards friend Han Dong for a game. The two talked candidly by the table and agreed to meet once a week, allowing their old friendship to find a new balance. After billiards, he had a late-night snack with Han Dong: a few skewers with unsweetened oolong tea. His weight increased slightly.

events.name: Implement the adjustment to the fund's regular investment plan
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan remembered yesterday's agreement with Xu Feng and opened mobile banking to execute the new automatic investment plan. Since the agreement had been modified earlier, he only needed to confirm that the change to the 15th deduction had taken effect. He also transferred an extra 1,000 yuan from his savings account to his fund account, injecting capital in advance for the newly added bond fund portion. After everything was settled, he logged out of the banking app with satisfaction and casually wrote in his ledger that the monthly automatic investment for June had been raised to 4,000.

events.name: Visited the Shanghai History Museum
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan set out light, took Metro Line 2 to East Nanjing Road Station, and walked 10 minutes to the Shanghai History Museum in Huangpu District. He headed straight to the fourth-floor Old Shanghai Life exhibition hall. In the restored longtang area, he carefully photographed details such as carved doorways, stone-paved roads, and public telephone booths, and also recorded his impressions in a voice memo: So that's how the faucets in the kitchen were shared... He stood for a long time in front of a Republican-era student uniform, imagining the outfit of the young protagonist in his writing, and bought a set of postcards of historical photos from the museum collection as reference. He left reluctantly only when the museum was closing (5 p.m.), determined to bring his parents next time and listen to them tell more stories on site.

events.name: Evening billiards chat with Han Dong
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan showed up on time at the nine-ball club he frequented on Zhangyang Road, and Han Dong had already secured a table. As usual, they played American eight-ball for half an hour, and Han Dong won two straight games. While resting with a drink, Han Dong joked, 'Your Moments posts now are all about coffee and camping—you're like a retired old man.' Lei Mingxuan put down his drink and said seriously, 'True, my interests have shifted. But our friendship won't change. From now on, as long as nothing important comes up, I'll be here every Friday night to beat you.' Han Dong was stunned for a moment, then laughed heartily and punched Lei Mingxuan on the shoulder: 'I was waiting for you to say that. Just don't get too brainwashed by coffee!' Afterward, they happily played five more games until the place closed at 11. Before leaving, they posted a group photo in the WeChat group 'Pudong Billiards Three Musketeers.' After playing, the two went to a nearby barbecue restaurant for a late-night snack. Lei Mingxuan made an exception and ordered a small number of skewers along with a cup of unsweetened oolong tea.

events.name: Reflection and diary after billiards
events.description: Returning home at 11:30 pm, Lei Mingxuan could still hear Han Dong's teasing echoing in his mind. After washing up quickly, he opened his diary and wrote: Today Han Dong said I've been brainwashed by coffee, maybe. But the joy I felt when I touched history in the museum and brewed coffee on the mountain was real. I still like billiards, it just takes up a smaller share. Balance is a grown-up's lesson. Closing the notebook, he felt that tonight's honesty had actually brought him closer to Han Dong.

2025-06.daily_overview: Saturday was a full itinerary. In the early morning, Lei Mingxuan tasted a pour-over coffee of a new bean variety, then went to a writing workshop to systematically learn creative techniques. After class, he had a lively conversation with barista Xiao Zhou at a specialty coffee shop. In the afternoon, while purchasing supplies for the store, he luckily won a Dyson vacuum cleaner, and his Moments became lively. Taking advantage of the good light in the afternoon, he completed the riverside camping gear shoot. In the evening, he had an intimate talk with his parents and shared his creative ideas. His father brought out old photos to reminisce about the past, and family warmth became a solid backing on his writing journey. The whole day was packed with activities, and his weight rose slightly.

events.name: Morning pour-over coffee (Nicaragua Pacamara)
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan switched to the new ceramic dripper he had just bought yesterday and made a pour-over with Nicaraguan Pacamara beans. These beans had been recommended to him in a coffee group a few days earlier and had almond and cocoa flavor notes. He adjusted the grind to slightly coarser, used 92°C water, and deliberately slowed the pour rate. The result was rich and mellow; he wrote in his tasting notes that it had a distinct dark chocolate finish and would pair well with a campfire. After rinsing the equipment, he quickly ate the scallion-oil noodles his mother had prepared, and left at 8 o'clock to attend his writing class.

events.name: First Class of the Historical Novel Writing Workshop
events.description: From 9 a.m. to noon, in a bright classroom at a cultural and creative training center in Pudong New Area, eight participants sat in a circle. The writing instructor was an author who had published three novels set in the Republic of China. She guided everyone to start by choosing a historical space they were most familiar with. Without hesitation, Lei Mingxuan wrote down Qichangzhan Lane in Pudong on his draft paper and explained his emotional connection to that area. The instructor suggested he construct a geographical memory anchor, and then had the participants break into groups for a 15-minute quick scene sketch. Lei Mingxuan wrote a 500-word passage—a teenager waiting for the postman at the lane entrance—which he titled "Waiting".

events.name: After class, a chance encounter at a specialty coffee shop
events.description: After class, Lei Mingxuan found an independent café called Chuncui next to the training center. He ordered an Ethiopian pour-over. The barista behind the counter, Xiao Zhou (Zhou Yang, 28 years old), noticed the V60 dripper sticking out of the side pocket of his backpack and started talking about brewing parameters. Xiao Zhou demonstrated the single-pour technique and also shared his experience volunteering at a coffee estate in Yunnan. The two hit it off immediately and exchanged WeChat contacts. Xiao Zhou invited him to come to the weekly cupping event on Wednesday evenings. Lei Mingxuan excitedly bought a bag of the shop's blended coffee beans.

events.name: Won a Dyson vacuum cleaner in a mall shopping draw
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan went back to the mall where his store was located to buy a small batch of new T-shirts for the season's restock. When he paid, he was told that purchases over 599 yuan qualified for the anniversary lucky draw, so he casually filled out a raffle ticket and dropped it into the box. At 4 p.m., when the mall announced the third prize, he was still tidying the store. As the host read out the first-prize number... he looked down at his ticket—it matched! He ran up to the second-floor prize stage, and a staff member captured a photo of him holding a brand-new Dyson V10 vacuum cleaner. He quickly posted the photo on WeChat Moments with the caption: 'An unexpected gift from the mall's anniversary celebration—our store's cleanliness will depend on it from now on!' Zhang Wei replied instantly, 'So that's how you win a vacuum cleaner?' and Han Dong teased, 'The coffee-colored one suits you better.'

events.name: Afternoon riverside gear shoot
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan took advantage of the soft afternoon light, changed into a khaki quick-dry shirt and dark gray cargo shorts, carried a sample hiking backpack from the store, and rode to the lawn near the roller skating path on the Pudong riverfront. Sunlight poured through the clouds onto the river, and the lighting was excellent. He set up a tripod and took more than a dozen sets of outdoor outfit photos with a remote control, focusing on the backpack's multi-compartment design and the shirt's sun-protection details. After the shoot, he hurried back to the store, edited and laid out the photos on his phone with Lr, and paired them with a heartfelt caption: 'Even in the city, you need to have the mindset of being ready to leave at any time #DailyYamaStyle #ShanghaiStoreHunting' before publishing. Thanks to the striking visuals, the number of saves within an hour surpassed that of all previous posts.

events.name: Late-night heart-to-heart between father and son: family stories and writing intentions.
events.description: At 8 pm, Lei Mingxuan solemnly invited his father to the study and showed him the outline of "Xiafei Lane" he was writing and the sketch "Waiting." Lei Jianguo put on his reading glasses and read slowly. When he finished, he took off the glasses and the corners of his eyes were slightly moist. He silently went into the bedroom and brought out a small tin box containing his grandfather's old belongings: a salt-worker certificate from the Republic of China period, a hand-drawn map of Pudong, and a copy of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" with a damaged cover. His father opened the map, pointed to a spot, and said: "Here, this used to be your grandfather's rice shop. Before liberation, underground party members often came to buy rice." Lei Mingxuan felt he had found a treasure and quickly scanned these materials with his phone. His mother Wang Xiuying came in with two cups of hot milk and said softly: "I used to keep a diary when I was young too, but they were all trivial things..." His father laughed and said: "Those are the best details." The family of three, under the warm light, talked about their distant family history.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Father's Day, Lei Mingxuan showed his filial devotion in his own way. Early in the morning, he hand-brewed two cups of Yirgacheffe for his parents, then finished his routine weekend morning run. In the morning, he attended a writing workshop and officially chose the old alleyway as the story setting. After class, he went grocery shopping and cooked, carefully preparing the four-happiness braised gluten his father loved, and at the midday restaurant meal he gave his father a new shirt, and the family was full of joy. However, in the evening, Song Jia's disappointed voice message made him realize he had neglected an old friend. He apologized sincerely and resolved to make amends. Late at night, amid the jokes in the billiards group chat and the reflections in his diary, he became more determined to balance his old and new hobbies. Before bed, he did yoga stretching, and his weight stayed stable at the end-state target value.

events.name: Morning 5 km run and pour-over coffee
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan put on his running shoes and completed his third morning run of the week along Zhangyang Road to Century Park, 5 kilometers at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, feeling in stable form. After returning home, he took a shower, then hand-brewed two cups of Yirgacheffe coffee for his parents. His mother said after tasting it that it was more fragrant than store-bought coffee, while his father just nodded approvingly at the black coffee. The family rarely enjoyed coffee time together in the early morning, so Lei Mingxuan recorded the conversation with his phone, planning to use it as material for a future Vlog.

events.name: Writing workshop lesson 2: determining the story background.
events.description: From 9:30 to 11:30 in the morning, the workshop was held online (the mentor switched to a video meeting due to circumstances). Lei Mingxuan joined from his study and shared his reading notes from the past week and stories about his grandfather. The mentor hit the nail on the head: your strength lies in real life experience; don't fabricate, let memory speak. Inspired by this, he officially named the novel Xiafei Fang and finalized the core setting: the story unfolds around the fates of three generations of a rice shop family in Qichangzhan Lane, Pudong, between 1947 and 1949. Both the mentor and his classmates expressed anticipation.

events.name: Making four-happiness braised gluten for my father
events.description: After class at 11:30, Lei Mingxuan rushed to the nearby standardized market and bought kaofu, dried wood ear mushrooms, dried day lily buds, peanuts, and soy sauce. Back home, he tied on an apron and followed his mother's dictated recipe: blanch the kaofu and squeeze it dry, then deep-fry until golden; soak the wood ear mushrooms and day lily buds; heat oil in a wok, stir-fry star anise and cinnamon bark until fragrant, add all the ingredients along with dark soy sauce, sugar, and water, and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes to reduce the sauce. His mother helped on the side and corrected the heat. The finished dish was glossy red and pleasantly sweet-savory. His father tasted a piece and gave a thumbs-up: "Up to restaurant standards!"

events.name: Father's Day lunch and gift giving
events.description: At 12:30 pm, Lei Mingxuan asked his parents to change clothes, and the three of them walked to the Shanghai Old Restaurant near their home. He ordered his father's favorite Shanghai-style braised pork, fish fillets in fermented rice wine sauce, and pan-fried buns. In the warm atmosphere, he handed over a shirt gift box. His father opened it and tried it on immediately; the size was a perfect fit. His mother said with a smile, "That's much nicer than your old shirts." Lei Mingxuan raised his orange juice to toast his father: "Dad, thank you for teaching me how to behave and how to handle things. From now on, I'll try to come back more often on weekends to have meals with you." His father replied with reddened eyes, "Focus on your career and your writing; don't worry about home." The three clinked glasses, and the surrounding diners cast envious looks. The lunch was quite hearty, and Lei Mingxuan realized he should watch his weight, but he still ate a lot.

events.name: Confirm the autumn order sizes with supplier Zhou Tao.
events.description: At 3 p.m., taking advantage of a lull in the store (Xiao Lin was on duty), Lei Mingxuan called Zhou Tao from inside the shop. Based on previous sales data, he precisely adjusted the size ratios for the 12 styles: M 40%, L 35%, XL 20%, XXL 5%, to ensure no inventory buildup. After Zhou Tao modified it in the system and sent back the final version, the two confirmed that production would be completed and shipped before July 5. Lei Mingxuan let out a sigh of relief — the autumn stocking was finally settled.

events.name: In the evening, received a disappointed voice message from Song Jia and apologized.
events.description: Around 5 p.m., Lei Mingxuan had just returned to the front of the store when Song Jia sent a voice message in a clearly low tone: Mingxuan, honestly, you're so hard to make plans with now... Did I do something wrong? He was taken aback and immediately realized that declining twice in a row might have hurt her. He called her back at once and said sincerely: Sister Jia, absolutely not! It's really just a time conflict; the camping trip and the writing class were both set in advance. This is definitely my problem. Next time, you decide the time and I'll be fully available. Song Jia was silent for a few seconds before saying, Mm, then I'll wait for you to ask me, in a somewhat softened tone. After hanging up, Lei Mingxuan looked at his phone and sighed, then wrote in his memo: Next Saturday, take the initiative to invite Song Jia for a night riverside skate

events.name: Evening yoga stretching
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan rolled out the yoga mat and did a 20-minute Hatha yoga session, focusing on stretching his hip flexors and neck and shoulders after the morning run. He felt that his flexibility had been maintained, and although his weight had increased from last month, it was still acceptable overall.

events.name: Interaction in the billiards group and diary reflection
events.description: After exercising, he opened WeChat. A message appeared in the Pudong Billiards Practice Group: Han Dong @Lei Mingxuan: "Coffee master, want to play billiards next week?" followed by a crying-laughing emoji. A few billiards buddies in the group started teasing. Lei Mingxuan smiled and replied: "Sure! Same place Friday, loser buys late-night snacks." He attached a self-made sticker of a coffee cup and a pool cue stacked together. The group was full of laughter. Before bed, he wrote in his diary: "Today, Father's Day, I was deeply moved. The power of family is the foundation of writing. Song Jia's voice message was a wake-up call — when pursuing a new world, I must not forget the people of the old world. I need to learn to actively maintain relationships. Coffee, writing, camping, billiards, and roller skating should not be enemies; they are the multiple voices that make up my life. I have to learn to conduct them."

2025-06.daily_overview: A Saturday to enjoy solitude and nature: brewed coffee at home in the early morning, then drove alone to Dianshan Lake and set up camp. I hiked, read, and practiced breathing exercises amid the lake and mountain scenery. In the evening, after cooking noodles for dinner, I jotted down ideas for a novel, and finally fell asleep under the stars.

events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan got up and practiced pour-over coffee as usual. Today he used Costa Rican honey-processed beans, a water temperature of 91 degrees, and a three-stage pour, which brought out distinct honey and nut sweetness. Satisfied, he recorded the flavor notes in his 'June Coffee Log.'

events.description: At 9:00, he loaded the camping gear (tent, sleeping bag, stove, etc.) into the trunk of his car, set out from his home in Pudong, and drove along Huqingping Highway for about 1.5 hours to reach Dianshan Lake Scenic Area. After choosing a flat grassy spot by the lake, he skillfully set up the double-layer tent, laid out the ground mat and sleeping bag, set up the folding chair, and placed coffee equipment on the small table.

events.name: Lakeside hiking, outdoor reading, and light exercise.
events.description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan hiked about 5 kilometers along the lakeside path, observing birds and aquatic plants. After returning to the campsite, he sat in a folding chair reading the historical novel 'The Biography of Zeng Guofan' he had brought, occasionally looking up to enjoy the lake view. During reading breaks, he also did several sets of sit-ups and breathing exercises on the moisture-proof mat to maintain basic fitness, until the sun hung low in the west.

events.name: Camp dinner
events.description: In the evening, he cooked a pot of vegetable noodles on a small gas stove and fried some luncheon meat for a simple dinner. After the meal, he cleaned up the dishes and bagged the trash.

events.name: In the evening, organized excerpts from the novel Plum Rain.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took out his notebook and recorded the inspiration from the lakeside during the day: the color of the lake water, the sound of wind blowing through the reeds, and the calls of waterbirds in the distance. He turned these details into a scene description of a summer night in the Republican era. In his notebook, he refined the draft of a key passage in his novel Plum Rain, preparing for subsequent writing.

events.name: Stargazing and falling asleep.
events.description: As it grew dark, the campsite fell quiet. He lay on his ground mat looking up at the starry sky, using a star map app on his phone to identify the Summer Triangle, and mentally sketched the corresponding Republican-era summer night scene for his novel. Late at night, he climbed into his sleeping bag and fell asleep peacefully.

2025-06.daily_overview: On the last day of June, Lei Mingxuan fought on two fronts in the office and at home, taking stock of his business and health gains and losses. Though physically exhausted, the steady rise in performance and slight drop in weight brought him comfort, and he set a clear direction for July.

events.name: Monthly store operations review and financial accounting
events.description: In the morning, at the store warehouse, he opened a computer Excel sheet and summarized June's revenue, purchasing costs, rent, marketing expenses, and so on, calculating that the month's net profit was about 21,000 yuan, a slight increase of 5% month-on-month. He analyzed that online customer acquisition had clearly boosted the average order value and decided to increase the social media budget in July. During this inventory review, he also specifically looked back at his body data: his weight had dropped compared with last week, but overall it was still about 3 kg higher than at the beginning of the month. This strengthened his resolve to follow a strict diet and exercise more in July, with a goal of dropping to 78 kg by the end of the month.

events.name: Reviewing the first month of Xiaohongshu operations with cousin Shen Jie
events.description: At noon Shen Jie arrived at the store, and the two reviewed their progress in the lounge area while eating takeout healthy salads. The account gained over 1,000 followers in a month, with good engagement and 10 posts. They concluded that outfit tutorial content had the highest engagement rate, planned to increase video frequency in July, and started planning an offline outfit-sharing event. Shen Jie drew a draft content calendar on a tablet on the spot.

events.name: Weighed myself in the evening and reflected on health progress
events.description: After returning home at 9 p.m., he weighed himself on the new electronic scale. It showed 80.5 kg, down from last week, and he felt slightly lighter. But due to dietary fluctuations in mid-June, his overall weight was still about 3 kg higher than at the beginning of the month. He took a photo of the scale and posted it to the fitness check-in group, receiving likes from friends. Then he checked his body; his thigh muscles were still noticeably sore. Realizing his endurance was insufficient, he decided to increase the proportion of stretching and strength training going forward.

events.name: Draft the July marketing calendar and bedtime journal.
events.description: After weighing himself, he sat in the study and continued working. Based on today's review, he drafted the July marketing plan in his notebook: continue the camping-themed display, create pet-friendly store content using Afu's material, and co-host a 'historical fiction + outdoor function' sharing session with the reading group, aiming to attract more traffic. Before bed, he handwrote a short diary entry, reflecting on June's gains and losses, and set July health goals: strictly run three mornings a week and reduce his weight to below 80 kg.

2025-02.daily_overview: Valentine's Day: Lei Mingxuan closed the shop early and personally cooked braised pork and pan-fried buns for his parents, expressing his gratitude with clumsy but sincere cooking; his parents were moved to tears. After doing yoga in the evening, he continued studying coffee brewing techniques to prepare for the next day's pour-over.

events.name: Closing the store early to buy ingredients
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lei Mingxuan closed the clothing store early and went to the market to pick pork belly, seasonings, flour, ground meat, and so on. He specifically asked the butcher how to choose three-layer pork belly, and bought his mother's favorite shepherd's purse to make the filling. Carrying heavy bags, he was full of anticipation.

events.name: Independently completed meal prep and cooking.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lei Mingxuan came home, put on an apron, and washed the ingredients, cutting meat and mincing filling. His mother tried to step in several times, but he smilingly pushed her out. He recreated his mother's method from memory: for the braised pork, he first stir-fried the meat, then let it simmer slowly; for the pan-fried buns, he added a little too much water when kneading the dough, making it sticky, but he insisted on finishing. The final braised pork was a bit too sweet, and the bun bottoms were slightly burnt, but it was full of heartfelt care.

events.name: The gratitude dinner moved the parents.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., his father came home from work and was astonished to see a table full of dishes. The family of three sat around the table. Lei Mingxuan served food to his parents. His mother tasted a piece of braised pork, her eyes welled up, and she kept saying that her son had grown up. His father also nodded repeatedly. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan expressed gratitude to his parents for their support over the years, and the atmosphere was warm and touching.

events.name: Proactively cleaned up and chatted after the meal.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan cleared the dishes, wiped the table, and swept the floor. Then he sat with his parents in the living room drinking tea and chatting about the store's recent situation and Valentine's Day feelings. His mother suggested having a family food day once a month from now on, and Lei Mingxuan readily agreed. He and his father also planned to go fishing on the weekend.

events.name: Yoga and learning about coffee
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan did a 25-minute home yoga session, then studied tomorrow's pour-over plan in the coffee group, adjusting the grind size and water temperature based on group members' suggestions, fully preparing for the morning coffee. The heavy oily dishes during the Spring Festival caused his weight to rise noticeably, so he decided to start controlling his diet next week.

This time, water flow control improved but was still not perfect; extraction uniformity increased slightly, but the coffee still tasted astringent. The coffee group commented that there was progress, but it had not yet reached the ideal. He decided to keep practicing and make pour-over coffee part of his morning ritual.

events.description: At 8 a.m., Lei Mingxuan laid out a mat in the living room and did 3 sets of push-ups, 3 sets of squats, and 2 sets of sit-ups, about 20 minutes in total. With no equipment and limited space, the intensity was far lower than an outdoor run, but his muscles still felt slightly sore, and he silently resolved to resume morning running when the weather warmed up. Then he showered and had breakfast.

events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Lei Mingxuan packed his backpack, walked to the metro station, and took Line 2 to People's Square Station. On the subway, he scrolled through Moments, saw a roller skating video posted by Shen Jie, and liked and commented on it. He arrived about 40 minutes later, exited the station, and walked to the Shanghai Museum.

events.name: Visit the Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition
events.description: At 10:15 a.m., Lei Mingxuan entered the museum and headed straight for the special exhibition on ancient Egyptian civilization. He carefully examined artifacts such as pharaoh statues, painted mummy coffins, and jewelry, paying special attention to the accessory craftsmanship and color matching on ancient Egyptian clothing. He took many detailed photos with his phone, including the decorative patterns on the golden mask and beaded jewelry, remaining fully immersed for about two and a half hours.

events.name: Selecting cultural creative souvenirs
events.description: At 1 p.m., after the tour, Lei Mingxuan picked out a papyrus bookmark with hieroglyphs and patterns, and a small pendant printed with the god Anubis, planning to hang it on the backpack display in the store. He paid with his phone and carefully put everything away.

events.name: Return home to organize inspiration
events.description: Returning home at 3 p.m., Lei Mingxuan imported the photos of cultural relics he had taken into his computer and categorized them by clothing, accessories, and patterns. He recorded inspirations such as geometric totems and tassel applications that could be incorporated into the store's accessory designs, and placed the papyrus bookmark in his commonly used notebook. He felt that this exhibition visit provided new ideas for differentiating the store's products.

He also left a sticky note on the refrigerator reminding himself to be moderate.

events.name: Morning weigh-in reflection.
events.description: After getting up, Lei Mingxuan stepped onto the body fat scale, and the number stayed at 82.0 kg, nearly 3 kg more than before the Spring Festival. He lifted his shirt and looked in the mirror, seeing obvious abdominal fat accumulation. Recalling weeks of high-fat, high-sugar eating and morning runs interrupted by the cold snap, he realized he had to act immediately to control his weight.

events.name: Agreed with Mom on a fat-loss dinner
events.description: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan discussed with his mother Wang Xiuying in the living room, suggesting reducing greasy dishes such as braised pork and switching to steamed fish, blanched vegetables, and multigrain rice. His mother expressed support and decided to adjust the daily menu herself, increasing the proportion of steaming and boiling.

events.name: Go to the food market to buy healthy ingredients
events.description: At 2 p.m., after Lei Mingxuan returned home from the shop, he changed out of his jacket and walked alone to the Zhangyang Road Food Market, where he picked out a fresh sea bass, broccoli, lettuce, and a bag of brown rice. He deliberately avoided the oily pork stalls and bought only low-fat fish and vegetables.

events.name: Mother and son cooking a fat-loss dinner together.
events.description: In the evening, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother wash vegetables in the kitchen while she prepared the sea bass. Together they made steamed sea bass (with just a little steamed fish soy sauce), blanched broccoli, and brown rice, controlling oil and sugar throughout. After his father Lei Jianguo came home from work, the family tasted the new light and healthy dishes, and his father nodded in approval.

events.name: Fridge magnet note reminding moderation
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan used a marker to write a sticky note reading Eat until 70% full at every meal and stuck it on the refrigerator door as a visual reminder. His mother smiled in agreement, and his father also expressed support.

events.name: Store tidying and customer reception preparation
events.description: At 10 a.m., after Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store, he first tidied the newly arrived spring clothing racks, arranging thin jackets and hoodies by color; checked the lighting of the blind box display cabinet, wiped the rest area coffee table, put out snacks and tea sets, and prepared to welcome regular customer Qian Duoduo.

The three of them created a small group chat and agreed to share promotional plans. Seeing the operational approaches of different business types, he was deeply inspired.

events.name: Mugwort foot soak at home in the evening
events.description: Class ended at 6:30. After eating a simple meal out, Lei Mingxuan went home. Feeling soreness in his legs, he took out a mugwort foot bath pack from the cabinet, boiled hot water, and soaked his feet for about 15 minutes. He broke into a slight sweat, and most of his fatigue was relieved.

events.name: After soaking my feet, I'll drink tea and watch the latest anime.
events.description: After soaking his feet, Lei Mingxuan brewed a cup of Longjing tea, curled up on the living room sofa, and opened Bilibili to watch the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. Immersed in the delicate visuals, he drank two cups of tea in a row and felt completely relaxed.

events.name: Rearranged the blind box collection.
events.description: At ten o'clock, Lei Mingxuan got up and went to the study, opened the glass display cabinet, moved the recently acquired Pan Shen and Dimoo hidden figures to the center display positions, and rearranged them by series and color. He squatted there fiddling for nearly half an hour, and the cabinet looked brand new.

events.name: Shared blind box photos in the designer toy group and established a foot-soaking habit.
events.description: Lei Mingxuan used his phone to take top-down photos of the full new display and close-ups of the hidden figure, and posted them to the 'Magic City Blind Box Fan Group' (members including Lin Jing, etc.) with the caption: 'Sorting through the cabinet late at night, I found the hidden figure's luster is really nice to look at.' He soon received a like and a doll-swap invitation from Lin Jing. Before bed, he felt his feet were warm and fell asleep faster, and wrote in his phone notes: 'Soak feet 15 min, a miracle sleep aid,' and decided to keep doing it every day.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the second day of the special training camp, the focus was on combined business formats. Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth discussion with the instructor on the 'coffee + clothing' model and received suggestions. In the evening, he immediately ordered starter equipment for pour-over coffee on JD.com's self-operated channel, choosing next-day delivery, determined to put the idea into practice. At the same time, he verified that soaking his feet improved sleep. In the evening, he organized his training camp notes and drew a layout diagram for the coffee corner to prepare for follow-up actions.

events.name: Felt the effects of foot soaking in the morning
events.description: Woke up at 7:30. Lei Mingxuan stretched in bed and felt more alert than usual. Realizing the deep sleep effect from soaking his feet last night, he smiled and noted: 'Keep soaking your feet to improve sleep.'

events.name: Attending the second day of the intensive training camp.
events.description: In the morning, the course shifted to combined "coffee + clothing" business model cases, and the instructor presented success-case data from Chengdu and Hangzhou. In the afternoon, in an experiential consumption design workshop, each group built store models with LEGO. Lei Mingxuan built a circular layout: the bar counter in the middle and clothing displays around the outside, earning the instructor's comment "smooth circulation."

events.name: One-on-one discussion with the instructor and online shopping for coffee gear
events.description: At 4 p.m., after the class ended, Lei Mingxuan proactively approached the instructor, Mr. Li, who taught the "mixed business formats" session, and spent ten minutes describing his store's size and customer base, asking about the "coffee + clothing" model. Mr. Li suggested starting with a pour-over coffee bar and partnering with a local coffee roasting studio for events. Lei Mingxuan recorded the audio and photographed the whiteboard. When he got home in the evening, he immediately compared review videos on his iPad, ordered a Hario V60 ceramic drip filter set and Colombian Huila coffee beans from JD.com's self-operated section, chose next-day delivery, and sent a screenshot to Yang Fan.

events.name: Evening organizing of training camp notes and coffee corner planning
events.description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan took out his notebook to organize the key points from the day's course, focusing on recording Teacher Li's suggestions. Then he sketched a layout diagram of the coffee corner on paper, planning the counter position, equipment placement, and traffic flow, and marked a list of utensils to purchase, and decided that after receiving the goods the next day, he would first try brewing at home.

2025-02.daily_overview: In the morning, Lei Mingxuan organized his notes from the special training camp and formulated an action plan for the store upgrade. The pour-over coffee equipment arrived, and he used the professional equipment for his first precisely controlled brew; compared with the previous simple equipment, the handling was noticeably improved. In the afternoon, Zhang Wei came to the store to look at samples and gave professional marketing advice. In the evening, he recorded his coffee notes and ordered an electronic scale, and the new hobby gradually took shape.

events.name: Organize notes from the special training camp and make a plan
events.description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan spread out his notes from the past two days in the study and used the mind-mapping software XMind to organize the 'three-step community marketing plan' and the 'coffee + clothing space circulation draft.' He set a goal to complete the concept drawing for partial store renovation within three weeks, start the procurement of the coffee bar counter after one month, and synced iCloud to his phone.

events.name: Sign for and clean the coffee equipment
events.description: At 10 a.m., the delivery man rang the doorbell. Lei Mingxuan signed for the package and immediately opened it in the kitchen. He excitedly took out the drip cone, coffee server, and pour-over kettle, washed them with dish detergent, and then sterilized them with boiling water. As he opened the sealed bag of coffee beans, a rich aroma rushed out.

events.name: First official brew with the new equipment
events.description: Lei Mingxuan used professional equipment for his first precisely controlled brew. Following the tutorial on his phone, he weighed 15 grams of beans and ground them to the coarseness of granulated sugar, folded the filter paper, and rinsed it with warm water. His hand shook slightly as he poured, but he tried hard to keep the stream even. The bloom was flatter than before. The brew took about two and a half minutes; the liquid was darker in color, and it tasted both sour and bitter. Yet compared with the previous simple tools, the feeling of control was much better. He savored the process and found it novel.

events.name: Reflect and continue learning.
events.description: While drinking the coffee he made himself, Lei Mingxuan immediately opened Bilibili to watch a tutorial video on correcting water flow. He discovered that fixing the wrist and driving with the forearm were the key points. He lay on the sofa practicing the pouring motion in the air and decided to practice once a day for a week.

events.name: Zhang Wei visited the store to check out the mountain-style samples.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Zhang Wei arrived at the store on time. Lei Mingxuan showed him the sample outdoor jackets in detail. From a marketing perspective, Zhang Wei said the 'urban exploration' concept could replace the mountain style, and suggested playing rainforest soundscapes in the store to enhance the atmosphere. The two chatted in the rest area for two hours, and Lei Mingxuan recorded all the suggestions on his phone.

events.name: In the evening, noted coffee insights and ordered a digital scale
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan noted in his phone memo: first pour-over, water temperature 87°C, grind size a bit too fine, adjusted one notch coarser. Then he ordered a digital scale with 0.1g precision on JD.com and added a bag of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe beans to his cart, feeling that life had gained a new dimension of ritual.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Tuesday morning, Lei Mingxuan resumed his morning run after half a month. His stamina had declined clearly, and he barely completed 2 kilometers. In the morning, he accompanied his mother to the vegetable market, reliving warm memories and learning her tips for choosing produce. In the afternoon, he continued optimizing the display with store clerk Xiao Lin. In the evening, he used an app to log his diet and plan his training resumption, then soaked his feet and went to bed early.

events.name: Resuming early morning runs
events.description: At 6:30 the alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan put on his compression top and running shoes and headed to the riverside path. He planned to jog 2 kilometers, but at 1 kilometer his heart rate spiked to 160 and his breathing became rapid, so he had to fast-walk for half a minute before continuing. He finally finished 2 kilometers in 16 minutes 30 seconds, sweating heavily. He sat on a bench to stretch, opened Keep to log the run, and set a morning running plan for every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.

events.name: Stretching and running resolve record
events.description: After stretching post-run, Lei Mingxuan took a selfie with his phone's front camera and posted a Moments entry visible only to himself: '2km, 16'30", fitness hit rock bottom, but this is the beginning of a rebound.' He also set the next morning run reminder to repeat.

events.name: Accompany mother to the vegetable market
events.description: At nine in the morning, after Lei Mingxuan had showered, his mother suggested they go grocery shopping together, and he readily agreed. The two walked to the market, where his mother taught him how to judge the freshness of pork ribs (pink color and springy texture) and showed him how to pick tender greens. Lei Mingxuan helped carry the basket and wrote down his mother's soup-stewing secrets. The whole process was relaxed and pleasant; his mother smiled and said, 'It's been a long time since we've done this.'

events.name: Home-cooked stewed soup and lunch
events.description: After returning home at ten, his mother blanched the pork ribs, Lei Mingxuan helped by cutting the winter melon, and they simmered it for over an hour until the soup turned milky white. At lunch, he drank two bowls of soup, remembered the taste of childhood, and agreed with his parents to go grocery shopping together every weekend.

events.name: Afternoon store display and app-based recording
events.description: Arriving at the store at one in the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan and Xiaolin put up the Urban Adventure theme sign and adjusted the mannequin outfits. When customer traffic was sparse, he shared stories about sourcing products in Hangzhou, and Xiaolin talked about her college camping experiences. After returning home in the evening, he used the newly downloaded MyFitnessPal app to record the day's diet, found that the calories slightly exceeded the target, but resolved to strictly control them tomorrow.

events.name: In the evening, soaked his feet and drafted a plan for physical recovery.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Lei Mingxuan did his routine 15-minute foot soak while drafting an initial physical recovery plan in the notes app on his phone: gradually increase running volume, add core training, and control the staple food at dinner. After the foot soak, he went to bed early to save energy for the next morning's recovery run.

start_state.mood: Determined to resume exercising; feels slight fitness anxiety but keeps it under control

end_state.location: At home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Physically tired yet mentally fulfilled, with warm interactions with his mother and renewed confidence in his future exercise plan.

2025-02.daily_overview: After his morning running adaptation training, Lei Mingxuan made his second pour-over coffee with the new electronic scale, showing clear progress; during the day he counted the accessory inventory at the store and contacted supplier Wu Fang to replenish stock; in the evening he discussed the coffee corner plan with his father and gained his support; before bed he formally drafted a spring fitness recovery plan.

events.name: Morning run conditioning
events.description: At 6:40, Lei Mingxuan left and jogged 2.2 kilometers along the same route at a slightly faster pace of 7'20". His heart rate was still a bit high but stable. He kept jogging the whole way without stopping, and stretched for 5 minutes after the run.

events.name: Second pour-over coffee practice
events.description: After returning home from his morning run, he used a new electronic scale to precisely weigh 15 grams of beans, adjusted the grind one notch coarser, set the water temperature to 88°C, poured with a steadier wrist, the bloom expanded evenly, brewed for 2 minutes 45 seconds, the bitterness on the palate lessened, and a faint sweetness emerged. He excitedly took photos and recorded the parameters.

events.name: Organize store inventory and contact Wu Fang
events.description: Arriving at the store in the morning, Lei Mingxuan found that only one piece remained of each of two titanium steel necklaces in the accessories area. He took photos and sent them via WeChat to Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang to ask about the restocking cycle. Wu Fang replied that the new styles could be shipped within a week. At the same time, he counted the arrivals of spring new items and checked Lao Zhou's delivery orders.

events.name: Lei Mingxuan poured out the foot-soaking water, washed up, changed into pajamas, and recorded the parameters to adjust tomorrow in the pour-over coffee diary app (lower the water temperature to 90). Then he said goodnight to his parents, opened Bilibili to watch a video about ancient Egyptian jewelry craftsmanship, turned off the lights at 23:00 on the dot, and went to sleep, bringing a full day to a close.
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to sit beside his father and opened his iPad to show him the coffee corner sketch. His father, Lei Jianguo, understood the trend but reminded him to control costs. Lei Mingxuan nodded and promised a strict budget, and asked his father for his opinion on renovation materials. His father agreed to help contact a contractor he knew.

events.name: Creating a spring physical fitness recovery plan
events.description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan formally wrote in his phone's memo: run 3 times a week (gradually increase to 5 km), do yoga 2 times (following Keep), bodyweight training 2 times (push-ups, squats), eat until 70% full at dinner and record meals, soak feet before bed. He named the plan "Spring Fitness Recovery Plan," with a goal of reducing his weight to 78kg within two months.

2025-02.daily_overview: Thursday was overcast and rainy; Lei Mingxuan replaced his morning workout with yoga at home. The store's community operation was initiated; he created a WeChat group and posted a preview on Moments. After assisting with the mall's fire drill in the afternoon, he had a long chat with his visiting cousin Shen Jie about the coffee corner idea; in the evening, he learned to make spring rolls from his mother, and before bed he soaked his feet and planned the next day's financial review.

events.name: Indoor yoga as a replacement for morning exercise and community group creation.
events.description: Outside a fine rain was falling. Lei Mingxuan spread out a yoga mat in his bedroom and followed Keep to complete a 20-minute vinyasa flow, using spinal twists to relax his lower back. After breakfast, he created a WeChat group called "Xiafei Ji Mountain-Style Players Group," added regular customers such as Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu, along with several shop-owner friends, and set the group announcement: the first wave of mountain-style new-product previews will be released Friday evening.

events.name: Teased the 'City Adventure' theme on Moments
events.description: At ten in the morning, he posted on WeChat Moments using the previously shot model photos with the caption “When the concrete jungle meets mountain-style utility — the Xiafei Collection spring line is coming soon,” and set the store location tag. Within half an hour it got more than twenty likes, and his cousin Shen Jie commented, “Buy it!”

events.name: Store fire drill
events.description: In the afternoon, the mall property management organized a fire evacuation drill. Lei Mingxuan led Xiao Lin to cut power, lock the cash register, and evacuate orderly via the stairs. Afterward, he checked the expiration dates of the store's fire extinguishers and re-posted the emergency exit signs.

events.name: Discussing the coffee corner with my cousin Shen Jie
events.description: After the rehearsal, Shen Jie stopped by the store. The two brewed a cup of coffee in the rest area using Lei Mingxuan's hand-drip equipment. After tasting it, Shen Jie suggested they could collaborate with independent coffee shops, and offered to connect him with coffee brands she knew in the fashion circle. Lei Mingxuan thought the idea was feasible, and they agreed to discuss it in detail next week.

events.name: Learning to make spring rolls from my mother
events.description: In the evening, his mother Wang Xiuying planned to make shepherd's purse and pork spring rolls. Lei Mingxuan stood nearby and watched with great interest. He clumsily broke two while wrapping, and his mother smilingly taught him hand-over-hand how to pinch the edges. After they were fried golden, he tasted his own ugly-looking spring rolls and found them especially delicious. His father praised his son for learning quickly.

events.name: Soaking feet before bed and planning for tomorrow
events.description: While soaking his feet, Lei Mingxuan listed tomorrow's to-do items in Todoist: confirm the meeting time with financial advisor Xu Feng, organize fund holdings, and sign up at the billiards association. He felt that life was busy but orderly, his weight had begun to trend downward, and everything was looking up.

start_state.location: At home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
start_state.mood: The gloomy rain dampened my mood a bit, but it was quickly brightened by new tasks.

end_state.location: At home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
end_state.mood: Felt fulfilled by the community launch and family warmth, and had a clear plan for the future.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last Friday of the month, Lei Mingxuan went to the billiards association to complete referee training registration. In the afternoon, he met with financial advisor Xu Feng to review the portfolio and adjust positions to reduce risk. In the evening, facing the 81 kg weight and the physical fitness test results, he calmly made a recovery plan and invited Zhang Wei to supervise, ending a fulfilling but somewhat cautionary February with a foot soak and an early bedtime.

events.name: Morning bodyweight workout and app tracking
events.description: After getting up at 7:00, Lei Mingxuan did a 10-minute bodyweight workout in the bedroom: 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps per set) and squats (20 reps per set), recorded with Keep. Then he used the app to log the calories in his breakfast, starting a day of moderation.

events.name: Billiards referee training registration
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike to the Pudong New Area Sports Federation, filled out a registration form for the amateur billiards referee training course, paid 600 yuan in training fees, and received a copy of the Billiards Competition Rules Handbook. After returning home, he skimmed the first chapter and found that the training starts next Saturday and lasts four weeks.

events.name: Organizing fund holdings materials.
events.description: After registering, Lei Mingxuan opened mobile banking in the store office, exported all fund position details and the yield curve for the past year, organized them into a table in Excel, and marked three tech-themed funds whose floating gains exceeded 20% but whose proportion had exceeded 35%.

events.name: Meet with financial advisor Xu Feng to review and rebalance the portfolio
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lei Mingxuan arrived at a café on Hengshan Road, Xuhui District. Xu Feng pointed out the risk of the tech sector overheating and suggested redeeming part of the holdings and switching to conservative mixed and pure bond funds, reducing the tech allocation to 15%. Lei Mingxuan agreed and reserved 30,000 yuan as working capital for the store renovation. When he got home around 6 p.m., he immediately made the moves: redeemed the profitable portion of ChinaAMC Technology Innovation Mixed Fund and GF Small/Mid Cap Fund, and subscribed to China Universal Steady Huiying Fund and E Fund Sound Return Bond Fund. After the transactions, he took a screenshot and sent it to Xu Feng for confirmation, leaving 32,000 yuan in the account.

events.name: Evening weigh-in and physical fitness test
events.description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan stood on the scale, and the reading settled at 81.0 kg. He lifted his shirt to look in the mirror, where the belly fat was noticeable. He tried climbing the stairs from the 1st floor to the 6th floor, and was panting heavily with a pounding heartbeat, realizing the consequences of the cold snap interrupting his morning runs.

events.name: Formulate a plan to resume exercise and invite someone to supervise.
events.description: Facing his weight, Lei Mingxuan didn’t wallow in anxiety. Instead, he opened his memo and listed: continue morning runs tomorrow if it doesn’t rain; order a jump rope and yoga mat online as backups; start doing three cardio sessions plus two strength sessions per week next week; send the screenshot to Zhang Wei to ask him to supervise. He also set a small goal of reducing his weight to 79 kg within a month.

events.name: Soak feet and go to bed early.
events.description: At 10:30 pm, Lei Mingxuan soaked his feet 15 minutes early, said goodnight to Han Dong and Zhang Wei in the group chat, fell asleep quickly after lying down, and in his dream saw the snowy mountains of western Sichuan and himself wearing a hardshell jacket, with the corners of his mouth slightly raised.

end_state.location: At home in Pudong New Area, Shanghai
